title: Digital Marketing Executor (Local SEO Focus)
description: Who We Are We’re Fresh Tech Maids ( ---------- ), a Chicago-based chemical-free cleaning company. Not someone starting from zero. (2) Execution of our playbook is what we need. (3) The strategy exists. The KPI dashboard exists. The playbook is documented. We need the person who executes it with discipline and proves it with numbers every week. (4) We live by the optimize — measure — learn cycle. Every project has a number. Every number gets tracked. Every result shapes what we do next. If that’s how you already work, keep reading. Are You This Person? (1) Accountable. You own your numbers. You don’t blame tools, the market, or the algorithm. (2) Deadline-driven. You hit dates. When something slips, you flag it early. (3) Data-first. You check dashboards before you share opinions. (4) Measurement-minded. You think in baselines, targets, and deltas. (5) Curious. You ask “what’s working?” and “why?” every week. (6) Honest. You say when something isn’t working. No sugarcoating, no spin. What You’ll Do You’ll execute the marketing system that brings qualified leads into our pipeline — calls, web chats, email s, and online bookings. Real projects, real numbers, real deadlines: (1) Local SEO (the core) — manage 3 Google Business Profiles; monitor weekly Semrush Map Rank Tracker geo-grids; grow our local map-pack visibility. (2) Relationship-based link earning — nurture relationships with Chicago bloggers, green-living creators, hyperlocal sites, and pet/realtor creators that earn quality links to our pillar blogs. (3) Listicle & citation placements — “best of Chicago” directories and citation correction across our 3 locations. (4) Content repurposing & social — turn our bi-weekly pillar blogs into GBP posts, Facebook /Instagram posts, and short-video scripts (3+ per platform weekly; 90%+ with no external links). (5) Backlink hygiene — maintain our Semrush backlink audit and weekly disavow workflow (SOP provided). (6) Email , Reddit & Quora — run value-first campaigns and community presence that support SEO and generate leads. (7) Reporting — update the KPI dashboard weekly; flag what’s moving and what isn’t. Schema markup, all website changes, review-request sending, and short-video production are handled by our webmaster and client-service team — you coordinate with them and write the video scripts; you don’t do those tasks yourself. Every project has a goal. Every goal has a number. Every number gets reviewed. Your Background (1) 3+ years of real, hands-on digital marketing experience with meaningful local SEO work (coursework alone won’t cut it). (2) Working proficiency in Semrush or Ahrefs — shortlisted candidates walk us through a real campaign they ran, live on a screen-share. (3) Hands-on Google Business Profile management. (4) A track record of setting goals, measuring results, and hitting targets. (5) Strong writing — short, clear, persuasive English. (6) Comfort with GA4, email platforms, and SEO software. (7) A 4-year Bachelor’s degree. (8) Honesty about what you know and what you still need to learn. Nice to have: Webflow, schema/JSON-LD, basic graphic/video familiarity. To show us you read this far: include the word “deionized” in the first line of your application. How We Work (this is the deal) (1) Daily async check-in (15 lines: what shipped yesterday, what ships today, blockers). We do not use surveillance or screen-monitoring software. We manage by visible output, not watched hours — your work must be visible: links earned, posts published, scans run, dashboard updated. (2) Weekly 1-hour Zoom with the founder to review the KPI dashboard. (3) Schedule: a full-time engagement (about 40 hours/week of focused work) with at least 3–4 hours overlapping US Central mornings as a communication window. (4) Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet plus a backup for internet and power. This is a stay-in-place role — not a work-while-traveling role; nomad setups don’t deliver the reliability this position needs. (5) Exclusivity: this is a full-time commitment — you won’t take on other clients while engaged with us. (6) Company tools provided under a company email we set up for you (Semrush, AI writing tools, and the rest). You never use personal accounts for company work. Growth Path & Pay This role has a clear growth ladder. As your measured results grow, your pay grows. Level 1 (Intermediate) — $8/hour-equivalent Level 2 (Intermediate plus) — $9/hour-equivalent Level 3 (Advanced Specialist) — $11/hour-equivalent Level 4 (Master Marketer) — $13/hour-equivalent Level 5 (Authority Expert) — $15/hour-equivalent Because this role requires proven experience, qualified hires enter at Level 2–3 (a fixed monthly salary of roughly $1,280–$1,700) based on demonstrated skills. We pay a fixed monthly salary for the role and your availability window — not an hourly timesheet. From there we move people up based on measured results, not tenure. A modest quarterly bonus is tied to campaign outcomes (map visibility, lead volume); your base never depends on outcomes outside your control. Benefits (1) Company-paid AI tools built into everything we do (2) Honest, ethical managers — real support including from the company President (3) A documented training/onboarding program (you ramp in weeks, not months) (4) A clear path to higher pay and more responsibility 13th-month pay (5) 6 paid US National Holidays (6) 5 paid personal days in Year 1; 10 from Year 2 Our Culture & Values (1) Direct, honest, empathetic communication (2) Always learning — optimize, measure, learn (3) Data-driven, not ego-driven (4) Team connection — no one left isolated (5) Integrity, every time How We Hire This role matters to us, so we take hiring seriously: (1) A short survey. (2) A small work sample. (3) A video interview with a live screen-share of a Semrush/Ahrefs campaign you personally ran. (4) A Zoom interview with the founder. (5) A paid 4-week trial at full salary, with real deliverables and clear, written acceptance criteria agreed before you start. We may run this trial with more than one candidate at the same time — if so, we’ll tell you openly, and everyone is paid in full. Pass the trial ? permanent, long-term role. We’re looking for one person to grow with for years — not a contractor for a month. How to Apply (1) A proposal starting with “deionized” (2) 3 reasons why you are a good fit. (3) Your availability in US Central hours and your weekly rate. If you’ve read this far and you’re the disciplined, tool-proficient executor we’re describing, we want to hear from you.

We're a U.S.-based technology company building local AI and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems for medical clinics and law firms. As we deploy AI systems that access sensitive patient records and confidential legal files, we need a sharp, self-driven Cybersecurity & Compliance Engineer to own security and compliance across our client environments. This is a high-trust, senior role where your work directly enables AI systems to operate safely and legally inside some of the most sensitive data environments that exist. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Assess and harden the IT environments of our medical clinic and law firm clients (endpoints, networks, file systems, cloud storage) - Design and implement secure remote access (VPN, MFA, IAM, network segmentation) so our AI engineers can safely work with client data - Ensure medical clinic clients are fully HIPAA-compliant — risk assessments, Security Rule safeguards, policies, i ---------- response, and BAAs with AI vendors - Build practical security policies and SOPs for law firm clients around client confidentiality, secure file handling, and least-privilege access - Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting so that access to sensitive data — especially by AI systems — is always traceable and auditable - Work closely with our AI engineering team to make sure new deployments don't introduce compliance or security gaps YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE - 3+ years in cybersecurity, IT security, or systems engineering - Real-world experience with HIPAA or U.S. healthcare / healthcare BPO environments - Experience securing environments where medical, legal, or financial data must be tightly controlled - Strong hands-on skills: VPNs, firewalls, MFA, endpoint encryption, IAM, and logging/monitoring - Ability to translate compliance frameworks into practical technical controls - Great written English — you'll be writing policies and SOPs for doctors and lawyers, not just engineers - Self-directed and comfortable working remotely with a U.S. tech team BONUS POINTS FOR - Experience with law firm environments or legal case-management systems - Experience securing AI/ML systems or data pipelines that touch sensitive data - Certifications such as Security+, CISSP, HCISPP, or formal HIPAA compliance training WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR TIME - 100% remote, long-term, stable position with a growing U.S. AI technology company - You will be THE security and compliance person — high visibility, real ownership, real impact - Direct collaboration with AI engineers and company leadership - Genuinely interesting work — AI, medical records, legal tech, and compliance all intersecting in one role - Salary: $2,500 to $3,200 USD per month depending on experience and certifications — paid in USD HOW TO APPLY Please include all three of the following or your application will not be reviewed: 1. Describe one HIPAA or healthcare security project you worked on — what was your role and what did you personally implement? 2. Describe one project where you secured sensitive data for a professional services environment (legal, medical, finance, etc.) 3. In 5 to 10 bullet points, outline how you would securely allow remote AI engineers to access patient files at a medical clinic while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

We ara an international high fashion brand active in wholesale (B2B), retail, direct-to-consumer e-commerce (Shopify), affiliate marketing, and product development with teams across Europe and Asia. We are looking for a highly proactive and organized Executive Assistant who will work directly with the Founder & CEO. This is not a traditional admin role. We need someone who can build and maintain a live Notion operating system for the entire business, proactively follow up on affiliates and B2B sales, and keep all operations perfectly organized in a fast-growing international company. Key Responsibilities: •  Design, build, and keep live a comprehensive Notion system (dashboards, project timelines, KPI trackers, supplier databases, action plans, etc.) that becomes the single source of truth for the company. •  Proactively manage and follow up on affiliate and ambassador programs — performance tracking, partner communication, optimization, and reporting. •  Support and actively follow up on B2B/wholesale sales activities: lead tracking, client communication, order status, and pipeline management. •  Coordinate collection development, production timelines, and logistics with teams in Europe and Asia. •  Support D2C e-commerce operations and Shopify-related projects. •  Track key financial and operational KPIs and prepare clear reports and action plans for the Founder. •  Coordinate marketing activities, photoshoots, and product launches. •  Manage suppliers, logistics, and deadlines. •  Take full ownership of projects and ensure nothing falls through the cracks. title: Hospice Coding Specialist (Remote – Philippines)
description: About EZ Scribe LLC EZ Scribe LLC provides clinical documentation, coding, and compliance support exclusively to U.S.-based hospice organizations. Our mission is to help hospice providers maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation while meeting Medicare, CMS, and regulatory requirements. We are expanding our hospice coding division and are seeking an experienced Hospice Coding Specialist who can independently review, code, and support hospice documentation across multiple client organizations and electronic medical record (EMR) systems. This position is designed for highly skilled professionals who require minimal supervision and can confidently manage coding responsibilities while maintaining compliance with Medicare hospice regulations. Position Overview: We are hiring a seasoned Hospice Coding Specialist to work remotely from the Philippines. The primary responsibility is reviewing hospice documentation and assigning accurate ICD-10 codes that support hospice eligibility, reimbursement, and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with U.S. Medicare-certified hospice providers, understands hospice clinical documentation requirements, and can adapt quickly to multiple EMR platforms and organizational workflows. Only applicants with proven hospice coding experience supporting U.S. hospice providers will be considered. Key Responsibilities: Hospice ICD-10 Coding -Review hospice admission, recertification, transfer, revocation, discharge, and death records. -Assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes supporting terminal prognosis and related conditions. -Ensure coding accurately reflects the patient's terminal illness, comorbidities, and symptom burden. -Maintain compliance with Medicare hospice regulations, CMS guidelines, and coding standards. Hospice Eligibility & Documentation Review: -Review physician certifications, face-to-face encounter documentation, hospice election statements, and supporting clinical records. -Verify documentation supports hospice eligibility and terminal prognosis requirements. -Identify missing, conflicting, or insufficient documentation that could increase audit or denial risk. -Provide clear and concise feedback to clinicians and hospice staff regarding documentation deficiencies. Compliance & Regulatory Support: -Stay current on Medicare hospice regulations, CMS guidance, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and hospice Conditions of Participation. -Assist hospice providers in maintaining documentation that is audit-ready and compliant. -Support preparation for ADRs, TPE reviews, UPIC audits, and other regulatory reviews when needed. Quality Assurance Support: -Perform chart audits and documentation reviews as needed. -Review nursing, social work, chaplain, hospice aide, volunteer, and interdisciplinary documentation for completeness and compliance. -Ensure plans of care, interdisciplinary group (IDG) documentation, visit notes, and recertification records support the patient's hospice status and ongoing eligibility. -Identify trends and opportunities for documentation improvement. Multi-Organization Support: -Work independently across multiple hospice organizations simultaneously. -Adapt to different documentation standards, workflows, and operational requirements. -Maintain productivity while managing varying client expectations and deadlines. -Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously with minimal oversight. EMR & System Proficiency: -Navigate and work efficiently within multiple hospice EMR systems. -Learn new charting platforms quickly with minimal training. -Maintain organization and accuracy while switching between client environments. Collaboration: -Communicate effectively with hospice clinicians, administrators, quality assurance personnel, compliance teams, and physicians. -Participate in case discussions and coding reviews as needed. -Provide education and coding guidance when documentation clarification is required. Qualifications: -Required Experience -Minimum 3 years of direct hospice coding experience supporting U.S. Medicare-certified hospice providers. -Demonstrated experience independently coding hospice charts and reviewing documentation for compliance. -Experience supporting multiple hospice organizations and managing competing priorities. -Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Certifications: One or more of the following certifications is required or strongly preferred: -HCS-H -HCS-D -CPC -CCS -BCHH-C Other recognized hospice or coding certifications Hospice Expertise: -Advanced understanding of Medicare hospice regulations and Conditions of Participation. -Strong knowledge of hospice eligibility requirements, terminal diagnosis selection, and supporting documentation requirements. -Ability to identify documentation deficiencies that may affect reimbursement, compliance, or audit outcomes. -Familiarity with LCD guidelines, hospice audit risk areas, and documentation standards. -Strong understanding of physician certifications, face-to-face requirements, recertifications, and hospice election documentation. Clinical Background: -Registered Nurse (RN) -Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) -Hospice clinician with coding experience -Graduate of an accredited medical coding program with significant hospice experience Technical Skills: -Experience working within multiple hospice EMR systems. -Familiarity with platforms such as MatrixCare, Netsmart, WellSky Hospice, Axxess Hospice, Suncoast, HospiceWorks, or similar hospice-specific systems. -Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and secure cloud-based file sharing. Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to write clear coding rationale, documentation feedback, audit findings, and compliance notes. Work Environment: -Fully remote position. -Reliable high-speed internet connection required. -Secure and HIPAA-compliant workspace required. -Ability to work during U.S. business hours. Compliance Requirements: -Must sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). -Must comply with HIPAA privacy and security requirements. -Must maintain strict confidentiality of all protected health information. Compensation & Benefits: -Competitive hourly compensation based on experience, certifications, and hospice expertise. -Long-term remote opportunity. -Flexible scheduling options. -Exposure to multiple hospice organizations and clinical environments. -Opportunity for advancement into senior coding, auditing, and compliance roles. How to Apply,  Please submit: -Resume/CV -Proof of coding certification(s) -Cover letter detailing your hospice coding experience In your application, please include: -The U.S. hospice organizations or hospice projects you have supported. -Your years of hospice coding experience. -Hospice EMR systems you have worked within. -Examples of how you have independently managed coding responsibilities across multiple hospice organizations. -Experience supporting hospice compliance, audits, documentation improvement, or quality assurance initiatives. Applications from candidates without direct U.S. hospice coding experience will not be considered.

Required Expertise: D2C E-commerce: You understand the psychology of a female consumer and what makes them click in a crowded feed. Layout & Typography: You have a "less is more" approach to design—clean, modern, and readable on mobile devices. How to Apply: Share a link to your portfolio showcasing D2C static ads.

description: We are looking for a talented, detail-oriented Short-Form Video Editor to join our content creation team. You will be responsible for taking raw video footage and turning it into highly engaging vertical videos (45 seconds to 1:30 long) for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Our Content Roadmap: We are going to start exclusively with a clean, high-retention "yap video" style. The editing for this phase needs to be simple but highly engaging, relying on frequent framing adjustments rather than flashy graphics. However, as our channel grows, this role *will eventually evolve* to include high-quality B-roll style videos with voiceovers and captions, as well as simple, comedic-style content. We want someone who can grow into those styles with us. This is a video by video basis, but looking for a long term partnership that could turn into a part-time thing! Content Workflow & Delivery (Crucial Requirement) Our production system relies on hook testing. For every video concept I film moving forward: I will record 1 Body and 3 Different Hooks all in one raw file. You will need to edit 3 final video versions per concept (the body stays the same, only the opening hook changes). Delivery Requirement: For each version, you must deliver two exports: 1. One version **WITH** burned-in captions/on-screen text. 2. One version **WITHOUT** captions/text (just the clean, cropped video with audio). Total delivery per standard concept = 6 final video files. Key Responsibilities Dynamic Framing:Frequently crop in and out every few seconds to match the pacing of the speech, emphasize key phrases, and keep the visual layout dynamic. Cut Dead Space: Edit down talking-head footage to ensure a fast-paced, high-retention flow (remove stutters, pauses, and breaths). Hook Variations: Cleanly splice the different hooks onto the front of the same video body to create distinct assets. Clean File Management: Export and organize both captioned and non-captioned versions clearly in Google Drive. Requirements * Strong proficiency in English (both written and spoken) to seamlessly match hooks to the body. * High attention to detail and ability to handle multiple file exports efficiently. * A reliable, high-speed internet connection. * Experience editing vertical short-form content with a proven portfolio (experience with B-roll editing and comedic timing is a huge plus for the future!). ?? title: Youtube Video Editor HIGH QUALITY
description: # YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content) ## Position Type Part-Time / Ongoing Contractor --- ## About This Role We have an existing editor and are building a reliable, long-term team. This is not a desperate replacement gig — we're looking for someone who can grow with the channel, deliver consistently, and become a trusted part of our production workflow. --- ## Compensation Per-package pricing (no video = no pay): **Starting Rate (Trial + First Month):** - $50 per video package - Includes: - 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime) - 5–7 short-form vertical clips - 1 custom thumbnail **Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):** - $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries - Based on quality, reliability, and communication **Additional standalone shorts:** - $5 each - $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required **Payment Schedule:** - Every 2 weeks - Only for packages actually delivered and approved --- ## About The Channel This channel focuses on: - mortgages - real estate - financial education - wealth-building concepts The editing style should feel: - modern - clean - high-retention - professional - trustworthy The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing. We want viewers to feel: *"Clear, calm, confident guidance."* Style references: - Graham Stephan - Ali Abdaal - Mark Tilbury --- ## What You'll Be Editing You will primarily edit: - talking-head educational videos - financial storytelling content - mortgage strategy content - real-world buyer scenarios Typical long-form videos: - 5–10 minutes You will also create: - YouTube Shorts - Instagram Reels - TikTok clips - LinkedIn vertical clips --- ## Responsibilities ### Long-Form Editing You will: - remove mistakes, pauses, filler words - tighten pacing for retention - add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts - add clean captions and text emphasis - add occasional b-roll and overlays - integrate provided infographics and visuals - use light background music and subtle sound design - maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style ### Short-Form Content From each long-form video: - identify strong hook ---------- nts - create 5–7 vertical clips - format properly for 9:16 platforms - add captions and pacing optimized for retention - create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video **IMPORTANT:** Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries. ### Thumbnails You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video: - clean, modern design - clear focal point - readable text at small sizes - consistent with channel branding ### Visual / Graphics Work You may occasionally: - add simple motion graphics - integrate charts and infographics - use stock footage selectively - organize visuals to improve understanding Most visuals and scripts will be provided. --- ## Editing Style Requirements We are looking for editors who understand: - pacing - storytelling rhythm - educational retention - visual clarity - modern YouTube editing This is NOT ---------- editing. We prefer: - clean cinematic pacing - calm confidence - modern documentary feel - clarity over flashy effects --- ## NON-NEGOTIABLES ### Accuracy Matters This is financial and mortgage content. All: - text - numbers - names - graphics - statistics MUST match the spoken audio exactly. Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit. ### Communication We value: - responsiveness - reliability - professionalism - clear communication - consistency If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role. ### Turnaround Expectations Typical turnaround: - 24–48 hours for long-form edit - Revisions handled quickly --- ## Workflow Typical workflow: 1. Long-form video delivered first 2. Revisions completed 3. Shorts created from approved final video 4. Thumbnail finalized We are building: - templates - SOPs - editing systems - reusable assets Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow. --- ## Included Resources You will usually receive: - raw footage - script - topic context - visual references - infographic assets - branding direction --- ## Required Skills - YouTube editing - Short-form editing - CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro - Understanding of pacing and retention - Good English comprehension - Ability to follow detailed instructions - Basic thumbnail design Bonus: - motion graphics - advanced thumbnail design - educational content editing - storytelling instincts --- ## Important Notes We are looking for: - long-term relationship - reliability - someone who grows with the channel This role may scale to: - multiple videos per week - additional responsibilities - increased compensation over time based on consistency and quality --- ## Application Requirements Please include: 1. 2–3 YouTube videos you edited 2. 2–3 short-form videos you edited 3. 1–2 thumbnail examples 4. Your editing software 5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video 6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail) 7. Your internet speed 8. Your ---------- or WhatsApp **IMPORTANT:** Start your application message with the word: **"EVEREST"** I'll reply with a youtube video to see if your current skills can match this level of quality. --- ## Auto-Disqualifiers We will not consider applicants who: - Don't include the word "EVEREST" at the start of their message - Don't include portfolio examples - Quote rates wildly outside our range without explanation - Take more than 48 hours to respond during the application process --- ## Trial Process Selected editors will complete a paid trial edit. The trial allows both sides to: - test workflow - test communication - test editing style fit - determine long-term compatibility We value long-term consistency over short-term speed.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist (Stripe Billing + QuickBooks) for US Marketing Agency
job_title: Accounts Receivable Specialist (Stripe Billing + QuickBooks) for US Marketing Agency
description: Own the billing and collections for a US marketing agency. If you're an experienced AR or bookkeeping professional who likes being the person everyone trusts with the money, this is your seat. ABOUT US RoofIgnite is a US-focused marketing agency. We run Meta advertising for roofing contractors doing $2.5M or more per year, and we're part of the ---------- portfolio. We're a small, tight remote team, and almost all of our team is based in the Philippines, so you'll be in good company. Our clients pay us a monthly retainer. The work is good and the clients stay. The one gap we have is on our own books: billing goes out late because nobody on the team has the time to run it on a strict schedule. That delay costs us real money every month. We want one reliable person to take full ownership of it so it never slips again. THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE You make sure every client is billed correctly and on time, you chase down anything that's late or failed, and you keep our books clean in QuickBooks. This is a high-trust role. You will have direct control over the company's incoming cash, working closely with the two owners. We're looking for someone who treats accuracy and follow-through as a point of pride. WHAT YOUR WEEK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE Most of your time, the core of the job: Billing in Stripe. When the team tells you a client is ready to be charged, you create and send the charge in Stripe right away. This is manual and on purpose, we don't auto-bill, because we confirm with each client first. It's roughly 60 to 70 charges a month, usually $3,500 to $5,000 each, some larger. You own the billing calendar so nothing is ever late. Collections. When a payment fails or a client goes quiet, you run the follow-up. You'll work from a dedicated ---------- address and you'll email and call US clients directly. The escalation path is clear: friendly reminder, firm follow-up, phone call, flag to leadership if a service pause is needed, then final notice. Often a failed payment just needs someone to get the client on the phone and sort out a new card. That someone is you. Recovering overdue accounts. Some accounts go past due (we count that as a missed billing cycle, or 14 or more days late with no reply). You take those on and recover them. Reporting. You keep the owners updated on what's late, what's at risk, and what you've recovered, so we always know where our cash stands. A smaller, steady part of the job: QuickBooks bookkeeping. You categorize expenses in QuickBooks. The rules and SOPs already exist and most transactions sort themselves automatically. You handle the ones that don't (roughly 500 to 600 a month) and send anything unusual for approval. You're running the system we built, not building it. Data quality checks. You audit two of our Google Sheets (a B2B sales tracker and a client check-in sheet) for missing or incomplete information, then track down the correct data and fill the gaps. Example: a lead marked "set and confirmed" while the "setter qualified" field is blank. You catch it and fix it. Keeping an eye on the numbers. You watch our key sales and marketing figures and flag anything that looks off. Occasionally: Helping onboard new hires in BambooHR, as needed. This is light and infrequent. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR This role only works for a specific kind of person, so please read honestly. You need two strengths that don't always come together: real precision with numbers, and the confidence to chase money without backing down. Plenty of people have one. The careful ones can be too soft to push a late payer. The pushy ones miss the small errors that make an invoice wrong. We need both in the same person. You should have: - 2 or more years in accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or collections (more is welcome). - Real, hands-on Stripe and QuickBooks experience. Not "I've seen it," but "I've run it." - Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll represent us to US clients by email and phone, so both matter. - A steady, organized approach to deadlines. You're the kind of person who keeps a list and works it. Nice to have (not required): GoHighLevel, ClickUp, BambooHR, and strong Google Sheets skills. HOURS AND PAY Full-time, EST business hours. That's a night shift in the Philippines, roughly 9pm to 6am your time. Where you live doesn't matter as long as you work those hours reliably. Base pay is $1,500 to $1,700 USD per month depending on experience. On top of that, you earn performance bonuses tied to things like overdue accounts recovered, on-time collection, and clean, accurate data. Do the job well and you earn more. This is an immediate hire. We want to bring someone on as soon as we find the right fit. BEFORE YOU APPLY: COMPLETE THE BILLING ACCURACY CHECK Every applicant must complete this short billing accuracy check. It's a real sample of the work: ---------- Completing it is required, not optional. To prove you read this whole post, start your application with the word LEDGER. Any application that skips the test, skips the LEDGER keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a firm requirement. HOW TO APPLY Along with starting your message with LEDGER, send a recording. This is required, not optional. Use Loom video or any application/software that shares your face and screen at the same time. In your recording, cover: 1. Your name and where you're based. 2. Your accounts receivable, billing, and collections experience. 3. The tools you've actually used hands-on. 4. Your answers to the three questions inside the billing accuracy check: which rows have an incorrect Total Charged and the correct amount for each, what went wrong in each case (a fee added that shouldn't be there, a fee missing, or the ad spend math), and what you'd check before sending the invoice. Only applicants who complete the check and send a recording will be considered for an interview. No recording, no interview. We also use the recording to hear your spoken English and get a feel for your personality, since this role talks to clients. So speak clearly and naturally, and just be yourself.

title: Brand Marketing Coordinator
description: # Brand Marketing Coordinator **Karst — North Charleston, SC** Karst is a strategic merch and creative agency. We help lifestyle and growth-stage brands extend who they are into the physical world — intentionally, at scale, never the disposable junk that ends up in a drawer. We've been doing it since 1996. Here's the honest version of why this role exists: Our founder has the marketing strategy. The ideas, the calendar, the direction — all there. What's missing is the person who takes it and *makes it real*. Designs it, builds it, posts it, ships it. That's you. This isn't a brief-and-wait role. You'll own marketing execution end to end, so the strategy actually leaves the building instead of dying in a doc. ## What you'll own - **Internal marketing.** You turn strategy and rough ideas into finished, on-brand work. - **Social content.** We hand you a bucket of ideas and raw material — you finesse it, design it, schedule it, and actually hit publish. - **HubSpot.** Email , landing pages, workflows, keeping the CRM working for us instead of the other way around. - **WordPress.** Updates, campaign hubs, landing pages, keeping the site sharp. - **Quality control** on any overflow design we send to contractors — so the founder doesn't have to babysit it. ## Who you are - You've spent **at least 3 years doing marketing execution** — not studying it, not "assisting with" it. Designing, building, posting, owning it. - You can design *and* organize. Rare combo. That's the whole point of this seat. - **HubSpot:** you've built email s, workflows, and landing pages in it — not just hit "send" on a campaign someone else set up. - **WordPress:** you've built and edited pages, not only written blog posts. - You're sharp in Canva and ideally Adobe, and you have a portfolio that proves it. - You'd rather own a thing than wait for instructions. You won't get daily art direction here. - You have taste, you sweat the details, and you'll tell us when something's off-brand or not good enough yet. Honestly? I care less about the exact year count than what you can show me. But green won't cut it for this seat — you'll be running things, not learning them on our dime. ## This isn't your seat if - You need a detailed brief and a sign-off before every task. - "Marketing" to you means scheduling posts someone else designed. - You're juggling five other clients and this would be gig number six. - You don't have work to show. ## What the first 90 days look like - The backlog of strategized-but-never-posted content is live. - Social is consistent — and it looks like us. - The founder is out of the execution weeds and back in the strategy seat where she belongs. ## Logistics - **Type:** Full-time, remote - **Hours:** Some daily overlap with US Eastern time (we'll work out specifics) ## To apply Read this whole post first. Then: - Send your **portfolio link.** No link, no read. We want social, email , and web work you actually made. - Pick one piece you took from idea to live, and tell us in a few sentences what you'd change about it now. We're reading how you think, not just what you made. - Start your message with the word **"Unsupervised"** so we know you made it to the bottom. Applications that skip these get deleted. Nothing personal — it's just the first test.

title: Creative Strategist (Direct Response, DTC Health)
description: Most creative roles are boring. You make one ad, it runs for three months, and you never find out if it worked. This is the opposite of that. We're a direct-to-consumer health brand running cold paid traffic on Meta. We test relentlessly, we read the data daily, and we know within days whether a concept is a winner or a loser. If you're the kind of person who gets a little obsessed with figuring out why one ad crushes and another flops, keep reading. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives in the ad account. Someone who finds what's winning and why, then turns that insight into a steady pipeline of new concepts. You'll have real ownership over the creative that drives this brand's growth, and you'll see the results of your work in real numbers, fast. This is NOT a media buying role. We handle media buying in-house, so you never have to touch a budget or a bid. Your job is the part most people are too lazy to do well: get the big idea, study what's converting and what's dying, research the market and the customer until you understand them better than they understand themselves, and produce winning concepts on a consistent basis. What you'll own: Analyzing ad performance data (thumbstop, hold rate, CTR, CPA) to spot what's working and what isn't, and why Researching our market, competitors, and customer to develop fresh angles Writing video ad scripts that hook and hold attention Creating image/static ad concepts (with copy attached) Writing landing page and advertorial copy (a strong plus, tested separately) Implementing copy directly into pages where possible (a bonus, not required) Apply here: ---------- Who you'll work with: You'll work directly with the founder, who handles strategy and media buying, plus a video editor and a VA team who help execute what you create. You won't be stuck doing everything yourself. You'll be the creative engine, and you'll have people to help you ship. Our stack: Meta Ads, Funnelish, Klaviyo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT/Claude, and AI image tools. Fluency with AI creative tools is essential. We move fast because we let AI do the heavy lifting on production, which frees you to focus on the thinking. How we work: "Work hard, play hard." We move fast, test constantly, and care about results over activity. There's no busywork here and no one watching the clock. There's just the work, the data, and the next winning idea. If you think in hooks, angles, mechanisms, and iteration loops, and you get a little thrill reading a retention graph, you'll fit right in. This role grows with you. Prove you can produce winners, and there's room to take on more ownership, more responsibility, and more pay over time. If that sounds like you, the next step is simple. Fill out the application form below. It's a little different from most applications, which is the point. We want to see how you think. Apply here: ----------

title: Operations Manager - Ecommerce
description: Hi, I'm Wiets, the founder of TechToast Academy. We're 6 months old and sell an Arduino-compatible electronics kit for kids. It's a $199 hardware kit plus a 25-week build-along curriculum on our own learning portal, with lifetime free tech support from real engineering grads. We're doing around $200K/month, almost all fro ---------- ta ads, and we're on track to 10x in the next 6 months. Here's what and why I'm hiring: I'm a technical, creative founder. I'm great at setting direction and I love the creative and product  development side, but I'm not great at the people side, making sure that everyone's productive, setting deadlines, holding people to KPI's, and always knowing who is working on what. I don't like checking in on people constantly, and I don't always know how to get the best out of someone or how to motivate them properly. That gap is the single biggest thing slowing us down, and it's the job I'm hiring for. What the team looks like at the ---------- nt: 1. 2 virtual assistants who run tech support and customer support over email (one day shift, one night shift. They're genuinely great, almost no backlog ever). They also do some Arduino circuit drawings for our instruction manuals. 2. 1 product developer working on our next kit (a line-following robot). I suspect he could move faster but I don't have the energy or the know-how to manage him on it. I tried making a timeline for him but I'm honestly a bit lost on how to check in with him and make sure he is as productive and motivated as he can be. I also want to give him the right structure so that he does not get lost and always knows what to do. 3. 1 editor for our meta ads. 4.  A creative strategist coming on board. I'll stay close to this person myself, that's the part I enjoy and currently do myself. I'll still want him under your wing, to make sure he stays motivated and has good structure. This is the biggest lever in our 10x. Our systems: At the ---------- nt everyone reports to me through ---------- . We use Shopify for the store backend. We have no project management tool and I track nothing, I just do video meetings every now and then and discuss what they're busy with now over chat during the week. I feel like this can be improved a lot. What I want you to take ownership of: 1. Building the machine. Setting up a proper system (project management tool, SOPs, KPIs) so that anytime I log in I can see who's doing what, what's been done, what's next for each person, and what they achieved last week or last month or whatever. I want to know I'm getting my money's worth from everyone and we're moving in the right direction. 2. Keeping everyone productive and accountable without me chasing anyone. The team comes to you for deadlines, priorities and decisions. I'll tell you what I want; you turn it into something that lands well with the team. (I'm too much of a nice guy to create or enforce a KPI, I need you to be the structure.) 3. Managing the product development timeline so we can launch products better and faster. I give the general direction ("here's the product, here's what it should do"); you figure out how to make it happen with the people we have, or tell me who we need to hire. 4. Helping me hire and scale through the 10x. Soon I'll need a curriculum writer for the new product, someone to handle photography for the circuits, an SEO person to get us organic traffic on Google (right now we're 100% Meta and I want to diversify), and probably someone to run a more junior creative-ops role under you. You'd help find and onboard these people. 5. Taking the creative-shoot logistics off my plate. We have a small content team in South Africa shooting professional family/kids footage for our ads, and setting up each shoot (venue, cast, coordination) has been a huge headache for me. I want someone to manage that end to end. You're probably a fit if: 1. You've run operations for a team through fast growth, not just kept a small team tidy or a large team compliant. 2. You've built SOPs, KPI tracking and accountability systems from scratch. 3. You can hold people accountable in a way that motivates them rather than annoys them. This is the part I care about most. 4. Ecommerce experience is a big plus. 5. You're comfortable hiring and managing other people as we scale. How to apply: I kinda want to hear what you can do for me before hearing what you have done for others. Instead of telling me about your past jobs, tell me about MY business. Based on everything I explained above (and feel free to look at techtoast.academy): 1. What's the first system you'd build in your first 30 days, and what would it actually look like? Be specific. 2. I think my product developer could be faster but I don't know how to manage or measure that. How would you handle it? 3. We're all on ---------- with zero tracking. What would you set up so I can log in and instantly see who's doing what, what's done, and what each person achieved last week? One more thing: just write it out in normal text, no need for obviously-AI generated highly formatted responses.

title: UAT Tester (Contract) - No Graveyard Shift
description: # UAT Tester (Contract), Zelix Labs **Engagement:** Contract / freelance **Level:** Mid-level **Location:** Remote (Singapore hours, SGT, with overlap expected) **Reports to:** Product lead / Project owner ## About Zelix Labs Zelix Labs builds conversational AI and automation for businesses: WhatsApp flows, AI agents, client portals, booking and intake systems, and the web layers around them. These go live in front of real clients and their customers, so the last check before launch matters as much as the build. ## The role We are hiring a mid-level UAT tester on contract to be that last check. You will run user acceptance testing across our web and automation projects: confirming features do what the brief said, catching the breaks before clients do, and writing them up so a developer can fix them without a back-and-forth. You think like the end user, not like the person who built it. ## What you will do - Read the brief or acceptance criteria, then turn them into clear, repeatable test cases. - Run UAT across web apps, forms, dashboards, WhatsApp flows, and automation sequences. - Test the full journey, not just the happy path: edge cases, bad input, broken links, mobile and desktop, different browsers. - Verify integrations end to end (form to CRM, webhook to automation, payment confirmation, message delivery). - Log defects clearly: steps to reproduce, expected vs actual, screenshots or recordings, severity. - Re-test fixes and confirm nothing else broke (regression). - Sign off on what is ready to ship, and be straight about what is not. - Keep a tidy test record so we have evidence of what was checked. ## What we are looking for - Two or more years in QA or UAT testing, ideally on web or SaaS products. - Strong eye for detail. You notice the thing everyone else scrolled past. - Able to write test cases and bug reports that a developer can act on without a call. - Comfortable testing across browsers, devices, and screen sizes. - Understands the difference between a bug, a missing requirement, and a design choice, and reports each correctly. - Methodical and organised. You finish the checklist. - Clear written English. You will work async, so your write-ups have to stand on their own. ## Nice to have - Experience testing automation or chatbot flows (WhatsApp, ---------- , GoHighLevel, n8n, ---------- ). - Familiarity with a defect tracker (Asana, Jira, Notion, or similar). - Basic API testing (Postman or similar) to check integrations directly. - Some exposure to test automation tools, though this role is primarily manual UAT. ## How we work together You will get the build, the acceptance criteria, and access to a defect tracker. We treat a well-written bug report as a gift, not a complaint. We would rather you flag ten things and have two turn out fine than miss the one that reaches the client. Honest sign-off is the whole job; never wave something through to keep the peace. ## To apply Send a short note, your testing experience, and a sample bug report or test plan you have written (redacted is fine). Availability and rate expectations welcome up front.

description: We are hiring video editor(s) for a fast-growing DTC health brand. This is for someone who can create clean, high-retention, performance-focused video ads across short-form, UGC-style ads, Reels/TikTok content, VSL-style creatives, landing page videos, and other ecommerce creative formats. Experienced ecommerce/direct-response editors are highly preferred, but if you are a killer editor with strong taste, speed, and hunger, you should still apply. We can train the ecommerce/direct-response side if you already have strong editing fundamentals. What's in it for you: - Competitive pay based on skill, experience, and output. - Consistent long-term remote work. - We accept applicants worldwide. - Full-time Monday-Friday roles available. - Weekend coverage roles also available. - Clear direction, references, examples, and briefs, especially in the beginning. - Zero micromanagement if the work is high-quality and delivered on time. - Work with a fast-moving DTC team. - Opportunity to learn direct-response ecommerce creative. - Strong performers can grow into higher-paid roles like Senior Editor, Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead. This is not a dead-end editing role. The best editor on the team can grow into a Lead Editor role and eventually help manage other editors. More ownership means more opportunity. What you'll work on: - Short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta, and other paid/social platforms. - UGC-style video ads. - VSL-style creatives. - Product-focused videos. - Hook variations and cutdowns. - AI-assisted assets, B-roll, animations, graphics, and visual enhancements. - Ecommerce ad creatives built around pacing, clarity, retention, and storytelling. What we're looking for: - Strong video editing skills. - Strong sense of pacing, retention, captions, visual rhythm, and storytelling. - You understand TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, and modern social content. - You can follow direction closely and match the style/vibe of provided references. - You can work fast without making sloppy mistakes. - You have good English comprehension and understand the nuance/vibe of scripts. - You are comfortable using AI tools or willing to learn them fast. - You are reliable, responsive, and can hit deadlines. - You are coachable and hungry to improve. Big bonus points: - You have edited ecommerce, DTC, health, or performance-marketing videos before. - You understand direct-response creative. - You have worked with 7-9 figure brands before. - You have edited ads that performed well. - You can explain why a hook, cut, caption, or pacing choice worked. - You have experience with VSLs, YouTube editing, creator content, or high-retention long-form editing. - You want to grow into a Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead role. Important: We do not care about flashy transitions just for the sake of looking fancy. We care about edits that make people stop scrolling, keep watching, understand the message, trust the product, and take action. Async screening: We do not do intro calls for the first screen. You will write a short breakdown in this form. Bonus points if you also include a voice-note link. Double bonus points if you include a short video walkthrough link. How to apply: Fill out the form below. Apply here: tally.so/r/gDzE1J Include your best work, any ecommerce/direct-response/ad examples if you have them, a short written breakdown of why an edit/ad worked, optional voice/video breakdown links, what types of videos you are strongest at, your tools/software, your availability, and why you are the best person for this role. At the end of the form, write LFG so we know you actually read this.

title: AI Automation Specialist

Briefly: a workflow that broke in production and how you debugged it. 6. Your availability and how you currently use AI tools (including Claude Code, if you’ve used it).

title: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)

I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - a fast-growing home and dining brand redefining modern tableware and lifestyle across the US. We are now expanding globally, and only just getting started. Our vision is simple - when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware, we want them to think of JazzUpCo. Your job is to make sure every customer experience is a smooth one - and that our backend operations stay organized as we grow. _____________________________________________________________ What You’ll Do: - Respond to customer inquiries via email , social, and chat platforms (we use Gorgias) - Resolve issues with care and empathy, ensuring customers feel heard and helped - Coordinate with warehouse and logistics partners to ensure smooth order fulfillment and tracking - Monitor reviews, identify trends in feedback, and suggest improvements to our systems - Support daily operations tasks - tracking returns, updating records, and keeping things organized - Collaborate with the team to improve our SOPs and backend workflows - Be the voice of the customer - bringing feedback to the team to help us improve You don’t need to have all the answers - we’ll teach you the tools and systems. What we care about is your attitude: someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute ideas along the way. _____________________________________________________________ Who We’re Looking For: - Empathetic & Patient Communicator: You write and speak with warmth and clarity, and genuinely care about helping people. - Reliable & Detail-Oriented: You keep things organized, catch the little things, and follow through consistently. - Tech-Savvy & Process-Oriented: You enjoy systems, tools (Notion, Slack, Gorgias etc.), and figuring things out when things aren’t working. - Eager to Grow: This is a full-time employee role - not a freelance or part-time gig. We’re looking for someone fully committed to growing with us long-term. You won’t be juggling other jobs. Instead, you’ll be part of the team, learning across different areas of the business, gaining new skills, and building something meaningful together. - Team Player: You work well with others, ask good questions, and love contributing to a positive team vibe. _____________________________________________________________ Why Work With Us: - 100% remote, full-time role with paid time off and other benefits - Learn directly from the founder and team lead with hands-on mentorship - Join a high-growth brand where your work actually matters - no layers, no red tape - Be part of a team that values excellence, growth, and fulfillment _____________________________________________________________ Our Culture We believe culture fit is key. Skills can be trained, but the right mindset, attitude, and shared values are what make the magic happen here. Our culture is built around 3 pillars: E — Excel If we’re going to do something, we do it with care and pride. F — Fulfilment We find meaning in the work we do - and how we do it. G — Growth We believe everything can be learned. And we’re committed to growing together, day by day. _____________________________________________________________ The Journey Ahead: Step 1: Apply - Tell us about yourself through the application form. (Link: ---------- ) Step 2: Interview - If shortlisted, we’ll get to know you and see if it’s a good fit for both sides. Step 3: Trial Task - A short task to see how you approach real situations. Step 4: Offer & Onboarding - If it’s a match, we’ll kick off with a 60-day onboarding and probation period to get you trained up and integrated into the team. At the end of this onboarding and probation phase, if we’re aligned and excited to move forward together, your position will be confirmed as a full-time tea ---------- mber - with continued mentorship, support, and a clear path for growth ahead. _____________________________________________________________ Ready to be part of something exciting? Apply now - we can’t wait to meet you!

title: Channel Partner Manager
description: We are looking for a results-driven, high-energy Channel Partner Manager based in the Philippines to re-ignite and scale our global Channel Partnership Programme. This is a full time, remote role. Our partnership model is unique and highly attractive: we offer a "Zero Sales Burden" proposition. Your partners do not need to learn complex software demonstrations or close technical deals; their sole focus is identifying opportunities, introducing our platform, and registering qualified leads. Once a lead is registered, our internal sales team takes over to run the demos and close the revenue, while the partner reaps the rewards. Your mission is to find the right partners, onboard them quickly, and keep them highly engaged so they consistently feed our sales pipeline with high-quality opportunities. Key Responsibilities Re-ignite & Scale: Audit our existing partner network, re-engage dormant relationships, and design a structured outreach strategy to recruit new high-potential channel partners. Partner Enablement & Activation: Equip partners with the simple tools, messaging, and co-marketing materials they need to easily identify leads within their existing networks. Pipeline & Lead Governance: Actively manage the partner lead registration portal. Review incoming leads to ensure quality, prevent market conflicts, and smoothly hand them off to our internal account executives. Relationship Management: Serve as the primary, day-to-day point of contact for partners. Run regular check-ins to keep our SaaS top-of-mind and help them overcome any roadblocks. Performance Tracking: Monitor partner-driven pipeline metrics (lead volume, conversion rates, and partner activity levels) and report directly to leadership on programme health. Required Qualifications & Experience SaaS Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience specifically managing or scaling a Channel Partnership / Reseller / Referral Programme for a B2B SaaS company. Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in driving predictable, high-volume lead registration or indirect revenue growth through third-party partners. Excellent Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to confidently pitch, negotiate, and build trust with business owners and channel executives globally. Process & Tool Savvy: Comfortable managing partner portals, CRMs (e.g., HubSpot/Salesforce), and leveraging automation tools to track lead attribution accurately. Self-Starter Mindset: Experience working remotely for international companies. You are highly organized, comfortable with ambiguity, and capable of executing a partnership strategy with minimal day-to-day supervision.

title: A?PLAYER DM SETTER / APPOINTMENT SETTER (NOT A VA, SALES HUNTER ONLY)
job_title: A?PLAYER DM SETTER / APPOINTMENT SETTER (NOT A VA, SALES HUNTER ONLY)
description: Read this carefully. If you’re just looking for “any VA job” or fixed hourly pay, this is not for you. I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance. We sell €3.5k–€20k coaching programs to men worldwide. Most clients come from DM conversations. We are already flooding the market with content across Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X, and the volume of inbound + outbound conversations is only going up. I have a full Content Operating System and A-Player closers. Now I want an A-player setter whose only job is: Start smart conversations. Qualify fast. Book calls. Get paid on results. If that excites you, keep reading. Mission of the Role: Turn warm attention from my content into qualified booked calls for my sales team. You will: - Own DMs on non-bot platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, maybe others). - On Instagram/Facebook, take over stuck / high-intent leads when the existing flows and automations have done their part and a human is needed. - Proactively initiate DMs with warm leads (engagers, commenters, voters) when directed by the team. - Follow proven scripts and flows, adapt when needed, and track results. - Be measured on: --> Conversations started --> Calls booked --> Show-up rate --> Sales from your sets This is appointment setting, not closing. No cold calling, no “spray and pray.” You talk to people who already follow/engage with me. What You’ll Actually Do (Daily): - Check all assigned platforms multiple times per day (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, plus IG/FB stuck/high-intent leads). - Reply to inbound messages using our scripts and training. - Start DMs with warm leads, for example: --> People who comment with clear pain/interest --> Story viewers/voters (when handed to you) --> Engagers on high-performing posts that we flag for you - Qualify leads using our questions (budget, problem, timeline, fit). - Handle basic objections at the DM level (time, “not sure”, “need to think”), and route serious buyers to a call. - Book calls on the correct calendar, with all required notes. - Keep your own simple tracking updated so we always know: - Who you talked to - Who booked a call from your DMs - Who showed up - Which of those calls became paying clients (you’ll see this from our CRM for commissions) - Who bought (for commissions) - Follow up on old leads consistently (you will not “forget” people). - Occasionally reply to high-intent comments (e.g. “how do I work with you?”) and move those people into DMs. (Low-level comment engagement is handled by a VA, not by you.) - Work closely with me + my team to improve scripts based on what you see in the field. You will not be responsible for content creation, editing, or generic admin. Your job is DMs and booking calls. Who This Is For: You’re a fit if: - You love sales conversations and messaging. DMs don’t drain you; you enjoy them. - Written English is 9/10+. You can sound natural, not robotic. - You have proven experience as a DM setter / appointment setter / closer (bonus if for coaches/consultants/fitness). - You can show proof – numbers, screenshots, client references, or case studies – that you’ve actually booked calls and driven revenue before. - You’re hungry. You want uncapped income, not just a tiny fixed salary. - You like being measured. Numbers don’t scare you. - You can work Philippines evenings to overlap with my time (Dubai) and US/Europe prospects. - You are okay working 6 days/week with lighter Sundays. Content + attention won’t stop on weekends. Nice-to-have (but not required): - Certificates in appointment setting / sales (e.g. setter/closer programs). If you have them, send them – they’re a plus, not a must. This is NOT for you if: - You’re scared of rejection or “pushback” in DMs. - You want to “learn sales someday” but have zero reps and zero proof. - You need someone to tell you every minute what to do. - You’re just collecting clients and will disappear in 30 days. Compensation: This is performance-driven. - Base: $200–$300/month (depending on experience) - Commission: 3–5% of cash collected from clients who buy after calls you set --> Our programs are €3,500–€20,000 --> Even at the low end, 3–5% is ~$110–$300+ per sale - Realistic OTE once ramped: --> 15–25+ calls booked/month, --> 30–40% close rate by our closers, You can make $800–$1,800+ / month once you’re dialed in. There is no cap. If you blow it up, you earn more. Simple. Schedule: - Approx. 35–40 hours/week spread across: --> Mon–Sat: core setting hours in the evening PH time (to be agreed) --> Sun: lighter check-ins + follow-ups You must be available during agreed core hours, not “whenever.” Minimum Requirements: - At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting / DM setting / sales (coaching, agency, SaaS, or similar). - Very strong written English (we will test this). - Stable internet + backup (data/second connection), and a quiet place to work. - Comfortable using: --> Instagram / Facebook / TikTok / LinkedIn / YouTube DMs --> Google Sheets / basic CRM --> Loom / Zoom for training - Willing to follow proven scripts AND give feedback to improve them. How to Apply (Follow Instructions Exactly): 1. Subject line / OnlineJobs message title: A-PLAYER SETTER – [Your First Name] 2. In your message, include short, direct answers to: a) Briefly describe your best DM setting or sales experience (1–3 sentences). b) What was your best month ever in terms of calls booked or revenue generated, and for what kind of offer? c) On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English? Show me with 2–3 sentences selling me on why I should pick you. d) What monthly income are you aiming for in USD within 3–6 months if you crush it here? e) Confirm your typical working hours in PH time and your availability on Sat/Sun. f) Attach or link proof that you’re a killer in DMs: - Screenshots, metrics, or a simple breakdown (e.g. “20 calls booked / 7 closes on $5k offer in one month”), - Any certificates in setting/sales you have (optional but a big plus). 3. OPTIONAL (big plus): Record a 2–3 minute Loom or audio where you: -> Introduce yourself -> Tell me about a time you turned a dead lead into a booked call -> Explain why you’re the best choice for this role Any generic “dear sir” or copy-paste applications will be ignored. I’m only looking for 1–2 killers who want to grow with the brand long term. If you read this all the way down and you’re fired up, apply now.

title: TikTok Short-Form Video Editor - US Food Brand (Street-Interview Style, Ongoing)
job_title: TikTok Short-Form Video Editor - US Food Brand (Street-Interview Style, Ongoing)
description: We're Counter, a high-protein frozen food brand in the US. Our TikToks are real college students doing street interviews: handing strangers our food and filming their reactions. We're hiring one editor to cut these for the long haul. You get added to our Slack and work straight with us. HOW IT WORKS We drop raw footage in a Google Drive folder. You turn it into native 10 to 20 second vertical TikToks. You edit only, no filming. Multiple videos a week. THE LOOK WE WANT Go watch SubwayTakes, Grillo's Pickles, and What's Poppin With Davis. Fast and native, like a real person cut it on their phone. Hard jump cuts. Word-by-word captions synced to the talking, sitting low, never over the face. Keep the real audio and reactions up front. One move we love, the "face freeze": on a funny or grossed-out reaction, freeze the frame, punch-zoom in, and drop ONE sound (a gasp, a record scratch, a vine boom). Once a video, twice at the most. WHAT GETS A VIDEO REJECTED - No cha-ching, click, or whoosh sounds on cuts. - No emojis, stickers, or graphics flying around the screen. - No glitch or spin transitions, no CapCut "viral template" look, no watermark. If it looks like a dropshipping ad, it is wrong. TOOLS CapCut or Premiere. You fix the auto-captions by hand so brand names are right. PAY $10 to $15 per finished video, paid weekly through Wise or Payoneer. Viral bonus on top when one of your edits hits big views in its first week. Honest heads up: this is a brand new program, so the first few weeks will be a little bumpy while we dial it in together. HOW TO APPLY (we skip anyone who skips this) 1. Start your reply with the word FREEZE so we know you read this. 2. Send 2 or 3 links to short vertical videos you edited, street-interview or reaction style. One line each on what you did. 3. Tell us one thing you would never add to a video like ours. Strong applicants get a PAID test edit on real footage we already shot.

THE KIND OF PERSON I REALLY NEED ----------------------------------------------------- You don't need to know everything already. But you do need to know how to find things out. When you hit something you've not done before, I need someone who has a sensible go at working it out — checking a help page, searching properly, looking at a previous example, or using an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude to think it through — then has a careful attempt and flags anything they're not sure of. I'm glad if you use AI to get yourself unstuck — it's how good people work now. What I don't want is someone who goes quiet, guesses blindly, or waits for every answer to be handed to them. >> I don't need someone who knows everything. I need someone who knows how to find out. (One small thing that isn't in the form's list of questions: somewhere in your voice message, please also tell me what the temperature is where you are right now.) THE BOOKKEEPING SIDE, HONESTLY ---------------------------------------------------- It's light to start with — mostly posting invoices into Xero and keeping records tidy. You don't need years of bookkeeping behind you, and you don't need to be an expert. What I need is the common sense to have a go, think it through, and ask a good question when something's genuinely unclear. I'd far rather have someone who thinks clearly and flags a sensible question than someone who guesses and makes a mess. The bookkeeping will grow over time, with support from self-learning and your team — so there's room to learn built into the role. (And while we're talking ledgers: when you reach the application form, type the word ledger into box 7.) WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH ---------------------------------------------- A small, personal team — me (Fiona), my husband Rudi, who looks after systems and tech behind the scenes, and our senior accountant in the Philippines. We work from home. It's personal, hands-on, and real. You'll be PA to me, but your day-to-day will run mostly through Rudi — systems, email s, onboarding, admin and process work — with bookkeeping guided by either myself, Rudi or eventually our senior accountant. The point of this role is to protect my time, keep work moving, and make sure important things don't get missed. You won't be just a number here — we're a small team, and we care about the people who work with us. WHAT YOU'LL DO ------------------------- • Help manage my email s and diary • Communicate with clients to get information in and keep work on track • Track follow-ups and chase missing records, answers, documents and approvals • Help with client onboarding • Draft email replies and client messages • Keep client records, folders and checklists tidy • Help move work in the door, through the process, and out the door • Support social media admin and post scheduling • Support general practice admin and help document repeat processes • Post invoices into Xero and support basic bookkeeping tasks • Take written instructions and voice notes and turn them into clear action • Spot problems early and flag them clearly • And anything else really that we need help with when it's needed This isn't an advisory role — you won't give accounting or tax advice to clients. But it is a communication-heavy PA role, so you'll need to be confident, clear, professional and comfortable dealing with clients to get things sorted. MUST-HAVES ------------------- • Strong PA, admin, operations or client-support experience • Experience supporting a business owner directly • Experience working remotely for a UK business, UK clients, or similar overseas clients • Excellent written and spoken English • Strong attention to detail and very strong organisation • Good spreadsheet skills, and confidence with email , online systems and shared folders (Gmail, Google Drive) • Some hands-on exposure to bookkeeping and/or Xero — you don't need to be experienced, but you should have actually used them. Xero certification would be a huge bonus. • Able to follow written and verbal instructions properly, and comfortable turning voice notes into action • Able to use initiative, work things out sensibly, and ask good questions when stuck • Able to take ownership without needing constant chasing • Reliable, trustworthy and professional • A modern laptop or PC, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work HELPFUL, BUT NOT ESSENTIAL -------------------------------------------- • Experience in a UK bookkeeping or accountancy practice • Experience with client onboarding or chasing client information • Experience with social media admin or post scheduling You do need to be switched on, organised, confident, and able to think. HOW WE'LL ASSESS YOU ----------------------------------- This is a serious role, so we'll assess properly. We'll be looking at your written and spoken English, your clarity of communication, your ability to follow instructions, your organisation and attention to detail, your ability to think and work things out, and your ability to take ownership and follow through. Please only apply if you're confident in those areas. PAY & CONTRACTOR TERMS --------------------------------------- • Pay is Php60,000 per month • This is an independent contractor role, not employment • Paid monthly in PHP — you handle your own taxes and contributions in the Philippines • Bring-your-own-device: we don't provide hardware initially • Full contractor terms will be set out clearly before work begins HOURS ----------- Full-time, based around UK time. We don't expect silly hours, but we need reliable overlap each weekday for communication, handovers and keeping work moving — typically 8:00am–12:00 noon UK time, which means late afternoon/evening in the Philippines depending on the time of year. We don't use invasive screen-tracking software. We manage by trust, communication and output. WHY THIS MIGHT BE THE PLACE FOR YOU ----------------------------------------------------------- I built this business so I could be there for my daughters. Family matters to me, trust matters to me, and doing good work properly matters to me — and I want the right person in this role to have that same dignity: to work from home, be trusted, do meaningful work, and grow with a small team that values good people. We're not for everyone. But if you're organised, reliable, switched on, and looking for a serious long-term role with a small UK firm, this could be a very good fit. HOW TO APPLY ---------------------- Apply through our application page: ---------- Access code: FJ2026 The application has a few short questions and a short voice recording. Please complete it carefully. Short, rushed applications won't be considered — I'm looking for someone thoughtful, organised and serious. Learn more: ---------- ----------

title: Founder's Associate, Operations & Systems (Startup Gaming Niche)
job_title: Founder's Associate, Operations & Systems (Startup Gaming Niche)
description: **About us** We're a small, fast-moving team in the video game industry. We're growing quickly, we treat our people well, and we play the long game: clear expectations, steady work, genuine respect, and real growth for those who earn it. This is a seat to build a career in, not a churn-and-burn gig. We're looking for someone exceptional to grow with us. **What this role is** You'll be the right hand to seasoned founders who move fast and never run out of ideas, which is exactly why this role exists. Your job is to bring order to that: take things off the plate, build the systems that keep the business running, and turn loose goals into finished work. Sometimes you'll have a clear process to follow. Just as often, you won't, and that's where the right person shines. When there's no playbook, you research it, figure out the smartest way to do it, talk it through with the founders, build the process, and then act on it. A real example of what we mean: "We need to bring on a video editor. Figure out where to find good ones, what it should cost, screen the candidates, bring me your top picks, and once we approve, get them onboarded and working." That's the level of ownership we're after. We want to hand you a goal and trust it's handled, not assign you a checklist. If you bring problems wrapped in solutions instead of just questions, you'll thrive here. If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this isn't the fit. We'll have a short check-in call once a day during the initial period to stay aligned, get you up to speed on how we work, unblock you quickly, and move quickly together. **What you'll do** It varies week to week, but expect a mix of: - Building SOPs and systems: Turning the things we do into clean, written, repeatable processes so the business runs more smoothly over time. This is a core part of the job, not an afterthought. - Acting on those systems: Running and following up on recurring work so nothing slips, and keeping our internal systems tidy and up to date. - Project management: Owning one-off projects end-to-end: scoping them, driving them, and reporting back clearly. - Hiring support: Sourcing, screening, and helping onboard contractors and tea ---------- mbers as we grow. - Content posting: Publishing and organizing content across our channels on a consistent schedule. - Coordination: Working with vendors, contractors, and our team to keep things moving. - Research: Figuring out the best way to do something we've never done, then bringing back a clear recommendation. The specific tools and tasks are learnable, and we'll teach you what's specific to us. What we can't teach is the resourcefulness and drive to own the outcome. **Who you are** - Resourceful: When you hit something you don't know, you figure it out. You research, you learn, and you come back with a plan, not just a question. - Proactive and ownership-driven: You anticipate what's needed, follow through without reminders, and treat the business as if it were your own. - Organized and systems-minded: You think in processes and checklists. You like building order out of chaos and enjoy finding smarter ways to do things. - Comfortable with ambiguity: A sharp, fast learner who can take a vague goal and find the path forward. - An excellent communicator: in written and spoken English, clear, professional, and easy to work with. You'll talk to the founders directly and represent us with vendors and contractors. - Hungry, with high standards and a strong work ethic: This matters to us more than your résumé. You take pride in your work, and you don't cut corners. - Honest, discreet, and trustworthy: You'll handle sensitive information. **Nice to have** These are bonuses, not requirements. Tell us if you have any of them: - 2+ years supporting founders, executives, or businesses - Fluent with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. We love people who use them to move faster - Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Trello, or similar - Experience writing SOPs or documenting processes - Hiring or recruiting experience - Content creation or light video editing **The details** - Hours: Full-time, with some daily overlap with British Summer Time. We'll work out the exact hours together. - Pay: 40,000 PHP - Payment: Weekly or biweekly via PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, or similar. - Location: Fully remote, work from home. - Type: Long-term. We want someone to build a future with us, and strong performers grow quickly from here. **How to apply** Please don't send copy-pasted applications. We read every complete one, and generic ones get ignored. One step: Record a short Loom or YouTube video** (a few minutes, on your own time) telling us: - A quick introduction about yourself and your relevant experience - Do you have any experience with video games? If so, which games do you play? - A time you were handed something with little or no instruction, and you figured it out and got it done - Why this role excites you and what makes you the person we're looking for We reply to every application that's a fit. We're excited to meet you.
