Takes detailed notes without needing to be reminded. Can manage follow-ups without losing track of important tasks. Has strong attention to detail. Experience in sales, appointment setting, claims support, insurance, legal intake, medical admin, customer service, or Australian campaigns will be highly regarded. title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
job_title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.) This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone). Our Stack (you'll work across most of this) -Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps) -Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API) -Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation) -ActiveCampaign (automations, API) -Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run) -REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job -LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API) -WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code. -Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API) -Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments -Softr (client portal on top of Airtable) -Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation. What You'll Do -Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems) -Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability -Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google -Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings -Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post. 2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't. 3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.) 4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem? 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD. 6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning. If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

We are a Sydney-based legal business in the personal injury and a ---------- space, looking for an organised, proactive, and detail-focused Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support tea ---------- mber to join our Philippines-based remote team. Your role is to help move these matters from a pending list into active client files that can be allocated to the Sydney legal team. This means you will be constantly reviewing files, identifying what is missing, following up with the right people or organisations, updating notes, and making sure matters keep progressing. You may be required to communicate with clients, internal tea ---------- mbers, superannuation funds, insurers, medical clinics, doctors, previous employers, and other relevant third parties to request or follow up on information required for a legal matter. Key Responsibilities Your day-to-day work will include: Reviewing pending client files and identifying outstanding information Following up with clients and relevant third parties Liaising with our Philippines-based team who originate the matters Communicating daily with our Sydney-based legal team Keeping detailed notes on every file Updating systems clearly and accurately Helping move matters from pending status to active legal files Supporting Sydney-based lawyers with administrative and paralegal-style tasks Staying organised across multiple matters at the same time Following up consistently until the required information is received The key measure of success in this role is your ability to reduce the pending list and keep legal matters moving forward. Who We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and detail-focused A strong written and spoken English communicator Able to work autonomously from home A self-starter who can think on their feet Comfortable following up regularly and professionally Able to manage a busy workload without losing track of details Confident speaking on the phone when required Reliable, consistent, and process-driven Comfortable working with lawyers, admin teams, and external parties Able to keep excellent notes and file records Looking for a long-term role in a structured legal business This role requires exceptional English and communication skills. You must be able to communicate clearly with Australian-based lawyers, clients, and external organisations. Technical Requirements You must have: A reliable high-speed internet connection A quiet and professional work-from-home setup A reliable computer Confidence using online systems, Slack, email , and cloud-based tools The ability to demonstrate your internet speed if requested How The Team Works You will work closely with our Philippines-based team and our Sydney-based legal team. The business is managed through Slack channels, internal systems, and structured workflows. You must be comfortable working online, keeping the team updated, and maintaining clear records of your work. This is a very important role because it helps ensure that legal matters do not sit idle and that clients can move forward through the legal process. There is real room to grow for the right person. Compensation And Benefits We offer: Attractive compensation for the role Long-term opportunity with a stable business Work-from-home arrangement Supportive team environment Clear structure, training, and systems Two weeks paid Christmas vacation, prorated depending on start date Paid time off over Easter Major Australian public holidays included Opportunity to grow within the business This is a contractor position. You will be responsible for your own tax obligations, government contributions, healthcare, insurance, and any other personal contractor obligations in the Philippines. Important Application Instructions To apply, please attach: Your updated CV A short cover letter explaining why you are suitable for this role In your cover letter, please include: Your legal admin, paralegal, or administrative support experience Your previous work history and any relevant roles Why you are highly organised and suited to managing pending files Why your English and communication skills are strong enough for this role Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time Confirmation that you have reliable high-speed internet Your application subject line must include: TPD Matters Admin Applications that do not include this in the subject line, or do not attach both a CV and cover letter, will be ignored. description: We're a DTC ecommerce brand running high volumes of video ads (Facebook /Instagram). We are NOT looking for a generic "video editor." We're looking for someone with real, proven experience editing ecommerce / direct-response ads who understands that the goal is to stop the scroll, hold attention, and drive a click — not to make something cinematic. You'll work in both formats: short-form (15–45s scroll-stoppers) and long-form (2–5 minute advertorial / VSL-style videos). Here's how we work: we send you a reference ad (or two) that shows the style we're going for, plus our raw clips. Your job is to study that reference, match its look, pacing and structure, and build our ad in that style — with room to use your own judgment and creative instincts. We don't hand you a shot-by-shot timeline. Where you need footage we didn't provide, you source it yourself (stock, B-roll, UGC-style clips). So you have to be able to read a video and recreate its feel, not just follow step-by-step instructions. You must have hands-on, proven experience with: Ecommerce / DTC ad editing — this is non-negotiable; show us the ads Both short-form AND long-form ad editing (advertorial / VSL-style 2–5 min videos) Sourcing your own footage — stock libraries (Storyblocks, Artgrid, Envato, Pexels, etc.), B-roll, and UGC-style clips that match a script beat Matching a reference / style ad — watching an example and recreating its look, pacing and structure (not following a shot-by-shot timeline) CapCut and/or Submagic (auto-captions, beat-syncing, exports) Talking-head / UGC ad editing (HeyGen avatar footage is a plus) Fast turnaround at volume (multiple ads per week) What we don't need: wedding/event editors, motion-graphics showpieces, color-grading reels, or people whose only experience is long-form YouTube vlogs. If you haven't edited ecommerce ads before, we're not a fit — please don't apply. This role is for you if: you can watch a great ad and figure out why it works, you're fast and consistent, you have good creative instincts but stay on-brief, and you communicate proactively when something's unclear. Pay: $800–1,000 / month depending on experience. Full-time, long-term, with raises for top performers. To apply — read carefully (we ignore applications that skip this): Start your reply with the word "SCROLL-STOP" so we know you read this. Send us as many ecommerce ADS as you can that you personally edited — we want to see a real body of work, not one lucky example. Include both short-form and long-form if you have them. These should be actual ads (not showreels, not client logos). For each, one line on what you did. Tell us about a time you sourced footage yourself for an ad — where you found it and how you chose it. Which stock libraries / sources do you use? Tell us which tools you use and your typical turnaround for (a) a 30–45 second short-form ad and (b) a 2–4 minute long-form ad. One line: what makes an ecommerce ad keep someone watching past the first 3 seconds? We reply to everyone who follows these 5 steps. Looking forward to seeing your work.

The standard, in my voice. Rising Tide is a personal brand. Everything we put out has to sound like me and hit a bar the industry notices. You'll learn my voice well enough to say "this isn't us yet" before I would. Nothing ships at "good enough." The weekly meeting. Every project, status, blockers, deadlines. Your meeting, not mine. The podcast. The Rising Tidecast from recording to published, on a schedule you own. The money. Budgeted vs. actual hours so we stay profitable. Invoice follow-ups so I'm not chasing payments on the water. Expenses tracked Keeping me accountable. description: About the Project We are producing 8 self-paced virtual learning modules (plus one short orientation module) for a professional development project in K-12 education. Suite Assembly • Import the completed .pptx slide deck into iSpring Suite Max (desktop application, Windows required) • Sync generated audio to each slide with correct timing • Configure slide transitions and advance settings (audio-driven, not click-to-advance) • Preview and test full module playback end-to-end Phase 3: Accessibility QA • Verify reading order in PowerPoint (Selection Pane) matches logical content flow on every slide • Write or refine alt text for all images, graphics, and diagrams based on provided descriptions • Verify caption transcript files align with final audio (timing, content match) • Run color contrast checks on all text and background combinations (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text per WCAG 2.1 AA) • Confirm all non-text information conveyed by color also has a non-color indicator (labels, patterns, icons) • Test keyboard/tab navigation in the published module to ensure all content is reachable without a mouse • Log all findings in an accessibility checklist per module Phase 4: SCORM Packaging and QA • Publish each module as a SCORM 1.2 package (or SCORM 2004 if specified) • Configure completion tracking rules (e.g., viewed all slides) • Configure resume behavior (learner can exit and return where they left off) • Test the published SCORM package in SCORM Cloud or equivalent LMS test environment • Verify: audio plays correctly on all slides, completion triggers properly, package resumes on re-entry • Deliver the final .zip SCORM package and a brief QA checklist per module Deliverables Per Module 1. Audio files (one per slide, .mp3, labeled) 2. Published SCORM .zip package (tested and verified) 3. Accessibility checklist per module (reading order, alt text, contrast, keyboard nav) 4. job_title: Virtual Assistant - Operations, Systems, Growth (Gaming Startup)
description: **About us** We're a small, fast-moving team in the video game industry. We're growing quickly, we treat our people well, and we play the long game: clear expectations, steady work, genuine respect, and real growth for those who earn it. This is a seat to build a career in, not a churn-and-burn gig. We're looking for someone exceptional to grow with us. **What this role is** You'll be the right hand to seasoned founders who move fast and never run out of ideas, which is exactly why this role exists. Your job is to bring order to that: take things off the plate, build the systems that keep the business running, and turn loose goals into finished work. Sometimes you'll have a clear process to follow. Just as often, you won't, and that's where the right person shines. When there's no playbook, you research it, figure out the smartest way to do it, talk it through with the founders, build the process, and then act on it. A real example of what we mean: "We need to bring on a video editor. Figure out where to find good ones, what it should cost, screen the candidates, bring me your top picks, and once we approve, get them onboarded and working." That's the level of ownership we're after. We want to hand you a goal and trust it's handled, not assign you a checklist. If you bring problems wrapped in solutions instead of just questions, you'll thrive here. If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this isn't the fit. We'll have a short check-in call once a day during the initial period to stay aligned, get you up to speed on how we work, unblock you quickly, and move quickly together. **What you'll do** It varies week to week, but expect a mix of: - Building SOPs and systems: Turning the things we do into clean, written, repeatable processes so the business runs more smoothly over time. This is a core part of the job, not an afterthought. - Acting on those systems: Running and following up on recurring work so nothing slips, and keeping our internal systems tidy and up to date. - Project management: Owning one-off projects end-to-end: scoping them, driving them, and reporting back clearly. - Hiring support: Sourcing, screening, and helping onboard contractors and tea ---------- mbers as we grow. - Content posting: Publishing and organizing content across our channels on a consistent schedule. - Coordination: Working with vendors, contractors, and our team to keep things moving. - Research: Figuring out the best way to do something we've never done, then bringing back a clear recommendation. The specific tools and tasks are learnable, and we'll teach you what's specific to us. What we can't teach is the resourcefulness and drive to own the outcome. **Who you are** - Resourceful: When you hit something you don't know, you figure it out. You research, you learn, and you come back with a plan, not just a question. - Proactive and ownership-driven: You anticipate what's needed, follow through without reminders, and treat the business as if it were your own. - Organized and systems-minded: You think in processes and checklists. You like building order out of chaos and enjoy finding smarter ways to do things. - Comfortable with ambiguity: A sharp, fast learner who can take a vague goal and find the path forward. - An excellent communicator: in written and spoken English, clear, professional, and easy to work with. You'll talk to the founders directly and represent us with vendors and contractors. - Hungry, with high standards and a strong work ethic: This matters to us more than your résumé. You take pride in your work, and you don't cut corners. - Honest, discreet, and trustworthy: You'll handle sensitive information. **Nice to have** These are bonuses, not requirements. Tell us if you have any of them: - 2+ years supporting founders, executives, or businesses - Fluent with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. We love people who use them to move faster - Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Trello, or similar - Experience writing SOPs or documenting processes - Hiring or recruiting experience - Content creation or light video editing **The details** - Hours: Full-time, with some daily overlap with British Summer Time. We'll work out the exact hours together. - Pay: 40,000 PHP - Payment: Weekly or biweekly via PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, or similar. - Location: Fully remote, work from home. - Type: Long-term. We want someone to build a future with us, and strong performers grow quickly from here. **How to apply** Please don't send copy-pasted applications. We read every complete one, and generic ones get ignored. One step: Record a short Loom or YouTube video (a few minutes, on your own time) telling us: - A quick introduction about yourself and your relevant experience - Do you have any experience with video games? If so, which games do you play? - A time you were handed something with little or no instruction, and you figured it out and got it done - Why this role excites you and what makes you the person we're looking for We reply to every application that's a fit. We're excited to meet you.

title: AI Automation & Systems Builder
description: # AI Automation & Systems Builder We are looking for a hungry, self-motivated AI Automation & Systems Builder based in the Philippines. This is not a basic virtual assistant job. We are looking for someone who can help us build systems, dashboards, automations, and better workflows that make the company run faster, smarter, and more organized. You do not need to have a formal technical background, but you must be comfortable learning new tools, figuring things out, testing ideas, and improving systems. We are looking for someone who is excited to build, not just follow instructions. ## What You’ll Help Build You may help us with projects such as: * A company dashboard to track important business information, open issues, tasks, orders, and team performance * A reorder dashboard that shows which products are running low, what needs to be reordered, what is already on order, supplier follow-up status, estimated arrival dates, and urgent priority items * Automations between different tools, forms, email s, spreadsheets, websites, and internal systems * Customer service workflows that help us track issues, questions, follow-ups, and resolutions * A customer interactive proofing system where customers can review proofs, approve them, request changes, and track status * Internal systems to reduce manual work and prevent things from falling through the cracks * Workflows using Codex or other AI coding tools * Better SOPs, checklists, and tracking systems * Reports and dashboards that help us see what needs attention quickly ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: * Hungry to grow * Self-motivated * Curious * Resourceful * Organized * Detail-oriented * Comfortable using AI tools * Comfortable learning new software and systems * Good at solving problems * Willing to test, fail, fix, and improve * Able to follow up without being chased * Able to communicate clearly * Honest about what they know and what they still need to learn * The kind of person who takes ownership and keeps going until the work is done properly We do not need someone who knows everything already. We need someone who can think, learn, test, follow up, and find a way. ## Helpful Skills These skills are helpful, but you do not need to have all of them: * ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or other AI tools * Codex or AI coding tools * Excel or Google Sheets * Dashboards and reports * Zapier, Make, Airtable, or similar automation tools * Google Forms, Typeform, Jotform, or similar form tools * Apps Script or basic coding * Customer service systems * Ecommerce systems * SOP creation * Data organization * Project tracking tools A technical background is helpful, but not required. What matters more is that you are a strong problem-solver, comfortable learning new tools, and excited to build systems that make the company run better. ## Important Application Rule Do not use AI to answer this application. This job requires AI skills, but your application must come from you. I want to see your real thinking, real experience, and real personality. If your answers sound generic, overly polished, or like they were copied from ChatGPT, your application will be skipped. Answer honestly and specifically. Short, real, clear answers are better than long AI-written answers. ## Follow-Up Requirement If you want this job, you must follow up after applying. We may not answer your first message right away. We are looking for someone who is hungry, takes initiative, and does not wait around passively. After you apply, send a follow-up message explaining why you believe you are the right person for this role and what you would be excited to help build for our company. A strong follow-up will make your application stand out. ## To Apply Please answer the questions below carefully. Applications with vague, lazy, or generic answers will not be considered. # Application Questions Please answer these yourself. Do not use AI to write your answers. 1. Why do you want this job? 2. Why do you think you are the right person for this role? 3. What does being “hungry” in a job mean to you? 4. Tell me about a time you cared so much about finishing a project that you pushed yourself harder than expected. What was the project, what happened, and how did it turn out? 5. Tell me about a time there was an urgent deadline and the work was not finished yet. What did you personally do? 6. When you are working on a project and you realize it will take longer than expected, what do you usually do? Give a real example. 7. What was the last project you became a little obsessed with finishing? Why did it matter to you? 8. Give an example of a time you had to figure something out without clear instructions. What did you do? 9. Tell me about your experience with tools, systems, spreadsheets, dashboards, automations, AI tools, or coding. You do not need formal technical training, but I want to understand what you have actually used, built, tested, or learned. 10. Have you ever built a dashboard before? If yes, what did it track and what tool did you use? 11. If we asked you to build a company dashboard, what information would you want to understand first? 12. If we asked you to build a reorder dashboard, how would you set it up? What information would you track, what alerts would you include, and how would you make sure it helps us take action quickly? 13. Have you ever created an automation before? What tools did you use and what did the automation do? 14. Have you ever used Codex or an AI coding tool to build or fix something? What did you build? 15. If we asked you to build a customer proofing system where customers can approve, request changes, and track proof status, how would you start? 16. What tools would you consider using for a customer proofing system? 17. What is one business process you think AI can improve, but should not fully control? 18. Tell me about one project you are proud of. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result? 19. What are you strongest at: automation, spreadsheets, coding, dashboards, customer systems, operations, or something else? Explain. 20. What are you still learning? 21. How do you handle it when something you built does not work? 22. How do you follow up when someone does not answer you? 23. What hours can you work in Philippine time? 24. Are you looking for full-time, part-time, or project-based work? 25. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP? 26. Please send proof of your work if you have it: screenshots, screen recordings, sample dashboards, automations, spreadsheets, systems, or anything you built. 27. After applying, please send a separate follow-up message telling us why you should be chosen for this role. # Required Follow-Up Message After applying, you must send a follow-up message. Your follow-up should answer: * Why do you want this job? * Why do you think you are the right person? * What makes you hungry and self-motivated? * What is one system, dashboard, automation, or tool you would be excited to help build? * Why should we choose you over someone else? Do not send a generic follow-up like “I am following up on my application.” Show us that you actually want the role.

description: We are looking for a reliable, detail-focused video editor to join our team on a freelance/ongoing basis. We are a UK-based business coaching and training company that runs regular online and in-person events, workshops, coaching sessions and training programmes. We need an editor who can help us turn this content into clean, professional, easy-to-watch videos for our coaching platforms, member areas, YouTube, social media and internal training resources. This role is specifically for someone who has experience editing educational, coaching, training, webinar or course-style content. Please do not apply unless your portfolio includes examples of previously edited educational or coaching content. Applications without this type of portfolio evidence will not be considered. The main focus of this role will be editing long-form coaching, event and training content. However, we also repurpose our coaching content into shorter social media videos, reels and clips, so you may also be asked to edit short-form content from the same recordings. We need someone who understands how to edit content where the viewer is learning something, but who is also comfortable creating shorter, engaging clips for social media when required. The type of content you will edit includes: * Coaching session recordings * Online training sessions * Webinar-style videos * Event recordings * Workshop recordings * Course/member area content * Long-form educational videos * YouTube videos * Short social media clips taken from coaching or training content * Reels, vertical videos and repurposed clips Sometimes the recordings will already be captured through OBS and may only need trimming, cleaning up and exporting correctly. Other times, the edit will be more detailed and will require you to bring slides in and out when they are referenced, cut between speaker and slide view, remove unnecessary sections, tidy up pauses, improve flow and make the content easier for the viewer to follow. You must be confident working with long-form content and be able to use your judgement to make educational videos feel clear, professional and easy to watch. Your tasks may include: * Editing long-form coaching, training and event content * Trimming OBS recordings and preparing them for upload * Adding slides into the video when referenced by the speaker * Cutting between speaker footage, screen recordings and presentation slides * Removing long pauses, mistakes or unnecessary sections * Cleaning up audio where needed * Creating shorter clips, reels or social media videos from longer coaching content * Adding captions, subtitles, simple titles, lower thirds or branded elements where required * Exporting files in the correct formats for different platforms * Following clear briefs and feedback from our UK team * Keeping files organised and version-controlled * Communicating updates clearly through Slack Requirements You must have: * Proven experience editing educational, coaching, training, course or webinar-style content * A portfolio that clearly shows this type of work * Experience creating social media clips or reels from longer-form content * Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro * Strong attention to detail * Good understanding of pacing for long-form educational content * Ability to follow brand guidelines and editing instructions * Reliable communication and good written English * Ability to work independently and manage deadlines * A stable internet connection for downloading/uploading large video files * Willingness to communicate with our team through Slack * Willingness to use a verified time tracking app while working so hours and charges are accurate * Willingness to sign a contract protecting our intellectual property, client content and confidential materials Working Hours & Communication Our team works Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:30pm UK time. You must be available to work and communicate during these UK working hours so we can brief projects properly, answer questions, give feedback and keep work moving efficiently. This does not mean you will always be editing for the full working day, but you do need to be available during these hours when working on our projects. Clear communication is very important to us. We use Slack for day-to-day updates, questions, briefs and feedback. Important Portfolio Requirement Your application must include a portfolio with examples of coaching, training, webinar, course, tutorial or educational content you have edited before. If your portfolio only includes music videos, gaming videos, weddings, lifestyle edits or general social media content, this will not be enough for this role. We need to see that you understand how to edit content where the viewer is learning something and where the structure, slides, speaker delivery and clarity of the message are important. Bonus points if your portfolio also shows examples of short-form social media clips or reels created from longer educational, coaching or training content. Applications without relevant portfolio examples will not be reviewed. What We Offer * Regular freelance editing work for the right person * Clear briefs and structured feedback * Ongoing projects rather than one-off tasks * A friendly, supportive UK-based team * The opportunity to become a long-term part of our content production process * Interesting coaching and training content to work on * A mix of long-form editing and repurposed social media content We are looking for someone reliable, organised and experienced who can help us turn our coaching and event content into professional, easy-to-watch videos for our audience, while also helping us repurpose the best ---------- nts into strong social media content.

title: Auto Transport Operations Coordinator (Remote – Philippines)
description: Location: Remote – Philippines Hours: Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time (full-time, ~40 hrs/week) Pay: $3–$4 USD/hour base + commission per booked load (structure discussed during interview) Employment Type: Full-time / Contract About the Role TrueTruck Auto Transport is a US-based auto transport brokerage. That means accurate quotes, real timelines, and no games. It's how we want every conversation to sound. We're looking for a sharp, motivated coordinator to handle the day-to-day communication that keeps shipments moving — talking and texting with customers, working leads, negotiating with carriers, and posting loads on the major dispatch boards. This is a hands-on operations role where you'll wear several hats and have a direct impact on whether a load gets booked, dispatched, and delivered cleanly. You don't need prior auto transport experience. We'll train you on everything. What we need is excellent English, quick thinking, and someone who can hold their own on the phone and over text. What You'll Do - Respond to inbound customer leads via phone and text — quote shipments, explain the process, and book the job - Handle a high volume of text message conversations with customers, leads, carriers, and drivers throughout the day - Cold call leads when other work is quiet (this is a steady part of the role, not the main focus, but it matters) - Communicate with existing customers — provide updates, answer questions, handle issues professionally - Post loads on Super Dispatch and Central Dispatch - Negotiate rates with carriers and dispatchers to get loads moved at the right price - Verify carrier insurance and authority before dispatching - Coordinate with carriers and drivers throughout pickup and delivery — confirm details, troubleshoot delays, keep everyone on the same page - Keep our internal CRM up to date with accurate notes on every customer, lead, and load - Flag problems early — a late driver, a customer concern, a carrier that won't pick up the phone What We're Looking For - This role requires real-time thinking on the phone and clear, professional writing over text. You'll be talking to US customers who want clear answers, texting back and forth with leads who are comparing quotes and negotiating with carriers who push hard on rates. You need to: - Listen carefully, respond clearly, and not get rattled - Write quick, professional text messages with correct grammar and a natural American tone - Stay honest with customers even when it's not what they want to hear — it's how we operate - Push back politely but firmly when a carrier's rate doesn't work - Juggle multiple shipments and text threads at different stages without dropping the ball Requirements - Excellent written and spoken English — near-native fluency, minimal accent, clean writing - Able to think and respond on your feet during live phone calls - Fast, accurate typing — a lot of this job is texting - Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment - Comfortable on the phone — this is a phone-heavy and text-heavy role - Comfortable using basic computer tools: email , messaging apps, CRM software - Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time, consistently - Responsive during your shift Preferred (Not Required) - Prior experience in auto transport, logistics, freight brokerage, or dispatch - Sales, cold calling, or call center experience - Customer service experience with US customers - Familiarity with Super Dispatch, Central Dispatch, or any TMS/CRM software We provide the phone system, software access, and training. You bring the work ethic and the English. What We Offer - Full-time, consistent hours with a stable US-based company - Base pay plus commission on every load you book — the more you close, the more you earn - Real training on the auto transport industry, not just a script - Direct communication with a small team — you'll know who you're working with - Long-term role for the right person To Apply - Please send a short message including: - Why you'd be a good fit for this role - Any sales, customer service, dispatch, or logistics experience you have - Your availability to start Applications without a personal message will not be considered.

MUST HAVE Very clear spoken English — Americans must understand you easily. Neutral/light accent preferred. This isn't me being difficult — it's me filtering for people who actually read instructions. That skill matters in this job. Put this exact phrase in your cover letter subject line: I READ THE POST — ABIN SAJI 2026 In your application, send me: A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link works great) reading this out loud in your most natural "phone voice": "Hey John, this is Sam calling from Globe Life, American Income Division. Fair enough?" A short paragraph (3–5 sentences) answering: What's the biggest objection you've ever overcome on a call, and how? That means: You talk directly to the owner (me), not 3 layers of managers Feedback loops are fast — I can change scripts, fix tools, raise pay instantly I actually reward performance — top producers make real money here I invest in training. You'll leave this job a better setter than you came in, guaranteed. I'm looking for 2–3 people. If that's you — apply today. I review every application personally. description: We are a small fully remote team that builds and maintains multiple Shopify apps for store owners worldwide. Payments, shipping, discounts, checkout customization, subscriptions, and related tools. We are not a big corporation. No call-center script. No canned corporate tone. Day to day: Answer setup and troubleshooting questions Read screenshots, ask clarifying questions, guide step by step Sometimes configure rules or settings for a merchant when they are stuck Explain honestly when something is not possible Reply in the merchant's language when you can. English is the default WHAT TYPICAL WORK LOOKS LIKE Many conversations start simple: merchant opens chat, you ask how you can help. Then it gets specific. Country-based payment rules. Shipping rate setup. Discount logic not applying. Checkout behavior on certain plans. Billing or uninstall questions. Plan limits. Screenshots back and forth until it is fixed or clearly explained. Most threads are short to medium length. Some are quick. Some take longer when the merchant is stuck or the store setup is unusual. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Must have: - Excellent written English. Clear, friendly, natural. Not stiff or robotic - Stable internet, reliable computer, workable home setup - Comfortable with live chat. Think while typing, stay calm with frustrated merchants - Honest and direct. You say when something cannot be done instead of guessing - Willing to learn Shopify admin: payments, shipping, checkout, billing, plans - Self-starter on a small team Big plus: - Prior Shopify experience as merchant, VA, support, or agency staff - SaaS or app support experience Not a fit if: - You only want rigid scripts - You avoid technical questions - You need a large corporate structure to function SCHEDULE Full-time, remote. Copy each question and answer under it. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. - Any additional information you feel is great to share with us SCREENING QUESTIONS (required) We use these to filter people who have actually worked with Shopify, not people who guessed or used AI. Be specific. Vague answers get skipped. IMPORTANT: about 90% of candidates were skipped in our previous hiring rounds due to AI generated answers, detected by our systems, or later humans. Do not apply if you don't know what you're doing, you'll be wasting yours and our time. If you really don't know what you're doing and apply using 100% AI generated answers, it will always show up later. Question 1: A merchant installs a cash-on-delivery app and says "COD is not showing at checkout." Before you touch anything inside the app, what is the exact click path in Shopify admin to enable Cash on Delivery as a payment method? Write it as steps, like Settings > Payments > ... title: Mortgage Loan Processor (DSCR / Non-QM Focus)
description: Position Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented Mortgage Loan Processor with strong DSCR and investment property experience to support a high-volume pipeline. This role works directly with the Loan Originator to move files from submission to clear to close. The majority of your pipeline will be DSCR loans on investment properties, with a smaller mix of full doc conventional loans on primary residences and bank statement loans. The ideal candidate understands how each of these products is underwritten and can keep files moving without constant oversight. Loan Types You Will Process The bulk of this role is DSCR. You should be confident processing all three of the following: DSCR / investment property loans (primary focus, majority of pipeline). Comfortable with rent schedules and DSCR ratio calculations, lease agreements and market rent (1007), business purpose and occupancy affidavits, entity vesting (LLC docs, operating agreements), and the non-QM condition set that comes with these files. Conventional full doc loans on primary residences (smaller volume). Comfortable with income and asset documentation, AUS findings, and processing in full compliance with TRID timing and disclosure requirements. Bank statement loans. Comfortable building and documenting income from personal or business bank statements and working with the lender's bank statement analysis requirements. Key Responsibilities Review new DSCR and Non-QM files for completeness and accuracy before submission. Submit files to underwriting and manage each loan through to clear to close. Review conditional approvals and prepare a clear, organized list of conditions. Communicate directly with borrowers to request and collect documentation, and explain underwriting conditions in plain, professional language. Follow up persistently with borrowers, third parties, and vendors to clear outstanding items. Order and track appraisals, title, insurance, and payoffs, and coordinate with those providers throughout the file. Calculate and verify DSCR ratios and confirm the file supports the program and pricing tier. Ensure TRID timing and disclosure requirements are met on every applicable file. Upload and organize all documentation in the LOS and keep compliance requirements satisfied. Work side by side with the Loan Originator to resolve conditions quickly and keep every file moving toward closing. Qualifications Prior experience as a Mortgage Loan Processor, with hands-on DSCR and Non-QM processing strongly preferred. Working knowledge of DSCR ratio calculations, rent schedules, and entity-vested investment property files. Experience processing conventional full doc loans under TRID, plus bank statement income loans. Familiarity with wholesale lender portals and submission processes. Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to work directly with borrowers. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage many files at once. Comfortable in an LOS and document management platforms (LendingPad experience a plus). Key Traits for Success Confident processing DSCR files independently from submission to clear to close. Strong follow-up and file management under deadline pressure. Clear, professional communication with borrowers, lenders, and third parties. Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to spot a problem in a file before it becomes a delay.

title: Finance Director
description: This is a chance to do high-grade finance work for some of the most exciting growth companies in the CPG and DTC space. You will sit close to the founders and operators building category-defining brands, owning the financial data, the modeling, and the analysis that shape how they plan, allocate capital, and scale. It is a senior, hands-on role for someone who takes real ownership of the numbers and keeps them clean, current, and decision-ready week to week. You should be equally comfortable building a three-statement model from scratch and tracing the margin implications of a new vendor contract, and you should get energy from seeing your work drive real decisions across a portfolio of brands. 1. Financial Data, Reporting, and Margins •        Own weekly financial data management across the portfolio, tracking performance and margins, not just the monthly close, so the numbers stay reliable enough to act on at any point in the cycle. •        Ensure data integrity by working closely with our accounting and controllership teams on reconciliations and month-end close outputs, owning the reporting cadence end to end. •        Develop and manage KPI dashboards, executive reporting packages, and board-ready materials. •        Drive the detail underneath the numbers: unit economics, margin analysis, and demand planning, so the CFO can point to where margin is leaking and where it can be recovered. 2. Planning, Forecasting, and Modeling •        Run planning cycles end to end: annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and ongoing variance analysis across a portfolio of clients. •        Build and maintain dynamic 1, 3, and 5-year models, including three-statement models, scenario analyses, and sensitivity tables. •        Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders. 3. CFO Pod Support and Client Coverage •        Serve as the primary analytical partner to Client CFOs across multiple engagements. •        Prepare materials and analysis ahead of board meetings, investor calls, and strategic planning sessions. •        Support client meetings alongside the CFO, and over time step into functional conversations with heads of marketing, supply chain, and operations as trust is built. •        Provide guidance and decision support on commercial questions including pricing, channel mix, inventory planning, and vendor terms. 4. Capital Markets and Strategic Support •        Support fundraising and M&A processes by building investor materials, data rooms, credit packs, and diligence support. •        Assist with capital allocation scenarios, cash runway planning, and lender and investor reporting packages. What we're looking for: Candidates must be comfortable working directly with CFOs and supporting multiple client engagements •        6 to 8 years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial operations, or corporate finance, with a track record of owning planning cycles and recurring reporting end to end. •        Senior FP&A or controllership-trained background. You are as comfortable with the integrity of the underlying data as with the model built on top of it. •        Prior experience in a multi-client or portfolio support role (fractional, consulting, PE operating, or multi-entity environment) is strongly preferred. •        Deep understanding of consumer business models including DTC, retail, omnichannel, and wholesale. •        Advanced financial modeling skills, including multi-year three-statement models and scenario analysis. •        Strong working knowledge of accounting principles (accrual vs. cash, revenue recognition, COGS treatment, inventory accounting). •        Experience with accounting platforms (QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Xero) and BI or reporting tools. •        Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive-ready insights and communicate with confidence to senior stakeholders. •        Bonus: strong experience with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) and automation platforms. •        Thrives in a lean, high-performance, distributed team environment. Send your CV and explain why you're fit for the role.

title: Remote Civil/Electrical Design Engineer — Site Civil, Stormwater & Mission-Critical Equipment Layout (U.S. Projects, U.S
job_title: Remote Civil/Electrical Design Engineer — Site Civil, Stormwater & Mission-Critical Equipment Layout (U.S. Projects, U.S
description: Good addition — but one scope judgment first, because it changes who you’re actually hiring. Stormwater/site-civil and mission-critical power are two different disciplines. A civil engineer’s legitimate role with generators, MV/HV gear, and 480V is the site/civil side: equipment pads and foundations, fuel storage and secondary containment (SPCC), spill berms around transformers, equipment-yard grading and drainage, MV/HV duct bank and conduit routing layouts, NEC/NESC working-clearance and access geometry, and delivery/laydown access roads. That’s real and worth requiring. What this person should not own is the electrical design — generator paralleling, switchgear sizing, load flow, and the MV-vs-480V topology. That’s electrical-EOR work and belongs in your MEP RFP track. Note for consistency: at 10 MW/site your campus distribution is MV (12.47 kV); 480V is the utilization/generator-output level, not the distribution backbone — so the posting should say “understands” 480V and MV equipment, not “designs the 480V distribution system.” If you want one offshore hire wearing both hats, the practical version is a dual-discipline design engineer/drafter who does civil site work and electrical CAD (one-lines, equipment layouts, duct banks) under separate civil-PE and electrical-PE direction. Here’s that posting: Job Posting (revised — copy/paste) Title: Remote Civil/Electrical Design Engineer — Site Civil, Stormwater & Mission-Critical Equipment Layout (U.S. Projects, U.S. Hours) About the role: We develop distributed digital-infrastructure (data center) campuses across rural Missouri. We need an experienced design engineer to produce site-civil, stormwater, and mission-critical equipment-siting deliverables for multiple ~5–50 acre campuses, each carrying standby generators, medium-voltage transformers, switchgear, and battery energy storage. Long-term, full-time, remote, working U.S. Central Time hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT), under the direction of U.S.-licensed civil and electrical PEs who review and seal all permit submittals. Responsibilities — Site Civil & Stormwater: • Grading, drainage, and site-development plans • Stormwater design: detention/retention basins, storm sewer, culverts, catch basins, hydraulic grade line checks • Pre/post-development runoff analysis (NRCS TR-55/TR-20, NOAA Atlas 14) • SWPPP and erosion/sediment control exhibits; earthwork and pipe sizing Responsibilities — Mission-Critical Equipment Siting (civil/layout scope): • Equipment pad and foundation layouts for standby generators, MV transformers, switchgear, and BESS units • Fuel storage siting and secondary/spill containment (SPCC) design • Equipment-yard grading, drainage, and oil-water separation around HV/transformer areas • MV/HV and 480V duct bank, conduit, and cable-trench routing layouts • NEC working clearances and NESC high-voltage clearance/access geometry; equipment delivery and laydown access roads • Production of equipment layout drawings and electrical one-line drafting under an electrical PE’s direction Nice to have: Data center / mission-critical / industrial site experience, Bluebeam Revu, GIS, U.S. county/state submittal sets, REVIT.

The users are real mechanics and service advisors with grease on their hands and no patience for clutter, so the work is about clarity and flow, not decoration. When you prove this is your thing, it becomes a permanent role, with you owning the look and feel of everything we build from then on. This is you - You have designed real B2B SaaS or web apps, and Figma feels like home. - You look at a cluttered, complicated screen and you actually enjoy finding the simple version hiding inside it. - You design for the person using the product, not to impress other designers, and you can explain the thinking behind a choice instead of just saying it looks better. - You have opinions, and you hold them lightly. description: ## Who I Am I'm Basit Oyebanji. In the last 18 months, I've collected over $2.7M in the online sales space. I run a group mentorship and a 1:1 intensive called The Haven Freedom Protocol — helping athletes and 9-5 workers earn 3-10k+/month online in 90 days or less. I'm not a guru with a microphone. I walked the path first. Now I coach people through it. I already have a full team running — SDR, content strategist, strategic advisor, calendar manager, and a creative director handling content systems. This isn't a one-man startup. It's a real operation being scaled intentionally. --- ## Why I'm Hiring You There's no dedicated long-form editor on the team yet. The YouTube channel is being built properly — and I need someone who actually understands what that means. This isn't "cut out the silences and add some music." Long-form is storytelling. It's retention. It's the thing that turns a stranger into a believer before they ever book a call. I need someone who feels the pacing, knows when to hold a ---------- nt and when to cut, and can make a 15-minute vlog feel like it flew past. The channel is young. That means whoever comes in now helps build the standard — not inherit someone else's template. --- ## What You'll Edit - **YouTube vlogs** — travel, training, behind-the-scenes (Cape Town, Barcelona, Miami, Lagos) - **Talking-head / whiteboard breakdowns** — sales frameworks, mindset, athlete-to-business mapping - **Podcast-style edits** — guest conversations, long-form interviews - **Cinematic, natural light, documentary feel** — not glossy ad, not flat studio --- ## What I Need From You - **You've edited long-form before.** YouTube, documentary, vlog — format doesn't matter as much as proof you can hold pacing across 10–20 minutes without losing people. - **You communicate cleanly.** If you're going to miss a deadline, you tell me *before* it's missed. Not after. - **You get the brief without it being repeated five times.** Watch the raw footage. Feel the story. Revision is refinement, not criticism. - **You're consistent.** Video 10 should be better than video 1 — not a coin flip. --- ## What Success Looks Like - **30 days** — first batch delivered on time. I hand you raw footage and trust it'll come back right. - **6 months** — you know the brand as well as anyone on the team. Proactively flagging what's working. The channel is compounding. --- ## How To Apply **? Apply here:** Long-Form Video Editor Application ---------- The form takes 8–10 minutes. Some questions will make you think — that's intentional. description: We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health niche, focused on building high-converting video ads for Meta. We sell bamboo compression products — knee sleeves, ankle braces, gloves and socks — primarily targeting customers aged 50+ across European markets. Our flagship product, DailyCompress, is a breathable bamboo knee sleeve with one key difference: it's designed to be worn through the night. Here's why that matters. While you sleep, blood flow to the knee slows right down — so the joint stays stiff, swells, and never fully recovers, which is exactly why mornings feel so painful and stiff. DailyCompress applies gentle, even compression all night long to keep circulation going, flush out fluid and waste, and ease swelling and inflammation while you rest. You wake up with a more supple, less painful knee. On top of that: a perfect fit for every body and a sleeve that genuinely stays in place — for a group of people most braces were never designed for, and never designed to be worn in bed. What we're really after (please read this carefully) This is the most important part of the role, so we'll be direct about it. Our biggest growth opportunity sits at the very top of the funnel — with cold, "unaware" and "problem-aware" audiences. These are people who feel knee pain and stiffness every single day, but who don't yet know what's actually causing it, and who have often never been diagnosed with anything. By far, this is our largest audience. That means our ads can't open by shouting "arthritis." The ---------- nt we name a diagnosis, we shrink our reach to the small group that already self-identifies. Instead, our best-performing ads: - Lead with a felt symptom or a relatable everyday ---------- nt (that first stiff step out of bed) - Reframe the problem by revealing a hidden cause the viewer never connected the dots on - Then bridge naturally to the solution, the proof, and the offer So we are specifically looking for an editor who can build long-form, top-of-funnel storytelling ads that educate and reframe — not just conversion edits for warm traffic. Our videos are getting longer, not shorter. The ability to hold a cold viewer's attention for 2–4+ minutes is the single most valuable skill you can bring to this role. This is a senior role — we are not looking for a beginner. We need an experienced editor who has already made videos exactly like this and can prove it, not someone still learning the craft on the job. If you're early in your editing journey, this won't be the right fit, and that's completely okay. What you'll be doing - Edit long-form VSL ads (2–4+ minutes) designed to take cold, unaware/problem-aware audiences from "I have knee pain" all the way to purchase in a single watch - Build narrative arcs: hook ? problem ? reframe ? solution ? proof ? CTA - Edit with strong pacing for retention (cuts every 2–4 seconds, B-roll layering, captions, motion graphics) - Work with clear customer avatars and structured creative briefs - Translate written scripts and angles into emotionally engaging videos What this role is NOT We are not looking for someone who just "cuts clips together." We're looking for someone who understands: - why a 3-minute ad keeps a cold viewer watching all the way to the end - how to layer B-roll, text, and music to build narrative tension across a longer story - which 5 seconds matter most (the hook) and how to make them stop the scroll - how pacing, captions, and visual rhythm affect retention and conversion - how to edit differently for someone who is unaware of the cause versus someone who is ready to buy Requirements - Senior-level experience — you've already edited multiple long-form/VSL ads that have actually run on Meta. This is not a junior or entry-level role - Proven experience editing VSL or long-form ad content for Meta (Facebook /Instagram) — please share examples - Strong skills in AI image and video generation — please share examples - Strong skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut Pro (mention which tools you master) - Solid understanding of direct response / performance marketing and awareness-stage thinking - Ability to work from scripts and turn them into engaging visual stories - Experience with captions, motion graphics, B-roll selection, and color grading - Ability to source or work with provided stock footage, UGC, and brand assets - Experience editing for the 50+ demographic is a strong plus - Experience in the health, wellness, or supplements niche is a big plus - Fluent English What we offer - Full-time position (8 hours per day) - Long-term opportunity in a fast-growing company - Clear systems, avatars, scripts and structured briefings - Room to grow with the brand - Direct collaboration with the creative strategist How to apply If you've read this carefully, start your message with the word "Editing" — applications that don't will be skipped. Then send us the following: 1. Three (3) long-form video ads you've edited that target unaware or problem-aware (top of funnel) audiences, each at least minutes long. This is the most important part of your application — we want to see how you hold a cold viewer's attention and build a problem-aware story over a longer runtime. 2. At least 3 realistic AI-generated scenes of older adults (50+) used for storytelling in video ads. 3. In a few sentences, tell us why you're the right fit for this specific role — what makes you strong at long-form, problem-aware storytelling for an older audience, and not just at editing footage. 4. Review our product: ---------- /bamboe-kniebrace 5. Based on this product, briefly describe: 1 long-form VSL concept (2–3 minutes) you would edit, with a short outline of the narrative arc, aimed at an unaware/problem-aware cold audience 6. Tell us your editing tools and your typical turnaround time per video. Thank you. Best regards, Ralph

job_title: Bookkeeper / Transaction Recorder — Luxury Watch Business
description: Majestix Collection is a premier destination for buying, selling, and trading luxury timepieces. We're looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper to accurately record every transaction that moves through our inventory — from the price we pay for a watch, through reconditioning and shipping, to the final sale and commission calculations. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys clean, accurate records and can follow a defined system without cutting corners. You'll be the single source of truth for our numbers, so precision and trustworthiness matter more than speed. What you'll do 1. Record what we pay for each watch Every watch enters through our Sell/Trade form, which automatically feeds into our MJX Sales Tracker (Google Sheets) under the "Submit and Shoot" tab. A thread is created for each watch in Zoho Cliq, where the amount paid is usually posted as a screenshot. You'll be tagged when a value is ready to record, and you'll log the purchase price in the correct row. 2. Record Shipping, reconditioning and parts costs When a watch is received and kept (not returned to the seller): Move its row from the "Submit and Shoot" tab into the "Stock and Sold" tab, placing it above the "Sold" section. Log the ship-in cost (we'll provide a rate sheet based on distance and insured value of the package). Log polish, service, and parts costs. Document what each cost is for using cell comments. When a single cost is made up of multiple components, use a formula (e.g. =value1+value2+value3) and describe each component in the cell comment. 3. Record the sale When a watch sells, the final numbers come from the platform invoice (eBay, Chrono24) or our own customer invoice — found in the sales thread (Zoho Cliq) or under Payments > Invoices. In the same row, record the initial amount we were paid. Record every fee involved in the sale — taxes, shipping, additional parts, platform fees, and so on. 4. Calculate the commisions Using the recorded numbers, calculate commissions for each tea ---------- mber — both in the MJX Sales Tracker and in each employee's personal commission sheet. This part of the role requires independence and discretion. You'll work directly with leadership and stay separate from the sales team, with no outside influence on the numbers. You'll have access to sensitive compensation data, so confidentiality and neutrality are non-negotiable. What we're looking for: Meticulous attention to detail and a genuine love for accurate, organized records Comfortable in Google Sheets — formulas, cell comments, and structured multi-tab workbooks Trustworthy and discreet; able to handle confidential financial and compensation data Able to follow a defined workflow consistently and flag anything that doesn't add up An independent worker who can stay objective and neutral Nice to have: Bookkeeping or accounting background Experience with Zoho Books or QuickBooks Familiarity with Zoho Cliq Experience with e-commerce or marketplace sales (eBay, Chrono24) To apply, please send the following. title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
job_title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.) This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone). Our Stack (you'll work across most of this) -Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps) -Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API) -Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation) -ActiveCampaign (automations, API) -Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run) -REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job -LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API) -WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code. -Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API) -Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments -Softr (client portal on top of Airtable) -Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation. What You'll Do -Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems) -Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability -Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google -Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings -Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post. 2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't. 3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.) 4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem? 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD. 6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning. If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: Growth Operations Manager

Required Skills & Experience ### Must-Have Experience * Shopify * Symprosis (Shopify Google Product Sync) * Google Tags / Google Tag Manager * Google Analytics * Meta Pixel * API Integrations * Reporting & Analytics * Troubleshooting technical issues * Working with dashboards and performance metrics ### Preferred Experience * Digital marketing agencies * Marketing automation platforms * CRM systems * Looker Studio * Zapier * Conversion tracking and attribution ## Who Will Succeed In This Role? You're likely a great fit if you: * Enjoy solving technical problems. * Are highly analytical and data-driven. * Can investigate issues and find root causes. * Are comfortable working with multiple software platforms. * Understand how tracking and integrations affect business performance. * Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people. * Stay organised while managing multiple client accounts. ## Compensation Please include: * Your desired monthly salary * Your availability * A summary of your relevant experience ## Application Instructions To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, please begin your application with: **"Data drives decisions."** Please also include: 1.
