title: AI Creative Operations Manager
description: Job Post: AI Creative Operations Manager Position: AI Creative Operations Manager / Technical Team Lead Location: Remote — Philippines Employment Type: Full-Time after a successful paid pilot Paid Pilot: 2 weeks — $400 USD flat project fee Full-Time Compensation: $1,500–$1,800 USD per month to start, depending on experience, with room for growth Company: Rudderr LLC This position is designed as a senior systems-builder and quality-control leader, not a general virtual assistant or entry-level graphic designer. The manager will build and operate a scalable AI-assisted content team, recruit and train junior editors, create repeatable workflows, and enforce strict product-accuracy standards. About Rudderr Rudderr is an e-commerce brand management and wholesale growth company that helps consumer brands expand across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Faire, and social media. We manage products across several categories, including outdoor and survival gear, home improvement, lawn and garden, wellness, beauty, and specialty consumer products. We are building an internal AI-assisted content production operation capable of producing high-quality product lifestyle images, short-form videos, and UGC-style content at scale. About the Role We are looking for an experienced AI Creative Operations Manager to build, lead, and manage our Philippines-based content production team. You will not be expected to create every image or video yourself. Your primary responsibility will be to build the people, systems, workflows, and quality-control process required to deliver accurate, realistic, and premium e-commerce content consistently. You will receive original product photography and creative direction from our U.S. team. You will then manage a team of junior AI image and video editors who transform those product photos into realistic lifestyle scenes, advertising assets, social media content, and short-form videos. Our most important standard is product fidelity. Logos, dimensions, materials, colors, proportions, accessories, controls, textures, and product features must remain accurate. Product distortion, invented features, incorrect branding, and visibly artificial imagery must be caught and corrected before delivery. Primary Responsibilities Build and Manage the Creative Team • Recruit and evaluate junior AI image editors, video editors, and creative production contractors. • Handle onboarding, training, performance reviews, coaching, and replacement of underperforming tea ---------- mbers. • Maintain sufficient staffing so content production does not stop when an editor becomes unavailable. • Assign work based on each editor’s skills, availability, and performance. • Build a reliable team capable of increasing or decreasing production based on demand. Build the Content Production System • Create repeatable workflows for AI-assisted product photography, lifestyle imagery, video, and synthetic UGC. • Develop SOPs, templates, prompt libraries, brand guidelines, file-naming systems, and quality-control checklists. • Establish a clear process from receiving original product photos through final asset approval. • Organize project files, source images, masks, models, prompts, revisions, and final exports. • Improve production speed without sacrificing product accuracy or visual quality. • Work toward a typical delivery time of approximately 24–48 hours for standard content requests. Own Quality Control • Review every asset before it reaches the U.S. team. • Enforce a zero-tolerance standard for distorted products, altered logos, incorrect colors, missing accessories, unrealistic shadows, and inconsistent proportions. • Check perspective, lighting direction, contact shadows, reflections, scale, resolution, texture, anatomy, and environmental realism. • Identify whether an asset can be corrected through inpainting, masking, compositing, relighting, regeneration, or manual Photoshop editing. • Train junior editors to recognize common AI generation errors. • Maintain consistency across image collections, recurring virtual models, brand campaigns, and product variations. Manage AI Image and Video Production • Oversee the creation of realistic lifestyle scenes using original product photography. • Ensure that the actual product remains accurate while environments, backgrounds, people, and scenarios are generated or composited around it. • Direct the creation of outdoor, camping, water-sports, home, wellness, and other product-specific lifestyle scenarios. • Manage short-form video production using still product images, generated environments, motion effects, and AI video tools. • Develop recurring virtual creators or product experts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, advertising, and educational content. • Ensure temporal consistency so products remain sharp and stable while backgrounds or surrounding elements move naturally. Manage Performance and Communication • Serve as the primary point of contact between Rudderr and the creative production team. • Translate creative requests into clear assignments for junior editors. • Track production volume, revision rates, approval rates, turnaround time, and editor performance. • Provide regular updates on project status, staffing, bottlenecks, and tool requirements. • Recommend workflow, staffing, and software improvements based on measurable results. • Manage software access and ensure company assets, trained models, and workflows remain organized and secure. title: Graphic Designer
description: We are a U.S.-based B2B industrial supply business looking for a graphic designer to support our ongoing e-commerce, marketing, and product documentation work. 1. Position Summary We need a graphic designer who can produce clean, industrial-style visual assets across multiple formats — enhanced product content, e-commerce listing imagery, website imagery, packaging, labels, infographics, and product documentation. Think 3M. Think Grainger. Think Uline. That is the visual register we work in: B2B industrial, utilitarian, spec-driven, durable-looking, function-first. Clean typography, technical illustration, performance claims front and center. This is not consumer retail — it is industrial supply. That said, the design sensibility must be contemporary, not dated. We want modern industrial — the way the best B2B brands look today, not how a 1990s parts catalog looked. Visuals should feel current and relevant to today's working professionals — millennials and Gen X buyers in their 30s through 50s who are the actual decision-makers in industrial purchasing. This is not a role for designers whose strongest work is lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wedding, or consumer-brand aesthetics. If your portfolio is built around pastels, soft-lifestyle photography, or "girly" branding, this is not your fit. The right candidate is equally comfortable producing an enhanced content banner for an e-commerce listing and laying out a print-ready box label with regulatory text, lot numbers, and barcode placement. 2. Scope of Work The designer will produce visual assets including: Enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery (product detail page modules, brand store imagery, hero banners) Website images and banners Product labels and box label design (print-ready, with regulatory and barcode placement) Box and packaging design Infographics for product features, specifications, and application guides Flyers, brochures, and sell sheets (digital and print) Safety Data Sheet (SDS) formatting and layout support Other ad-hoc graphic design work as needed 3. Required Skills & Experience Proven portfolio of industrial, B2B, MRO, hardware, or technical product design — please include examples Fluent in English — speaking, listening, and writing. You must be able to communicate effectively with us in real time, understand verbal direction clearly, and respond promptly in writing. This is non-negotiable. A real creative streak and a contemporary design sensibility. Your work should look current and modern — industrial, but not dated. We need someone who brings ideas to the table, not someone who only applies templates. Designs must resonate with today's working-age buyers (roughly 30s through 50s), not feel like a relic from a previous generation. Fluent with enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery requirements across major marketplaces (module structures, image specs, dimensions, file formats) Experience designing print-ready files (labels, packaging, brochures) with attention to bleed, color profiles, and dieline accuracy Strong typography and layout skills for dense, information-heavy content (specs, instructions, regulatory text) Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) or equivalent professional tools Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across assets To apply, please send over your resume and portfolio.

ClickUp Ownership & Workflow Management - Serve as the primary ClickUp administrator - you own the structure, hygiene, and integrity of the workspace. - Build and maintain detailed project plans, task assignments, timelines, and status updates for all active client projects. - Enforce task standards: every active task must have a due date, an owner, and a current status at all times. - Prioritize and sequence work across projects to prevent collisions and missed deadlines. - Identify and eliminate backlog aging - no overdue tasks older than 7 days without a documented escalation path. 2. Resource Allocation & Capacity Management - Monitor team capacity in real time using ClickUp and Everhour - flag imbalances before they become problems. - Ensure no tea ---------- mber is critically over- or under-allocated; proactively rebalance workload across the team. - Surface resourcing gaps to leadership with supporting data and a recommended solution (reallocation, contractor, or hire). - Track utilization trends to identify systemic capacity issues and inform hiring decisions. 3. Blocker Resolution & Risk Mitigation - Act as the first responder to identified blockers - escalation speed is a measured KRA. - Track average time from blocker identification to resolution; own the trend line. - Proactively surface risks to leadership before they impact client deliverables. - Maintain a documented escalation path for recurring issue types. 4. Process Development & Standardization - Develop, document, and enforce internal SOPs for recurring workflows and campaign types. - Build and maintain ClickUp templates that standardize how work gets set up across service lines. - Identify process inefficiencies through data and implement improvements with measurable outcomes. - Partner with service line leads to ensure process changes reflect operational realities. 5. Internal Communication & Team Alignment - Run regular internal standups and project syncs - keep them tight, action-oriented, and documented in ClickUp. - Serve as the connective tissue between service teams; eliminate silos that cause delivery failures. - Deliver clear task briefs and instructions so tea ---------- mbers can execute without ambiguity. - Provide leadership with accurate, timely status reports on project health, risks, and performance metrics. Required Qualifications - 3+ years of project management experience, preferably in a digital marketing agency or DTC ecommerce environment. - Expert-level proficiency in ClickUp: you must be able to demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise. This is non-negotiable. - Proficiency in Everhour or comparable time-tracking and capacity management tools. - Strong command of resource allocation principles; comfortable reading utilization data and making decisions from it. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills - you can write a clear brief, run a focused meeting, and escalate crisply. - Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects under tight deadlines without losing detail. - Analytical mindset: you track metrics, notice trends, and use data to drive decisions. Preferred Qualifications - Familiarity with digital marketing service lines: SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Email /Klaviyo. - Experience building or refining PM processes in a scaling agency environment. - PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification. What Success Looks Like at 90 Days - On-time task delivery rate is at or above 90?ross all active client projects. - ClickUp workspace hygiene is at 100%: every active task has a due date, owner, and status. - Zero tasks in backlog aging beyond 7 days without a documented escalation. - Capacity report is running bi-weekly; no tea ---------- mbers are flagged as critically over- or under-allocated. - Blocker-to-resolution time is documented and a baseline has been established for ongoing improvement. description: Job Title: Virtual Assistant / Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Beginner Friendly) About the Role I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help me with basic video editing for my TikTok Shop account. The tasks are super simple, and beginners are more than welcome to apply! I will provide the raw clips, and your job will be to make quick, basic edits to get them ready for posting. Responsibilities The two most important parts of this job are the following, and they should be your main focus with every video: 1. Cut out all dead space between clips. The videos need to be fast-paced and tight. Any pauses, gaps, or slow ---------- nts between clips must be removed so the viewer stays engaged from start to finish. Retention is everything on TikTok, and a well-paced edit is the number one priority. 2. Add plenty of overlays and photos throughout the video. You will be finding and inserting relevant images and overlays consistently throughout each video to keep the viewer visually stimulated and watching. The more engaging the visuals, the better. In addition to the above, you will also add a few brief onscreen text captions throughout the video to summarize key points. These do not need to be excessive — just enough to reinforce what is being said and help viewers who are watching without sound. Requirements The main technical requirement for this job is that you must have a smartphone capable of downloading and running TikTok Studio. All editing will be done using this specific app, which is completely free and very easy to use. No advanced editing experience is required, and beginners are absolutely fine! You just need to be willing to learn, follow simple instructions, and have a reliable internet connection to receive raw clips and upload the finished videos. Attention to detail is a must. To ensure you are reading this entire job post, at the subject of your application, put your favorite season of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job. Pay & Schedule The pay rate for this position is $4.00 USD per hour, paid weekly. You will be required to keep a timesheet logging your hours worked each day, which will be used to calculate your weekly payment. In terms of workload, I typically produce between 4 and 9 videos per day. The editing tasks are intentionally simple, so you should be able to comfortably complete around 4 videos per hour. On a typical day, this means the work will take you roughly 1 to 2.5 hours to complete. Workflow Raw video clips will be shared with you through a shared Google Drive folder. You will download the clips, edit them using TikTok Studio on your phone, and then re-upload the finished videos back to the same Google Drive folder. No complicated file-sharing tools — just a simple, straightforward process. All edited videos must be returned within 24 hours of receiving the raw clips. For example, if I send you the clips on Monday, I need them back by Tuesday. This turnaround time is essential so I can maintain a consistent daily posting schedule. Growth Opportunity This is not just a one-off project — I am looking for someone to grow with long-term. As my TikTok Shop continues to scale, there will be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and higher pay for the right person. If you are reliable, consistent, and take pride in your work, there is a real future here.

title: *Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig*
description: *Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig* Boutique Video Production Studio — New York *About the Role* We're a boutique video production studio based in New York City, specializing in corporate image films, brand documentaries, and event films — primarily for European companies operating in the US market. We're rebuilding our website, and we need someone who understands that a studio site isn't just a portfolio — it's a sales tool. Every page has a job to do: communicate who we are, build trust with a specific type of client, and move them toward picking up the phone. We're looking for a Web Designer who leads with structure and ends with craft. Someone who opens a new project by thinking about pages, user flow, and hierarchy — not colors and typefaces. The visual execution matters enormously, but it comes last. You'll work directly with the founder on a project basis, with potential for ongoing work as we grow. You'll own the design process from sitemap to handoff, working within Wix (or Webflow if you can make a case for it). Copy and video assets will be provided — your job is to make them land. *Who You Are* You understand the web as a medium, not a canvas. You think about scroll behaviour, states, responsiveness, and hierarchy the way a developer thinks about logic: it either works or it doesn't. You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives. *What You'll Do* You'll take ownership of the full website project from concept to launch — starting with strategy, not aesthetics. Before a single frame gets designed, you'll need to understand our brand, our clients, and our business goals. 1. Strategy & Concept • Develop the sitemap, define page hierarchy, and map out the user flow • Make deliberate structural decisions before moving into design • Understand what a service-based studio site needs to do commercially, not just visually 2. Design & Build • Design and build a 5–7 page website in Wix (including Wix Developer tools) or Webflow • Deliver fully responsive designs for both desktop and mobile — not just scaled-down versions of each other • Understand scroll behavior, interactive states, and responsiveness as logic problems, not just visual ones • Apply hierarchy the way a developer thinks: what loads first, what earns attention, what drives action 3. Conversion & SEO • Build a conversion-focused site that actively moves a visitor toward becoming a client • Implement proper SEO foundations from day one: meta titles, header structures, and technical configurations • Structure content and copy placement for both readability and search performance 4. Technical Setup • Handle hosting setup, domain transfer, and any migrations required • Deliver a clean handoff so the site is fully live and running from day one • Manage any technical configurations independently — no handholding needed *What We're Looking For* Required: • 3+ years specializing in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design • A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time • Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief • Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behavior, mobile-first thinking, and interactive states • Expert-level skills in either Wix (including Wix Developer / Velo) or Webflow — tell us which one and show us what you've built with it • A portfolio of live websites for service-based businesses or creative studios that shows process, not just final output • Clear, proactive communicator in English — you flag problems early and ask the right questions *How to Apply* Send us the following: • Your portfolio — live websites only. We're not interested in Dribbble shots, unsolicited redesigns, or graphic design work. Show us websites you actually shipped. • 1–2 case studies that walk us through your process: how you structured the site, the thinking behind the page hierarchy, and how the final design connects back to the brief. The thinking matters as much as the output. Bonus points if any of them are for a creative studio, production company, or service-based business. • A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, your platform of choice (Wix or Webflow), and your rate for a project like this. Compensation • $400–600 flat project fee for the full website (5–7 pages), depending on complexity and experience • Ongoing retainer available for post-launch support, updates, and maintenance — billed hourly at a rate we agree on upfront We're looking for the best fit, not the cheapest option. If your work is strong and your process is solid, we're open to discussing rate.

description: Job Title: Virtual Assistant / Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Beginner Friendly) About the Role I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help me with basic video editing for my TikTok Shop account. The tasks are super simple, and beginners are more than welcome to apply! I will provide the raw clips, and your job will be to make quick, basic edits to get them ready for posting. Responsibilities The two most important parts of this job are the following, and they should be your main focus with every video: 1. Cut out all dead space between clips. The videos need to be fast-paced and tight. Any pauses, gaps, or slow ---------- nts between clips must be removed so the viewer stays engaged from start to finish. Retention is everything on TikTok, and a well-paced edit is the number one priority. 2. Add plenty of overlays and photos throughout the video. You will be finding and inserting relevant images and overlays consistently throughout each video to keep the viewer visually stimulated and watching. The more engaging the visuals, the better. In addition to the above, you will also add a few brief onscreen text captions throughout the video to summarize key points. These do not need to be excessive — just enough to reinforce what is being said and help viewers who are watching without sound. Requirements The main technical requirement for this job is that you must have a smartphone capable of downloading and running TikTok Studio. All editing will be done using this specific app, which is completely free and very easy to use. No advanced editing experience is required, and beginners are absolutely fine! You just need to be willing to learn, follow simple instructions, and have a reliable internet connection to receive raw clips and upload the finished videos. Attention to detail is a must. To ensure you are reading this entire job post, at the subject of your application, put your favorite season of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job. Pay & Schedule The pay rate for this position is $4.00 USD per hour, paid weekly. You will be required to keep a timesheet logging your hours worked each day, which will be used to calculate your weekly payment. In terms of workload, I typically produce between 4 and 9 videos per day. The editing tasks are intentionally simple, so you should be able to comfortably complete around 4 videos per hour. On a typical day, this means the work will take you roughly 1 to 2.5 hours to complete. Workflow Raw video clips will be shared with you through a shared Google Drive folder. You will download the clips, edit them using TikTok Studio on your phone, and then re-upload the finished videos back to the same Google Drive folder. No complicated file-sharing tools — just a simple, straightforward process. All edited videos must be returned within 24 hours of receiving the raw clips. For example, if I send you the clips on Monday, I need them back by Tuesday. This turnaround time is essential so I can maintain a consistent daily posting schedule. Growth Opportunity This is not just a one-off project — I am looking for someone to grow with long-term. As my TikTok Shop continues to scale, there will be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and higher pay for the right person. If you are reliable, consistent, and take pride in your work, there is a real future here.

We compensate our team competitively, invest in their development, and have a strong track record of long-term retention. Our tea ---------- mbers stay—and we’re proud of that. ROLE OVERVIEW We’re hiring our first Virtual Medical Scheduler: a remote, full-time hire who will serve as the first voice our patients hear. This is a high-volume, detail-critical scheduling role supporting a dermatology practice that handles 400–500 incoming calls per week across our appointment lines. This isn’t a vague support role. It’s a focused, essential function: answer calls, schedule patients accurately, enter the right insurance information into our practice management system, and represent Vista Dermatology with warmth and professionalism on every single interaction. If we hire well, we intend to hire a second virtual scheduler shortly after, and we’re committed to making this a stable, long-term position with a clear compensation path and real professional investment over time. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY This role requires consistent, predictable availability. Our phones open at a set time each morning, and our patients expect someone to be there. - Hours: 7:45 AM – 4:15 PM, Monday through Friday (40 hours/week) - Time Zone: Central Time (US) - Lunch break: 12:15 PM – 12:45 PM (30 minutes) - The 7:45 AM start allows time to review email s, check messages, and be ready before calls begin - Phones close to active callers at 4:00 PM; the final 15 minutes are used to close out to-do lists and contact the manager with any remaining questions - Attendance is non-negotiable — this is the first point of contact for our patients - Tardiness policy: notify the office manager by phone at least 10 minutes before your start time if late; no more than 2 late arrivals per rolling 30-day period - Punctuality is treated as a core professional standard, not a preference WHAT YOU'LL DO Your day will be primarily driven by live call volume, with additional responsibilities added incrementally as you become proficient. Tasks are prioritized in the following order: 1. Live Scheduling Calls (Primary Responsibility) - Answer 200–300+ inbound scheduling calls per week with professionalism and warmth - Collect accurate patient demographic, insurance, and appointment information - Enter all information correctly into our EMA (Modernizing Medicine/ModMed) practice management system; this is the first entry point of the patient chart - Verify insurance eligibility using our credentialing grid (updated regularly; the most current version must always be used) - Send patients the correct intake paperwork and obtain required credit card authorizations - Follow each scheduling step consistently and in order — every time, without skipping steps - Transfer calls appropriately when a patient has a clinical question outside the scope of scheduling 2. Online Scheduling Support (Added After Proficiency) - Process online scheduling requests and messages submitted through the patient portal - Manage online scheduling queue after demonstrating consistency on live calls 3. Voi cemail & Reschedule Callbacks (Added After Proficiency) - Return voi cemail messages within a strict callback window - Handle reschedule requests and cancellations professionally 4. Fax & Referral Processing (Added After Proficiency) - Process incoming fax referrals and scheduling records from outside providers WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR This role is not high-level complexity, but it demands a very specific kind of person. The work that looks deceptively simple on paper consistently separates strong performers from those who don’t make it past week two. You're a fit if you: - Have excellent spoken and written English — clarity and professionalism are non-negotiable - Type 50–70 words per minute with high accuracy - Are calm, patient, and consistent even during high call volume - Are naturally detail-oriented and take following a process seriously - Can sit at a computer for extended periods and navigate modern software with ease - Value stability and doing one thing excellently - Have a computer-comfortable background: past work in data entry, sales systems, student platforms, or similar computer-heavy environments - Understand that accuracy matters more than speed in the early stages - Are comfortable working during U.S. Central Time business hours This Role Is NOT a Fit If You: - Thrive on constant variety and creative problem-solving - Prefer physical, hands-on work environments - Have difficulty sitting attentively at a computer for a full workday - Are looking for a steppingstone to a different kind of role quickly - Are not comfortable with detailed, step-by-step processes that must be followed precisely - Have limited experience with modern computer systems or software TOOLS & SYSTEMS YOU'LL WORK WITH You do not need prior experience with these specific platforms, but you must be comfortable and confident with modern computer systems. Our staff has consistently found that tech-savvy individuals pick up our systems quickly. - ModMed (EMA / Modernizing Medicine): our all-in-one electronic health record, scheduling, and practice management system - Klara: HIPAA-compliant secure messaging with patients - RingCentral: our phone system (call volume is monitored and reviewed weekly) - Gusto: payroll and time tracking - Insurance Credentialing Grid: must be reviewed and used on every scheduling call; updated regularly - HIPAA compliance is expected in all digital communications: all patient information is protected health information (PHI) TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS Because this is a remote, HIPAA-regulated role, your home setup must meet the following minimum standards before your start date: Internet & Connectivity - Minimum 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload speeds (25 Mbps preferred for video) - A direct Ethernet (LAN) cable connection is strongly preferred over Wi-Fi for maximum stability - A backup internet source is required Hardware & Software - PC with at least Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 processor and 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred) - Operating system: Windows 10/11 or macOS 12+ - HD webcam (minimum 720p) for video check-ins - High-quality noise-canceling headset — critical for clear communication and patient privacy - A secure, enterprise-grade VPN and antivirus software to meet HIPAA requirements - Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure (our EHR is fully cloud-based) - Familiarity with HIPAA-compliant communication platforms (e.g., Zoom for Healthcare, Microsoft Teams, Slack) Environment - Quiet, distraction-free workspace - Secure physical environment appropriate for handling protected health information (PHI) TRAINING & ONBOARDING We take onboarding seriously. We’ve grown quickly and trained several rounds of employees, and we’ve developed a structured onboarding approach that sets people up for success. We’ll apply a similar approach for our first virtual hire. - Week 1: Observational training — watching and learning alongside an experienced tea ---------- mber; ModMed video tutorials; meeting with office manager at end of week - Week 2: Graduated training — practicing scheduling with live supervision; check-in with office manager at end of week - Weeks 3–12: Increasing independence on calls; weekly touchpoints and performance reviews throughout - Day 90: Formal performance review with the office manager Our experience is consistent: those who adapt to the system do so quickly. Those who don’t fit the role make that clear in the first one to two weeks. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS We believe the best way to reward great work is through a strong, reliable hourly rate with clear raises you can count on as you grow with us. We’ll define a formal title progression (Scheduler I, Scheduler II, Scheduler III) tied to tenure, performance metrics, and peer feedback, so you’re always advancing—even when the work itself stays consistent. Months 1–3 (Onboarding): $6.00/hour Months 4–6: $6.50/hour Months 7–12: $7.00/hour Year 2: $7.50–$8.00/hour (based on performance review) Year 3+: $8.50+/hour (based on performance review) Every step up is tied to performance. Show up consistently, handle calls with care, and follow the process, and the raises will follow. We want you to see exactly what you’re working toward. Additional Benefits - 13th Month Bonus: One additional month’s salary paid at year-end (a standard Philippine benefit we are proud to honor) - Annual healthcare allowance: $432/year - Performance bonuses tied to call volume and quality metrics - Equipment & connectivity stipend: available after 12 months of strong performance (a reward for loyalty and consistency, not a day-one entitlement) - Payroll processed twice monthly via Gusto Time Off Full-time employees (30+ hours/week) earn paid time off based on hours worked: - Years 1–2: PTO accrues at 3.08 hours per 80 hours worked (10 days/year) - Years 2–4: PTO accrues at 4.61 hours per 80 hours worked (15 days/year) - Year 5+: PTO accrues at 5.84 hours per 80 hours worked (19 days/year) In addition, 6 paid U.S. holidays are observed each year: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. Combined with PTO, total paid days off are 16 per year (years 1–2), 21 per year (years 2–4), and 25 per year (year 5+). - PTO begins accruing on your start date but may not be used until after the 180-day probationary period - PTO must be requested at least 4 weeks in advance (28 days); sick leave follows a separate process COMMUNICATION & SUPERVISION We use a structured, transparent management approach. You will never feel like you’re working alone without direction or feedback. - Weekly check-ins with the office manager throughout your first 90 days - Formal semi-annual performance reviews - For urgent scheduling questions during your shift: contact the supervising Medical Assistant via RingCentral - For non-urgent issues: email the office manager at any time - For face-to-face conversations or screen sharing: Google Meet - Performance tracked weekly via RingCentral (call volume) and ModMed (scheduling activity) We are an approachable team. We’d rather you ask a question than handle something incorrectly, especially when it comes to insurance data and patient communication. When in doubt, ask. Always. WHY THIS ROLE MIGHT BE PERFECT FOR YOU You’re not just filling a seat, you are Vista Dermatology’s first impression. You’re the voice our patients hear before they ever meet a physician or step into a treatment room. That means something. If you’re someone who finds deep satisfaction in doing one thing really well, in being the dependable constant in a busy medical practice, and in knowing that your work directly contributes to patient care—this role was made for you. We offer stability, growth, real professional investment, and a team that will treat you as a valued member, not a remote resource. We’re looking for someone who wants to stay, to grow within this role, and to be part of building something lasting. If you pass this first round, we will send you a few follow up assessments. The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then finally a live face-to-face interview. Then we will make our final decision. It is not mandatory to have them completed but it will improve your chances of moving along in the process. We’re excited to find the right person — and when we do, we intend to invest in them for the long haul. — The Vista Dermatology Team

description: WISE SCOUT Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA Remote · Full-Time About Wise Scout Wise Scout is a recruitment firm that helps small and growing businesses find and hire exceptional remote talent, primarily in the Philippines. We're a small, tight-knit team that does meaningful work: we match the right people with the right opportunities and help businesses build teams they're genuinely proud of. We're a caring, lighthearted team that believes work should be purposeful but not all-consuming. We care about our families, our people, and doing things well. If you've ever wanted to be part of a company where you're treated as a person first — this is that place. We're growing, and this hire is a critical next step. The person who steps into this role won't just support the work, they'll help shape how we operate and eventually build a team of their own. Role Overview We're looking for a Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA to be the operational engine behind Wise Scout's hiring pipelines and client relationships. This is a role for someone who loves moving things forward; who sees a task and gets it done without waiting to be told twice. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our recruitment process: setting up client meetings, building assessment pipelines, posting jobs, filtering candidates, tracking progress, and keeping clients informed every step of the way. You'll also support internal HR for our staff and jump into client-facing calls when needed. This isn't a role where you'll wait for perfect instructions. We have processes — many of them — but they're still being refined. You'll need to be comfortable stepping into some ambiguity, figuring out what the next step is, and moving forward. If that excites you, you'll thrive here. Schedule & Availability This role requires meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours, as client meetings and internal team calls happen in U.S. time zones. At least half of your working hours must be available during U.S. business hours in the Central time zone. During busy weeks, around a quarter of your hours will be spent in the U.S. Central time afternoons (between 12-4am PHT) Weekly all-hands meeting with the full Wise Scout team (Tuesdays 2pm CST/3am PHT) Weekly operational sync with Abby to drive hiring pipelines forward Schedule is otherwise flexible; we trust you to manage your time and deliver results What You'll Own This role is broad but focused. Here are the five core areas you'll be responsible for: 1. Client Communication & Relationship Management Set up and schedule intro calls with new clients; follow up with meeting notes, to-dos, and next steps Maintain consistent, professional communication with clients throughout the hiring process Send follow-up check-ins over days and weeks to stay top of mind with prospective clients Represent Wise Scout warmly and confidently in email and on video calls Potentially run intro meetings and hiring calls with clients independently over time 2. Hiring Pipeline Management Build and manage assessment pipelines in Criteria Corp for each active role Write experience questionnaires: self-assessment quizzes designed to quantify a candidate's background through how they answer, not just what they say Post job descriptions across multiple job boards Download and score applicants in spreadsheets; filter to top candidates based on scores and answers Move candidates through each stage of the pipeline with clear documentation and communication 3. Recruitment Reporting & Tracking Maintain a master tracking spreadsheet showing all open roles, current stage, and time-in-process for each Upload data and report regularly to leadership on pipeline health: how many applicants, who's moving forward, and where things stand Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between steps or between client touchpoints 4. Job Description Writing Use AI tools (and interview notes) to draft compelling, accurate job descriptions for each client role Collaborate with John and Abby to refine and finalize before posting 5. Internal HR & Staff Support Check in regularly with Wise Scout's internal staff to gauge workload, morale, and needs Answer basic technical questions about Slack, ---------- , and other internal tools Track team hours in ---------- , compile timesheets, and submit payroll through ---------- Support onboarding of new hires as the team grows What We're Looking For Skills and tools can be taught. What we can't teach is the right wiring. Here's what that looks like for this role: You're a Fit If You: Are self-directed; you see what needs to happen next, and you do it Love checking things off a list and moving tasks forward without being prompted Are detail-oriented without being paralyzed by perfectionism — 90% shipped beats 100% stuck Communicate openly and confidently, both in writing and on video calls Are comfortable making mistakes and talking about them honestly, so the team can move on Solve problems independently; you Google it, look at how it was done before, and figure it out Enjoy understanding the whole process, not just your piece of it Can hold a lot of moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball This Role Is NOT a Fit If You: Need clear, step-by-step instructions for everything before you can act Are uncomfortable with ambiguity or imperfect processes Avoid difficult conversations or are reluctant to give or receive direct feedback Struggle to communicate confidently with clients or leadership Get overwhelmed when managing multiple tasks or clients at once Tools You'll Work With You must arrive proficient in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Gmail. Everything else can be learned on the job. Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Meet (must-have on day one) Slack: internal team communication Criteria Corp: assessment and hiring pipeline tool (we'll train you) ---------- : time tracking for internal staff QuickBooks Online: bookkeeping and invoicing (light exposure helpful) ---------- : payroll and payments AI writing tools: to assist with job descriptions, email s, and candidate summaries Fathom or similar AI note takers: for meeting documentation What This Role Does NOT Include To be clear about scope: No marketing, social media, or content creation No image design or creative work No bookkeeping or accounting responsibility Your First 90 Days We don't expect perfection on day one. Here's roughly what the arc looks like: Week 1: Learn our tools, processes, and active client roster; shadow existing pipelines; get familiar with our communication style and documentation Month 1: Take ownership of client communication for existing roles; begin building and managing assessment pipelines with guidance Month 2: Run pipeline reporting independently; begin drafting job descriptions and experience questionnaires with light review Month 3: Fully own your client relationships and hiring pipelines; begin joining or running client calls; formal performance review at 90 days We meet regularly throughout; you won't be left guessing. As Wise Scout grows, so does this position. The person who excels here will have the opportunity to move into a team leadership role, eventually managing a small team of their own that supports the full client roster. That means more responsibility, more compensation, and a real career path — not just a job. We're not looking for someone to plug a gap. We're looking for someone to grow with us for the long haul. If you're still here in three years, we want you to look back and say this was one of the best decisions you ever made. title: CSR
description: Firehouse Pest - CSR (VA) Firehouse Pest Control Services, a locally owned and operated pest control company serving the Phoenix, AZ area, is looking for a proactive virtual customer service representative with strong communication and sales skills to join our growing team. As one of the first points of contact for current and prospective customers, you'll play an integral role in shaping their experience with our company, making you a highly valued member of our staff. Your responsibilities include answering inbound calls promptly and professionally, scheduling pest control appointments, managing leads and online inquiries with timely follow-ups, handling billing questions and entering customer data into our CRM system. You'll also support our outreach efforts by making outbound calls to warm leads including referrals from our home inspection division, connecting with existing customers and working to generate new business from provided lead lists. This role is an even mix of inbound and outbound sales and customer service and it gives you the chance to make a direct impact on company growth while earning commission on any new business you bring in. One thing we want to mention upfront: we ask that this position be your primary professional commitment. We have established processes, clear communication channels and a team that's ready to set you up for success and we want someone who is equally committed to showing up and doing the same for our customers. If you're looking to join a team where you can make a real impact while building your skills in sales and customer service, we'd love to talk with you about this position. For more information, please visit our website at ---------- . Responsibilities at a glance Answer inbound calls promptly and professionally and provide an outstanding customer experience Make outbound calls to warm leads including referrals from our home inspection division Schedule pest control appointments and add jobs to the service schedule as needed Follow up on inbound leads and online inquiries in a timely manner Handle billing questions and collect payments accurately Ensure accurate and detailed data entry in our CRM systems Reconnect with existing customers to upsell additional services when appropriate Reach out to provided lead lists to generate new business Handle customer concerns professionally and escalate to management when needed Maintain a positive, helpful attitude that supports customer satisfaction and retention Requirements Available to work Monday through Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST with flexibility for Saturday coverage when needed Saturday availability is required - candidates who are not able to work Saturdays should not apply Previous customer service and sales experience required Must be able to communicate clearly and professionally in English in a way that is easily understood by our customers Familiarity with CRM and sales tools - experience with GoHighLevel and GorillaDesk is a plus Comfortable working across multiple communication platforms including Slack Highly organized with strict attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment Proactive problem-solver with the ability to adapt to changing priorities and work independently with minimal supervision This must be your primary place of employment - candidates juggling multiple jobs or clients will not be considered Application Instructions To be considered for this position, all applicants must submit a short audio or video recording along with their application. In your recording, please introduce yourself and explain: • Why you are interested in this position • Why you believe you would be a great fit for Firehouse Pest Control • Any relevant customer service, sales, or virtual assistant experience you have • What excites you most about working with our team The recording does not need to be professionally produced. Important: Applications submitted without an audio or video recording will not be reviewed or considered. Because communication is a critical part of this role, only candidates who follow these instructions and provide a recording will move forward in the hiring process. About Us Firehouse Pest Control Services is a locally owned and operated pest control company serving residential and commercial customers in the Phoenix area. We're a team that values doing things right, from the way we answer the phone to the way we show up for our customers. title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 + $50 per show-up
description: Please just send us any message if you’re interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form. Why strong setters join us We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real. 01 — Uncapped earning potential Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there’s no ceiling on what you can earn each month. 02 — Experienced leadership that develops you You’ll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what’s working, coach on what isn’t, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow. 03 — A supportive, high-performing team We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You’ll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth. Compensation — paid every week via Wise Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — every one, on top of the base Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month The status bonus — how it works: Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads. Hit 12 = 10% Hit 16 = 15% Hit 20 = 20% The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an extra ~$375/month. At Gold level, that’s an extra ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base and per-appointment pay. Working hours 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET) That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT). This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment. Onboarding Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident. To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we’ll be coaching you throughout to help you get there. What you’ll actually do Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services. Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote. Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically. Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day. Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work. Who we’re looking for 2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling. A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller. Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation. Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset. Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline. What you’re walking into A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You’ll know exactly what’s expected, exactly what you’ll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term. Ready to apply? If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out

title: Soccer Match Video Calibration Specialist

We're looking for a careful, detail-oriented person to calibrate match videos in our web-based tool. This is the step that makes our analytics accurate, so precision and consistency are everything. What you'll do: Open assigned soccer match videos in our browser-based calibration tool (we give you a login). Basic soccer familiarity is a plus (you know what a kickoff, halftime, center circle, and penalty box are), but not required — our guide explains everything. Nice to have: experience with data labeling, image annotation, tagging, or similar detail work.

title: Accounting Lead – Systems Migration
description: About MAVI MAVI is an AI-powered finance and accounting talent platform that connects exceptional global professionals with high-growth US companies. Built by leaders with experience at Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank, MAVI goes beyond traditional recruiting. We build long-term partnerships between talented accounting professionals and companies transforming the future of finance. As a professional placed through MAVI, you receive support throughout the entire journey—from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding, integration, and long-term career growth. This opportunity is part of one of MAVI’s largest and most established client engagements. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Accounting Lead – Systems Migration to lead the accounting and financial data work involved in ERP and accounting system migrations for high-growth US companies. This is not primarily a software configuration role. It is a hands-on accounting leadership role focused on ensuring that historical financial information is accurately transferred from legacy accounting platforms into a modern ERP system. You will take ownership of the accounting integrity of each migration, including data extraction, mapping, validation, reconciliations, discrepancy resolution, and go-live readiness. You will work with real financial data, collaborate with US-based finance teams, and help guide migration projects from initial data assessment through successful implementation. Your work will directly determine whether every balance, transaction, account, vendor, customer, and reporting field is complete, accurate, and ready for use in the new system. What You’ll Do -Lead the accounting workstream across ERP and financial system migration projects -Extract historical financial data from accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Xero, Sage, and similar platforms -Review, clean, organize, and map financial data to the new general ledger, chart of accounts, entity, and reporting structure -Prepare and execute journal entry, trial balance, opening balance, and historical transaction uploads -Map accounts, vendors, customers, departments, classes, locations, entities, and other relevant accounting dimensions -Upload and validate bills, invoices, contracts, and supporting accounting schedules -Reconcile financial data between legacy accounting systems and the new ERP -Perform detailed reconciliations across cash, accounts Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language. Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns. Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next. Creative Performance Analysis Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type. Identify why certain ads are working or not working. Use performance data to inform future creative briefs. Track winning patterns across accounts. Help build a repeatable creative testing system. Client-Facing Communication Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed. Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction. Strong written and spoken English is required. You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos. Requirements You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy. You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns. You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager. You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute. You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning. You must have excellent written and spoken English. You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy. You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts. We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role. Nice to Have Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories. Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators. Experience writing UGC scripts. Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel. Experience working inside an agency. Compensation Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level. Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis. Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month. If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus. Hiring Process: Step 1: Application You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work. Step 2: Level 1 Test If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test. Step 3: Interview If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview. description: Long-term role with a family-run Queensland agribusiness Engagement Part-time to start (4 hrs/day), scaling to full-time for the right person Hours Some overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) preferred Reports to Business owner Software Xero (new file setup + ongoing) Start As soon as the right candidate is found About us We are a family-run agribusiness in rural Queensland, Australia, running several enterprises under one roof. Our main business is a paddock-to-plate meat operation selling Wagyu and premium beef direct to customers at markets and online. Alongside this we run cattle, produce hay, do contract farm work, and make a natural tallow-based skincare range. Because we have several income streams, we need someone who can keep our books clean and accurate, and show us clearly how each part of the business is performing. We are looking for one reliable, long-term person to take ownership of our bookkeeping and tax work so we can focus on running the farm. The role You will take over all of our day-to-day bookkeeping and tax-related work. The first big job is setting up a brand-new Xero file and moving us across from our current system. After that, you keep everything reconciled, GST-coded correctly, and ready for our Business Activity Statements (BAS) and end-of-year tax. Important: all BAS and tax documents are reviewed and signed off by the owner before lodgement. You prepare; we approve. What you will do • Set up a brand-new Xero file from scratch and manage the changeover from our current system — chart of accounts, opening balances, bank feeds and contacts. • Structure the accounts so each income stream (meat, cattle, hay, contract work, skincare) can be reported separately for both income and expenses — using Xero tracking categories. • Process and reconcile all bank transactions across multiple accounts. • Handle Australian GST correctly. Most of our food/meat sales are GST-free, while many of our supplier purchases include GST that we can claim back. You apply the right GST code to every transaction. • Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) and supporting tax documents for the owner to review and lodge. • Produce regular reports — profit & loss by enterprise, GST position and cash position — so we can see how each part of the business is tracking. • Maintain accurate records for end-of-year tax and liaise with our Australian accountant when needed. • Flag any errors, odd transactions or discrepancies early. We value someone who flags problems rather than hiding them. Must have • Solid hands-on experience setting up and running Xero (Xero certification / ProAdvisor is a strong plus). • Good understanding of GST and the difference between GST-free sales and GST-inclusive purchases — or a strong tax background and the ability to learn the Australian system quickly. • A bookkeeping or accounting qualification, with real experience keeping books for businesses. • Strong attention to detail and accuracy — this matters more to us than speed. • Reliable internet, your own computer, and good written English. • Honesty and discretion handling confidential financial information. Nice to have • Experience with Australian clients, BAS preparation, or the Australian tax system. • Experience with multi-enterprise, farming or primary-production accounts. • Confidence using Xero tracking categories for departmental / enterprise reporting. Why work with us • Long-term, stable role with room to grow your hours and responsibility. • Real ownership of the books — you run the system, not just data entry. • A friendly, straightforward team that values accuracy and clear communication. How to apply To apply, please send the following. Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it tells us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly. 1. Your CV / resume. 2. A short note on your Xero experience and whether you are Xero-certified. 3. Your experience (if any) with Australian tax / GST / BAS. 4. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available. Please also answer these three quick questions in your application: • In Xero, how would you set up the file so that income and expenses can be reported separately for several different parts of one business? (One or two sentences is fine.) • If a sale is GST-free but the supplier invoice for that product included GST, how do you treat each side in the books? • Have you prepared a BAS before, or worked with Australian GST? If not, how comfortable are you learning a new tax system? Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

This is a part-time role to start, with a path to full-time for the right person. What you will do Your main tasks will include: * Uploading and scheduling TikTok and Instagram posts * Posting content from our internal content studio * Using our posting software to manage multiple accounts * Making sure each post goes out on time * Checking that posts actually went live * Marking posts as posted in our tracking system * Using captions that are already written, and sometimes making small caption edits * Adding hashtags when needed * Choosing the correct sounds for TikTok and Instagram posts * Organizing content files in Google Drive and spreadsheets * Reporting errors, failed posts, account issues, or anything that looks wrong * Checking account health and making sure accounts stay active * Occasionally scrolling TikTok/Instagram to understand trends, sounds, and account behavior * Following clear SOPs and checklists carefully You will be using tools like TikTok, Instagram, ---------- , Google Drive, spreadsheets, and our internal content studio. Who this is for This role is a good fit if you are: * Very detail-oriented * Reliable and consistent * Good at following instructions * Comfortable doing repetitive tasks accurately * Fast to report problems instead of hiding mistakes * Good with checklists, spreadsheets, and content systems * Comfortable working with TikTok and Instagram * Interested in social media, short-form content, and growing accounts * Hungry to learn and prove yourself Experience with social media management is a plus, but it is not required if you are sharp, careful, and willing to learn. Schedule We are starting with around 15 hours per week. The ideal schedule is a few hours per day with some overlap with European daytime hours. This will likely be afternoon/evening time in the Philippines. There may also be some light weekend work, since posts need to go out on weekends too. This will be discussed clearly before starting. Pay This is a paid part-time role. We will start with a 2-week paid trial. If the trial goes well, this can become a long-term part-time role, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time Content Operations Manager role as we scale. There may also be monthly bonuses when the content operation performs well and posts are managed properly. Important qualities Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with detailed operational work. This role requires accuracy. Small mistakes can create problems, for example: * Posting the wrong video to the wrong account * Missing a scheduled posting time * Forgetting to check if a post went live * Using the wrong caption or sound * Not reporting an issue quickly * Not following the checklist We of course know that mistakes can me made, which is normal, but  it is important to  handle the mistakes properly and  make sure that it doesn't happen again. What We Are Looking For Strong written and verbal English communication Experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, healthcare administration or virtual assistance Highly organised and detail-focused Able to work quickly and calmly when roster changes occur Confident communicating with staff and managers Able to follow instructions and escalate issues appropriately Comfortable using spreadsheets, email , online systems and shared folders Reliable, proactive and able to work independently Strong follow-up skills and ability to manage competing priorities Trustworthy with confidential client and staff information ## Preferred Experience Previous experience in NDIS, disability support, aged care, healthcare or home care rostering Experience using ShiftCare, Brevity, CareMaster, Deputy, Employment Hero, Visualcare, Lumary or similar systems Experience working with Australian businesses or clients Understanding of support worker scheduling, client preferences and continuity of care Experience with timesheets, shift notes, cancellations and service delivery administration Experience working remotely with distributed teams ## What Success Looks Like In the first 30 days, you will understand our clients, support workers, systems, rostering process and communication standards. In the first 60 days, you will be confidently updating rosters, confirming shifts, managing staff availability, identifying gaps and supporting care managers with scheduling needs. In the first 90 days, you will be helping improve rostering accuracy, reduce missed shifts, strengthen communication and create smoother workforce coordination across the business. ## Why Join Us You will be joining a growing Australian healthcare and disability support business with a strong focus on quality service delivery, responsiveness and operational improvement. title: Passionate Mid/Senior Python Developer
description: Are you passionate about Python and becoming the best developer you can become? Let’s team up. We believe in people. This is why we only work with clients who serve people. From firefighters, to law firms, to suppliers sending life-saving food to kids dying of malnutrition, the code you write will help make the world a better place. Our team is made up of people who want to do the best work of their life. People who love to learn, challenge themselves, grow and have some fun along the journey. We also care about each other – we support each other in our own personal goals and vision. We are human beings before employees and we love to bring out the best in each other. Now, ready to learn more about this opening? Buckle up. If you work here, you’ll be: - Challenged to do the best work of your life in a supportive environment. - Become the best communicator you can become (this is the most important thing we do). - Have the space to ask questions, voice your feedback and make a difference (and be yourself). - Help expand our codebase and tools, participate in code reviews, and grow with your fellow developers. You’ll do well in this job if you: - Have a strong background in Python and understand HTML, CSS and Javascript enough to be dangerous. - Enjoy working with people who actually care about what they do and will not let you be lazy or do sloppy work. - Have an opinion and care about best practices and love learning and creating and building. - Are familiar with common things we deal with as developers: Git, SQLAlchemy, building and engaging with APIs, linters, etc. - Have grit and determination and are someone who will exceed no matter what gets in your way. - Are attentive to details. - Have 3+ years of Python development experience. You probably shouldn’t apply if: - You’re “just looking for extra money.” - You like working 5 full-time jobs because all you care about is work. - You get offended easily and take things personally. - You are not someone with grit and determination who can persevere while being challenged to do great work. - You get overwhelmed easily with new code, new habits, new learnings and chat messages. The interview process: - Since 99% of our work is done via Slack (we don’t do scheduled calls), the entire interview process will be via email . (With lots of questions, sprinkled with a few voice notes) - You may be able to speak with a developer or two on our team to see how they like the role. If you work here: - You’ll get 13th month salary, Filipino holidays, unlimited time off (we don’t count sick days), a normal working day schedule (no night shifts, although an early start is preferred for time overlap) with some flexibility, a week off during the holidays in December, and the opportunity to grow and become your best self. A little more about us: - We’ve been in business for a decade+. Our teams are remote (mostly in the Philippines). Our longest standing tea ---------- mber has been with us for over 13+ years. We've had people quit smoking on our teams with our help, lose weight, learn a new instrument, speak a new language, and more. We all love what we do. How to begin - Your mission, should you choose to accept, is to send us an email with 3 questions you have about this role. If you’re currently in a full-time role and are looking for something new, we’re open to a transition window. We actually care about your happiness. NOTE: While we like AI, and we use it in certain circumstances, we ask that no AI be used during communication. Communication is the most important thing we do. If I don't see your natural voice from our first interaction, then you're setting an inaccurate representation of who you are and how you communicate. And when I see that change, it's going to come across as a lack of harmony in how you communicate.

title: Logistics Coordinator Freight LTL & FTL
description: This is a role for committed, focused, independent, consistent, and experienced professionals. Do not apply if you're looking for a gig. We are a B2B store buildout partner delivering complete retail store projects across Canada and the USA — one point of contact for fixtures, refrigeration, walk-ins, millwork, racking, and kitchen equipment. Every project ships freight to a customer's site on a fixed opening date, and this role owns that freight from quote to delivery. THE ROLE You own the freight lifecycle end to end. A shipment need comes in, you gather the full spec, pull rates in a TMS, book the load — mostly LTL — send the BOL to the supplier, schedule the pickup, track the shipment, coordinate delivery, audit the carrier invoice, and handle any claim, then log it all. Day to day, the job is steady coordination with customers and suppliers — confirming what is shipping, when it is ready, and when it needs to land. Much of the work is orchestration. A single store order often pulls product from several different suppliers, and all of it has to arrive at one location at the same time. You plan and sequence those pickups so the loads converge on the customer's delivery date — matching ready dates, pickup windows, and transit times across multiple suppliers and carriers at once. Getting that timing right, repeatedly, is the core of the role. For US-bound loads you handle cross-border documentation — commercial invoices, broker coordination, and the customs paperwork that keeps freight from sitting at the border. The boundaries are clean. You do not set customer pricing and you do not do the accounting — the estimating and accounting team owns markup and invoicing. You own the movement and the cost accuracy. Three rules define the job: nothing ships before payment clears (unless the customer has an account with net terms), every BOL comes back signed the same day as pickup, and every carrier invoice gets audited against the booked rate. This is pure freight movement — no warehousing, no inventory management, no fulfillment. This is a full-time role. Carriers, suppliers, customers, and the customs broker are reached during North American business hours, so 9:00 to 5:00 Eastern Time availability, Monday through Friday, is a hard requirement — not a preference. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR The one trait that separates a strong coordinator from an average one is relentless follow-through. The person who chases the signed BOL the same afternoon, reads every line of a carrier invoice, and never lets a shipment drift. In freight, a loose end becomes a claim — so the job is closing loops before they cost money. Precision under detail load is table stakes — dimensions, weights, freight class, and accessorials have to be right the first time, because a wrong spec is a wrong quote or a failed delivery. On top of that we need calm coordination when several shipments, suppliers, and carriers are all moving toward the same delivery date — no drama, no dropped threads. This is a long-term, full-time seat. We are looking for someone reliable, mature, and committed — not someone fitting this between other gigs. Warehouse, inventory, fulfillment-only, or parcel-only backgrounds without real commercial freight coordination experience will not be considered. REQUIREMENTS 1. Three or more years coordinating commercial freight in USA or Canada — primarily LTL — including booking loads, managing BOLs, and dealing with carriers directly. Warehouse, inventory, or parcel-only experience without freight coordination will not be considered. 2. Hands-on experience with a TMS or freight booking platform (Freightcom, project44, FreightPOP, MercuryGate, Descartes, or similar) for rate shopping, booking, and tracking. 3. Cross-border US and Canada freight experience, including commercial invoices, customs broker coordination, and Importer of Record basics. (optional) 4. Carrier-invoice auditing and claims handling — disputing reweighs and reclassifications, and filing damage or shortage claims with proper evidence. 5. Comfortable owning a structured workflow inside coordination tools — a TMS, a project tracker such as Asana, shared inboxes, and spreadsheets — without being chased on status. 6. Strong spoken and written English. You will be on the phone every day with carriers, suppliers, customers, and a customs broker, so clear, confident phone communication is essential — alongside professional written English for BOLs, quotes, and email coordination. 7. Full-time availability on a 9:00 to 5:00 Eastern Time schedule, Monday through Friday. This is a must, not a preference. Experience coordinating freight for store fixtures, building materials, foodservice, or commercial equipment is a strong advantage. HIRING PROCESS 1. Application review — applications without a clear, specific summary of freight coordination experience will not advance. 2. A 15-minute interview, booked online. Concrete answers about real shipments — the lanes, the problems, and how you closed them — work best. May be followed by a second longer interview if needed. 3. Offer to the candidate who passes — a full-time position paid semi-monthly, on the 1st and 16th of each month, in exchange for 9:00 to 5:00 Eastern Time availability, Monday through Friday. TO APPLY Submit your application through the form here: ---------- The form covers your freight coordination experience, the platforms you have used, your cross-border background, your availability, and your rate. Applications that do not come through the form will not be reviewed.
