title: Contracts and Client Accounts Officer
description: Position Description Contracts & Client Accounts Officer Employment Type Full-Time Reports To Operations Manager / Practice Manager Position Summary The Contracts & Client Accounts Officer is responsible for managing the contractual and financial administration of client matters from engagement through to completion. The role prepares service agreements and contract variations based on consultation outcomes and instructions provided by Registered Migration Agents (RMAs), maintains client accounts, generates invoices, monitors payments, negotiates payment arrangements, follows up outstanding accounts, reconciles client records, and issues Statements of Service upon completion of contracted services. The position plays a critical role in ensuring contractual accuracy, timely billing, effective debt collection, accurate client account management, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements while maintaining positive client relationships. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Contract Preparation and Administration Prepare service agreements based on consultation outcomes and instructions provided by RMAs. Draft contract variations, amendments, and additional service agreements as directed by RMAs. Ensure agreements accurately reflect the approved scope of services, fees, payment schedules, and terms and conditions. Issue agreements to clients and manage contract execution processes. Explain agreement terms, payment obligations, and contract variations to clients where required. Maintain contract registers and document management systems. Store executed agreements and related documents within the client management system. Monitor contract status and ensure documentation remains complete and current. Maintain standard agreement templates and supporting documentation. 2. Client Account Management Establish and maintain client accounts upon engagement. Record agreements, variations, invoices, payments, credits, refunds, and account adjustments. Monitor client account balances and payment schedules. Maintain accurate client financial records and transaction histories. Reconcile client accounts and investigate discrepancies. Prepare client account statements and payment summaries when required. Respond to client enquiries regarding invoices, payments, balances, and contractual charges. Ensure all client account information is accurate, complete, and up to date. 3. Invoicing and Revenue Administration Generate invoices in accordance with approved agreements and contract variations. Prepare milestone, progress, and final invoices. Verify invoice accuracy prior to issue. Ensure fees charged align with contractual obligations and approved services. Maintain invoice registers and billing records. Monitor upcoming billing events and payment schedules. Coordinate with RMAs regarding additional billable services and approved variations. Ensure timely invoicing of all contracted services. 4. Accounts Receivable, Collections and Negotiations Monitor outstanding invoices and payment due dates. Follow up overdue accounts via telephone, email , and written correspondence. Issue payment reminders, demand notices, and account statements. Negotiate payment arrangements and payment plans within approved authority limits. Resolve account disputes and billing queries professionally and efficiently. Encourage timely payment while maintaining positive client relationships. Maintain records of collection activities and client communications. Monitor compliance with agreed payment arrangements. Escalate unresolved accounts to management when required. Assist with debt recovery activities where necessary. Prepare aged debtor and accounts receivable reports. Work proactively to minimise overdue accounts and improve collection performance. 5. Service Delivery Tracking Monitor client matters against contracted services, milestones, and deliverables. Liaise with RMAs and support staff regarding service progress and completion. Track approved contract variations and associated billing events. Ensure services delivered align with contractual obligations. Identify and report discrepancies between contracted and delivered services. 6. Service Completion and Matter Closure Liaise with RMAs to verify completion of contracted services. Prepare and issue Statements of Service upon completion of services. Ensure all invoices have been issued prior to matter closure. Reconcile client accounts before file closure. Issue final account statements where required. Ensure all contractual and financial records are complete and properly filed. Close client matters in accordance with company procedures. 7. Reporting and Record Keeping Maintain accurate records of contracts, variations, invoices, payments, collections, negotiations, and client accounts. Prepare weekly and monthly operational and financial reports. Monitor contract activity, revenue generation, outstanding accounts, collection performance, and payment plan compliance. Support management with reporting and business analysis. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records. 8. Compliance and Quality Assurance Ensure all documentation complies with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements. Maintain confidentiality of client information. Support internal audits and compliance reviews. Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to operational efficiency. Maintain high standards of accuracy and professionalism in all documentation and communications. Essential Qualifications Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Legal Services, Contract Administration, or a related discipline; or Equivalent demonstrated work experience. Essential Experience Minimum 2 years' experience in: Contract Administration; Client Account Management; Accounts Receivable; Finance Administration; or Professional Services Administration. Demonstrated experience: Preparing contracts, agreements, and variations. Managing client accounts and records. Generating invoices and administering billing processes. Following up outstanding accounts and collecting payments. Negotiating payment arrangements and resolving account-related issues. Maintaining accurate financial and administrative records. Working with CRM and business management systems. Managing client-facing financial discussions. Experience within a migration, legal, accounting, consulting, education, or other professional services environment. Experience using QuickBooks Online. Experience using CRM or practice management systems. Experience supporting compliance-driven service delivery environments. Essential Skills Contract Administration Ability to prepare contracts, agreements, and variations from approved templates and instructions. Strong document management and record-keeping skills. Ability to interpret instructions and accurately translate them into contractual documentation. Financial Administration Invoice generation and billing administration. Accounts receivable management. Payment allocation and reconciliation. Debt collection and account follow-up. Client account management and reporting. Negotiation and Relationship Management Strong negotiation skills. Ability to negotiate payment arrangements and collection outcomes. Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally. Ability to resolve disputes and account-related issues. Ability to influence positive outcomes while maintaining client relationships. Strong stakeholder management skills. Technical Skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams. Ability to work with CRM, accounting, and practice management systems. Experience with QuickBooks Online will be highly regarded. Strong data entry accuracy and database management skills. Communication Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Professional client service skills. Ability to communicate contractual, financial, and account-related matters clearly and professionally. Ability to build rapport and maintain productive client relationships. Organisational Skills Strong attention to detail. Excellent time management and prioritisation skills. Ability to manage multiple client matters simultaneously. Ability to work independently while meeting deadlines. Personal Attributes Highly organised and detail-oriented. Professional and client-focused. Honest, trustworthy, and able to maintain confidentiality. Strong sense of accountability and ownership. Process-driven and committed to accuracy. Proactive and solutions-oriented. Confident and professional communicator. Tactful and diplomatic when handling sensitive financial matters. Resilient and comfortable dealing with difficult conversations. Able to negotiate effectively while maintaining professionalism and client satisfaction. Able to work effectively in a team environment. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Service agreements prepared within 24 hours of receiving RMA instructions. Contract variations prepared within 24 hours of approval. Invoice accuracy rate of 99% or higher. All invoices issued within 1 business day of becoming billable. Reduction in aged debtors and overdue accounts. Collection targets achieved each month. Payment plans monitored and maintained effectively. Accurate maintenance of client account records. Statements of Service issued within 2 business days of service completion. Compliance with company policies and quality standards. Audit-ready client files and financial records at all times. Ideal Candidate A highly organised and commercially minded professional with experience in contract administration, client account management, invoicing, collections, and financial administration. The ideal candidate possesses strong negotiation skills, is confident managing client financial discussions, and can independently manage the contractual and financial lifecycle of client matters while supporting RMAs and ensuring a professional client experience. Experience with QuickBooks Online, CRM systems, and professional services environments will be highly regarded.

title: Operations & Client-Communications Assistant
description: JOB POST — Operations & Client-Communications Assistant Part-time to start, growing to full-time · US real estate media + marketing We run two connected businesses — a real estate media company (photo and video for real estate agents) and a digital marketing agency for local businesses. We're looking for a sharp, reliable assistant to own our inboxes, coordinate our team, and keep our media and content moving. You'll be the person our clients and contractors hear from, and the one who makes sure nothing slips. This starts part-time and grows into full-time as we scale — so we want someone who wants to grow with us. What you'll do Own client and contractor communication across both businesses — clear, warm, professional, using our templates. Book shoots and calls in our systems (Aryeo for real estate, GoHighLevel for marketing) and keep the calendar straight. Manage media end to end: download finished work, edit photos in Fotello, run simple AI photo edits from our step-by-step guides (object removal, virtual staging), upload to the right place, and hand footage to our editors. Move and organize files in Google Drive, ---------- , Aryeo, and GoHighLevel — everything labeled and in the right folder. Coordinate our photographer, video editors, and contractors so deadlines are met. Keep the owner looped and flag anything that needs his decision. The schedule (fits a normal Philippine day — not a night shift) The work happens in two blocks during your day: Main morning block — about 7:00–10:00 AM Philippine time (this is 7:00–10:00 PM US Eastern, the evening before). This is when the day's media comes in and our editors are online — you process it and hand it off. Short evening block — about 8:00–9:00 PM Philippine time (8:00–9:00 AM US Eastern), roughly 1 hour for quick uploads and deliveries. That's about 20 hours a week to start, growing to full-time as volume grows. Your midday stays free. Who we're looking for Excellent written English — you can write a clear, warm, professional message with no hand-holding. Detail-obsessed and reliable — you follow a checklist exactly, flag problems early, and never go quiet. A fast learner — you don't need to know our tools already; you need to learn one from a short video and follow it precisely. (We give you written guides and AI assistants so you can learn fast.) Comfortable with everyday web tools (Google Drive, web apps). Bonus, not required: real estate, agency, GoHighLevel, or media-coordination experience. Tools we'll train you on Aryeo, Fotello, ---------- , Google Workspace/Drive, GoHighLevel, Claude, and Higgsfield. All provided — and used only for our business. A note on trust Because you'll handle client data and our accounts, we take security seriously. You'll sign a simple confidentiality and security agreement, and the tools we provide are for our business only — never personal use or other clients. Details Part-time to start (about 20 hrs/week), growing to full-time. Pay: $700/month for the part-time hours, increasing as it moves to full-time. Begins with a short paid trial task before a full offer. To apply (read carefully) Start your message with the word "ENGINE" so we know you read this. In 3–4 sentences, tell us about a time you owned communication or coordination for a business or team. Attach one example of professional writing you've done (an email , message, or short note).

I prefer a mood that is slightly darker and more cinematic rather than bright and airy, while still looking crisp, clean, and professional. Think Christmas, winter, hygge, warmth, elegance, and a premium feel. In particular, I would like: - Natural and tasteful enhancement of colors. - Beautiful and natural retouching of the model without looking retouched. - Natural-looking skin tones and facial features. - A harmonious and polished overall look. - Realistic snow and winter atmosphere outside the windows. - The outdoor winter scenery can be slightly soft or diffused rather than very sharp, so the focus remains on the interior and overall mood. - Removal of visible cables, wires, and other distracting elements when appropriate. - Removal of distracting reflections or other details that take attention away from the image. - A clean, refined, and visually pleasing result while maintaining realism. What matters most to me is the overall feeling and atmosphere of the image. I want the final result to feel genuine, premium, inviting, and believable—not artificial or heavily edited. If you feel that certain adjustments would improve the image, please feel free to use your professional judgment, as long as the final result remains natural and realistic. I look forward to seeing your interpretation of the images and hope this can be the start of a long-term collaboration. Thank you!

title: Appointment Setter
description: Financial Literacy Basics FINANCIAL PLANNERS Position: Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative Location Remote — Work From Anywhere Employment Type Independent Contractor (1099) Daily Activity Standard Minimum 100 dials per day — Target 100–300 with power dialer Contact Goal 20–30 live prospect conversations per day Compensation Monthly Retainer + Per Qualified Appointment Bonus Reports To Lead Financial Planner, Financial Literacy Basics Start Date Immediate ABOUT Financial Literacy Basics Financial Literacy Basics is a financial planning and education firm operating under the financial planning and education brand. We design retirement and wealth plans built to last — plans grounded in structural analysis, real math, and risks most advisors never address. We work with people at every stage of their financial journey who want to make sure their money is working as hard as they are. We are not a traditional financial advisory/planning firm. We are plan architectural engineers. Our work identifies the gaps, the blind spots, and the structural weaknesses in a client's current approach — and we build the framework to fix them. THE ROLE We are looking for motivated, self-directed individuals to join Financial Literacy Basics as Appointment Setters. Your role has two clear objectives: connect with prospective clients by phone, schedule a 20-minute discovery call with our lead planner, and collect basic financial profile data so the architect can make the most of that conversation. You do not need a financial background. You do not need sales experience. You need confidence on the phone, the discipline to make calls consistently, and the professionalism to represent the Financial Literacy Basics brand with integrity. This is a door-opening role. You are the first impression and the intake point. Your success is measured by two things: qualified appointments booked and prospect data collected accurately. RESPONSIBILITIES • Make outbound cold calls to prospective clients using a provided script and contact list • Deliver the Financial Literacy Basics opening script with consistency, confidence, and professionalism • Handle common objections using trained responses and redirect to appointment booking • Schedule 20-minute discovery calls between prospects and the Financial Literacy Basics lead architect • Collect basic financial profile data from each booked prospect — years to retirement, investable asset range, advisor status, and primary financial concern • Submit completed prospect data forms to the lead architect prior to each scheduled call • Leave professional voi cemail s and follow up with prospects on callback commitments • Log all call activity daily — dials, contacts, outcomes, appointments booked, and data collected • Maintain a minimum of 100 dials per day; target 100–300 using power dialer tools • Participate in brief weekly check-in calls to review performance and refine approach WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This is strictly an appointment-setting and data collection role. You are not expected to discuss financial strategy, investment products, market conditions, or any aspect of retirement planning. If a prospect asks detailed financial questions, your response is: "That's exactly what the call is for — I'll let our lead architect walk you through it." • You will NOT provide financial advice or discuss investment strategies • You will NOT present or explain the Financial Literacy Basics plan methodology • You will NOT represent yourself as a financial advisor or planner • You will NOT make promises about outcomes, returns, or specific plan recommendations • You will NOT discuss fees or pricing — that is handled by the lead architect DATA COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY Once a prospect agrees to a call and confirms their email , you will collect four data points before ending the conversation. This takes approximately 60 seconds and is framed as helping the planner prepare — which it does. Data Point Why It Matters Years to Retirement Determines planning horizon and urgency — shapes the entire architecture framework Has a Financial Advisor? Sets context for how the discovery call is framed — additive vs. first-time planning Investable Asset Range Establishes whether the prospect is qualified and helps architect tailor the conversation Primary Financial Concern Market risk, income, inflation, or legacy — allows architect to lead with what matters most to them If a prospect declines to answer, do not push. Note it as "declined" and move on. The appointment is always the priority — data collection is secondary. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required • Comfortable and confident speaking on the phone with strangers • Self-motivated — able to work independently without daily supervision • Disciplined — able to maintain 50+ dials per day consistently • Detail-oriented — able to accurately capture and submit prospect data after each booking • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment • Basic computer skills — email , calendar scheduling, simple spreadsheets or forms • Professional demeanor and clear verbal communication Preferred (Not Required) • Prior experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or phone-based sales • Background in insurance, annuities, or any financial services outreach • Experience using a CRM or power dialer platform (CloudTalk, HubSpot, etc.) • Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive, consistent approach COMPENSATION STRUCTURE Trial Period: Week 1 and 2:  $35 per qualified appointment — no retainer Week 3 and 4: $40 per qualified appointment — no retainer Continuous Offer: Monthly Retainer $1000 – $3000 (based on performance, experience and availability) + $35-$40  per qualified appointment Per Qualified Appointment Bonus paid per appointment that is confirmed, shows, and includes collected data Definition of Qualified Prospect confirmed the call, provided contact info, attended the 20-minute discovery call, and basic data was collected prior Payment Schedule Monthly — net 15 following the close of the calendar month Classification Independent Contractor — 1099 issued annually Compensation details are finalized during the offer conversation. High performers who demonstrate consistency, data accuracy, and brand alignment will be considered for advancement with expanded responsibilities and increased earning potential. GROWTH PATH Financial Literacy Basics is building a distribution network. This role is the entry point. Strong performers advance through three stages — all based on performance, not time. 1 Appointment Setter Script-driven outreach. Book the call. Collect prospect data. Nothing more. 2 Junior Financial Planner Learn the Financial Literacy Basics language and methodology firsthand.  Learn basic financial planning and budgeting. 3 Senior Financial Planner Present the plan framework to prospects with architect support. Expanded compensation and responsibility. HOW TO APPLY Send a brief introduction — no resume required — that answers the following three questions: • Tell us about a time you had to persuade someone or handle pushback in a conversation. • What does your current daily schedule look like and how many hours can you commit to this role? • Have you ever made cold calls or done phone-based outreach? If yes, describe the context. Submit to: ---------- with subject line: "Financial Literacy Basics — Appointment Setter"

(We'll assess this through your application video — see "How to apply.") - *A real phone and Zoom operator.* Confident on the phone and on camera, calm under objections, and skilled at consultative, question-led conversations. Nice to have: - Familiarity with GoHighLevel (or a similar CRM), a power/auto-dialler, and WhatsApp Business. - Experience reactivating cold databases or running outbound campaigns. - A track record you can point to (set rates, show rates, or deals influenced). What success looks like (first 90 days): - Consistently dialling inbound leads inside 60 seconds. - Hitting target connect, set, and show rates on qualified conversations. - Clean CRM hygiene and closer briefs on every booked call. Compensation: - *Base: SGD $800–$1,200/month*, depending on experience. - *Plus a per-show bonus* for every qualified call that actually attends. - (Optional, recommended to attract top talent: a small commission on deals closed from the calls you set — this is what turns a good SDR into a motivated one and helps land an ex-closer.) - Paid in Singapore Dollars, monthly via bank transfer. How to apply: We're not interested in a traditional CV. Instead, send us two things: 1. A short presentation (slides or a document) covering: - What you sold, and who you sold it to. - Why the offer was good — why people bought. - The results you helped your customers or clients achieve. - Your specific role in the sales process. - The results you brought the company (give real numbers). - Why you believe your experience will help TRES specifically. 2. job_title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.) This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone). Our Stack (you'll work across most of this) -Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps) -Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API) -Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation) -ActiveCampaign (automations, API) -Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run) -REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job -LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API) -WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code. -Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API) -Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments -Softr (client portal on top of Airtable) -Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation. What You'll Do -Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems) -Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability -Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google -Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings -Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post. 2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't. 3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.) 4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem? 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD. 6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning. If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

description: Speck of Dust is a video production company in Sydney, Australia, working across documentary, sport and live-event content. PLEASE READ THIS IN FULL BEFORE APPLYING. We receive a lot of generic, copy-paste applications, and we only consider people who are a genuine fit. Apply only if you are a genuine video editor with a real video editing reel. This is NOT a role for generalists, web or graphic designers, AI-content creators, or social-media content editors. If that is your background, please do not apply. We are looking for a remote video editor, and we like to start with a single paid trial project so we can both see if it is a good fit. This first project is small (budget around US$150 to US$300). Only if it goes well would we then talk about more project work and, in time, a possible ongoing monthly arrangement. There is no immediate or permanent commitment up front, and nothing is locked in. THE WORK (the trial project). It is a fun, upbeat highlight edit of an event night: the kind of piece that gives the people who took part a great memory to watch back and share. It is a single-camera job. You cut the best ---------- nts down into selects and assemble them into a finished piece of around 90 seconds (two minutes maximum). It opens with a short presenter introduction, moves through people arriving and enjoying the experience, carries a short interview section around the halfway mark, and builds to a high point before closing on a sponsor logo we supply. The feel is celebratory and energetic, driven by well-known upbeat pop music, with the cuts and speed ramps timed to the rhythm. Golden ---------- nts are kept in their original slow motion. The footage is shot on a Canon C400 (C-Log2 profile) and you apply a LUT we provide before any grading. We give you reference edits to match for pacing, structure and feel, so you are not starting from a blank page. It is edited in Premiere Pro, you hand back the Premiere project file, and review happens in ---------- with time-coded notes (one revision round on the trial). Beyond this first project, our work overall ranges from emotionally driven, story-led documentary pieces through to fast, energetic sport and event edits. WHAT THIS IS NOT. We are not looking for a generalist social-media editor. If your main experience is editing for YouTubers, Instagram, or short-form social (for example CapCut-style content), we are probably not the right fit. We don't do disposable, templated clips with tacky graphics, gimmicky sound effects, or AI-generated filler. We want a genuine video editor who specialises in considered, brief-led craft: emotional, story-led documentary work and cinematic, high-energy sport. Every piece is made to a specific brief, with real storytelling, craft and taste. TWO THINGS WE WEIGH HEAVILY (these are core to the role, not nice-to-haves): 1. A strong, fluent command of English, written and spoken. We will assess this on a short video call. 2. A genuine video editor specialising in craft work, shown in a real editing reel, not generalist, social-media, web or graphic-design work. YOU MUST HAVE (please be honest, this is where we have had trouble before): - A computer that can genuinely handle large-format Canon C400 footage (.mxf, C-Log2) in Premiere Pro, with a proxy workflow if needed. - Plenty of fast, free storage. Jobs are often 400GB or more. - A fast, reliable internet connection. You will be downloading large media and that download time is real. - Confidence with the ---------- Transfer app and the Google Drive app, and with relinking media in Premiere. - Premiere Pro, and you hand back the Premiere project file on delivery. - Comfortable applying a supplied LUT, working with slow motion and speed ramps, and cutting to music. - Organised and reliable, and comfortable communicating day to day on Google Chat or WhatsApp. - Able to take feedback through ---------- time-coded notes and action it properly. A BONUS (not a dealbreaker): After Effects and a sophisticated hand with visual effects. TO APPLY, please include: 1. Two or three of your most relevant samples as direct video links (for example Vimeo or an unlisted YouTube link), ideally matching our work: one story-led emotional edit and one high-energy sport edit. If you do not have directly relevant work, send your strongest pieces instead. Please do NOT send a full Google Drive folder with endless lists and subfolders for us to dig through; pick your best two or three and link them directly. It must be genuine video editing work. 2. Your computer specs and storage. 3. Your internet speed. 4. Your rate for a single project like this, and your monthly rate if we were ever to move to ongoing work. 5. References and proof of the work and credentials you mention. 6. One thing from this brief that stood out to you, in a sentence, so we know you have actually read it. We read every application and can tell a copy-paste from a real one. Applications that clearly ignore this brief, or whose work is not genuine video editing, will not be considered. A short video call is the next step so we can have a chat. THE DEAL. We start with this one paid trial project. If it works, we would love to keep working together on more projects and possibly an ongoing monthly arrangement later, but nothing is committed or locked in up front. description: READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. This post is direct on purpose. It saves your time and ours. Applications that ignore the instructions at the bottom will not be replied to. And to be upfront about the process: text answers don't get you hired here. A screen-share does. If you're not willing to show your real work, live, on camera, stop reading now. ABOUT US 1 DASH ( ---------- ) is a US payments and merchant services company with 20+ years in the industry, serving businesses nationwide. Our stance with our customers is simple: "Running a business is hard. Your payments shouldn't be." The software behind that promise is what you'd be building: a payment and invoicing SaaS, an agent dashboard, a mobile app, and internal analysis tools. Our values are simplicity and transparency, in the product and in how we work. That's also why this post is blunt. Small dev team, zero bureaucracy, and the features you ship get used by real businesses to move real money. THE STACK (THIS IS WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY WORK IN) • TypeScript everywhere, strict mode • Frontend: React 18/19, Next.js 15/16, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod • Backend: Node 20, Express APIs • Database: Supabase (Postgres + Auth), Drizzle ORM and Prisma • Mobile: React Native / Expo with NativeWind and Zustand (nice to have, not required) • Integrations: payment processor APIs (Valor, Dejavoo), OpenAI, Resend, webhooks • Testing: Vitest, Playwright, Supertest • Infra: Vercel, Railway, GitHub Actions, pnpm / Turbo monorepo You do not need every item on this list. You do need to be genuinely strong in TypeScript, React, Node/Express, and SQL/Postgres. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Build features end-to-end: database schema, API endpoint, UI • Fix bugs without being babysat • Write typed, Zod-validated code that passes lint, typecheck, and tests before you say "done" • Work with payment APIs and webhooks. This is fintech, correctness matters more than speed. • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) daily. We expect this. We don't care that you use AI, every good dev does now. We care whether you understand what it produces, and we will verify that live. WHO THIS IS FOR • Mid to senior level: around 3-5+ years of real, shipped work • You can take a loosely defined task and come back with a working, tested feature • You communicate proactively. Blocked means you communicate the same day, not three days later. • You use AI tools heavily however, you can read, verify, and fix everything they produce. If you cannot explain your own code line-by-line on a call, please do not apply. You will be asked to. Please DO NOT APPLY IF • You're an agency or you plan to subcontract the work • You need step-by-step instructions for every task • You cannot explain code you've submitted without an AI tool open • You will not record a Loom video or join a live screen-share call PAY AND SCHEDULE • $10 per hour. This is the rate. • Part-time, around 20 hours per week to start. Can grow into more (and full-time) if you're good. • Flexible schedule, long-term role. THE HIRING PROCESS (SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR) 1. Application (instructions below) 2. 15-minute live screen-share call. You'll open your own code from the project in your Loom, and I'll ask you to walk through specific files, explain decisions, and reason through a change on the spot. I'll also show you a small snippet from your codebase and ask what it does and what's wrong with it. No prep needed if the work is actually yours. Note on the call: AI tools must be closed during it. Not because we're anti-AI (you'll use Claude Code daily here) but because the call tests the one thing AI can't do for you: understanding. HOW TO APPLY. FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY Read carefully, because the first instruction is not where you expect it. Somewhere in this paragraph is your first filter: the first line of your application must be the word SHIPIT followed by the name of the database from our stack list above. Applications missing either are deleted unread. If you pasted this post into an AI tool and skimmed its summary, you've probably already failed. 1. Attach your resume, or include a Google Drive link set to "anyone with the link can view". A locked link counts as no resume. 2. Record a Loom video, 3-5 minutes. This is the core of your application. Requirements: o Introduce yourself briefly on camera (face visible at the start) o Say today's date and the word from your application's first line out loud o Walk through ONE project you built. Show the actual code in your editor or the live app. No slideshows, no reading from a script. o Open the git history or git blame on at least one file and show your commits o Explain one hard problem you solved AND one design decision you'd make differently today o Videos showing tutorial projects, cloned repos, or code you can't git-blame to yourself are an instant rejection 3. Answer ALL of the questions below, numbered. Skipped questions = deleted application. Keep answers SHORT, 2-3 sentences each. We can tell the difference between concise-because-you-know and long-because-AI-padded. QUESTIONS: EXPERIENCE (links over stories, everything you claim should be checkable) 1. Years of professional experience, and the biggest thing you've shipped that is live right now. A link is required: live URL, App Store listing, or public repo. "I can't link anything" needs a one-sentence explanation (NDA, internal tool, etc.) plus the closest verifiable substitute. 2. Rate yourself 1-10 on each (be honest, the live call and test task will verify): TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node/Express, Postgres/SQL, Supabase. 3. One feature you built end-to-end, database to API to UI. Link the live feature, repo, or PR/commit range, and tell me which parts you personally wrote. 4. Have you worked with payments, fintech, or third-party API webhooks? One concrete example with specifics (which processor/API, what you handled). 5. GitHub or portfolio link. If your GitHub is empty, link whatever you HAVE built instead. QUESTIONS: AI WORKFLOW 6. Which AI coding tools do you use daily and for how long? Then in 2-3 sentences: your last real task with one, what it got wrong, and what you fixed manually. (This gets verified on the call, so be accurate, not impressive.) QUESTIONS: AVAILABILITY 7. How many hours per week are you actually available, and in what timezone? Generic copy-paste cover letters will be deleted. AI-polished applications might slip past me here, but they do not survive the screen-share, so you're only wasting your own time. Only shortlisted applicants will hear back from us. If you followed everything above, you are already ahead of 90% of applicants.

title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads
job_title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads
description: **Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads** --- We are building a supplement brand from the ground up. The model is simple. We find supplement products that are already proven on TikTok Shop, private label our own version, build a Shopify store around it, and scale it with Meta ads. We move fast, we test fast, and we double down on what works. We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who understands this model, has done something like it before, and can take a product from research to live store to running ads without needing their hand held every step of the way. --- **What this role actually looks like** You will spend time researching supplement products that are already selling well on TikTok Shop. You are looking for products with strong demand signals, real social proof, good margins, and room to compete with a private label version. Once you identify a winner you will help us source a private label version, work with our supplier to get it produced or fulfilled, and build a Shopify store around it that is clean, trustworthy, and built to convert. Then you launch Meta ads. You find the best performing videos for that product or category, make them better, write the copy, set up the campaigns, and monitor performance daily. You cut what is not working and push harder on what is converting. You understand that in the supplement space trust and credibility are everything so the store, the ads, and the messaging all need to feel legitimate and professional. You will also handle supplier communication, verify orders, coordinate fulfillment, and keep operations organized as we scale. --- **The supplement space has specific requirements and you need to understand them** Supplement ads on Meta have strict rules. You cannot make certain health claims. You cannot use before and after imagery in certain ways. You need to know what gets ads disapproved and how to write copy that converts without triggering a policy violation. If you have never run supplement ads before this is not the role for you. If you have and you know how to navigate the compliance side while still writing ads that sell this is exactly the role for you. The same applies to the store. A supplement store needs to feel credible. That means professional product photography or AI generated imagery that looks real, clear ingredient information, trust signals like reviews and guarantees, and copy that speaks to real customer concerns without making illegal claims. --- **Who we are looking for** You have researched winning products on TikTok Shop before and you can walk us through your process. You have run Meta ads for a physical product brand and you have real numbers to show for it. You understand the supplement space well enough to know what sells, what claims are allowed, and how to position a private label product against established brands. You can build a Shopify store from scratch in under 8 hours. You are comfortable sourcing private label products and communicating with suppliers. You use AI tools every day to speed up research, copy, and creative production. You work independently and you are focused on results not just completing tasks. --- **You are not the right fit if** You have never run a paid ad campaign from scratch. You do not understand supplement compliance on Meta. You need a team around you to do product research. You cannot show us proof of something you tested and what happened. You are looking for a slow paced admin role. --- **Experience that will move you to the top of the list** You have run Meta ads specifically for a supplement or health and wellness brand. You have private labeled a product before and understand the sourcing and fulfillment process. You have used Kalodata or a similar tool for TikTok product research. You have experience with supplement compliance on Meta and know how to write copy that converts without violating policies. You have built a Shopify store for a health or wellness brand that felt credible and professional. --- **Tools you should know** Kalodata for TikTok product research and validation. Shopify for store builds and product management. Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. CapCut or any video editor for creative production. Claude, ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy, research, and workflow. Triple Whale or any attribution and tracking tool is a strong plus. Canva or Photoshop for basic image editing and visual work. --- **How we structure pay** Base hourly rate plus a performance percentage tied to sales you directly generate. If you find winners and scale them your earnings grow with the results. We start with a short trial period so both sides can see if this works before committing long term. --- **How to apply** We want proof not promises. Tell us about a product you researched and tested. What was it, how did you find it, and what happened with the numbers. Tell us about any supplement or health brand experience you have. Share any Meta ad results you have even rough numbers are fine. Tell us your product research process step by step. Tell us which tools you use and why. If you have private labeled a product before tell us about that specifically. Generic applications will not be considered. Specific ones with real examples and real numbers will get a fast response.

description: **Paid Ads Manager | Meta and Google | Ecommerce and Short Term Rentals** --- We run two businesses. An ecommerce store that sells physical products and a short term rental property business. We need one sharp person who can run paid ads across both. Not someone who has only boosted posts or followed a template. Someone who actually understands how paid traffic works, how funnels work, and how to turn ad spend into real revenue. Meta is the priority. If you are not strong on Meta do not apply. --- **What you will be doing** On the ecommerce side you will be running Meta ads to test and scale winning products. That means building campaigns from scratch, writing ad copy, selecting or editing video creatives, testing angles, monitoring performance daily, cutting what is losing, and scaling what is converting. You will also support Google Shopping campaigns for our Shopify store and make sure our product ads are structured correctly and performing. On the short term rental side you will be running Meta and Google ads to generate direct bookings for our properties. That means building awareness and retargeting campaigns, driving traffic to landing pages, and optimizing for bookings and inquiries. You will need to understand how to speak to a traveler audience and what makes someone click and book. Across both businesses you will be responsible for campaign setup, creative testing, budget management, performance reporting, and ongoing optimization. You will also support landing page setup or improvements when needed to make sure the traffic we are paying for actually converts. --- **What we need from you** You have run Meta ads for an ecommerce brand before and you can show us results. You understand campaign structure, ad sets, audiences, creative testing, and how to read the numbers. You know what a winning creative looks like and you know how to find or build one. You understand direct response marketing. You are not just running brand awareness. You are running ads that are supposed to make people take action right now. You know how Google Shopping works and you have set up or managed Performance Max or standard Shopping campaigns before. You understand funnels. You know that the ad is only one part of the equation and that the landing page, the offer, and the follow up all matter. You are comfortable setting up or improving landing pages to support your campaigns. You are organized and you report clearly. We need to know what is working, what is not, and what you are doing about it. --- **Experience that will move you to the top of the list** You have managed a monthly ad budget of at least five thousand dollars across Meta or Google. You have run ads for both ecommerce and service based businesses before. You have experience with short term rentals, hospitality, travel, or local service businesses. You have used tools like Triple Whale, Northbeam, or any attribution platform. You have built or optimized landing pages using tools like GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, or similar. You understand creative strategy and can give direction to a video editor or content creator to produce better ad creatives. --- **Tools you should know** Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. Google Ads for Shopping, Search, and Performance Max campaigns. Google Analytics for traffic and conversion tracking. Any landing page builder — GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, Shopify pages, or similar. Canva or any basic design tool for simple creative edits. description: ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE) Location: Remote Type: Full-time Salary: AUD$10-$15ph ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives. ABOUT THE ROLE The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team. FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES 1. The Information Steward - Custodian of all essential client information and access rights. - Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc. - Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements). - Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times. - Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence. - Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly. - Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms. - Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management. - Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?” 2. The Delivery Project Manager - Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines. - Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval. - Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks. - Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution. - Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome. - Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals. - Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties. - Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?” 3. The Relationship Anchor - Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client. - Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly. - Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients. - Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life. - Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings. - Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal. - Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting. - Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates. - Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?” 4. The Compliant Storyteller - Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story. - Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes. - Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up email s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information. - Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised. - Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions. - Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals. - Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered. - Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?” PRIORITISATION ORDER - From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order: - Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction. - Insurance applications and getting policies into force. - Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting email s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser. - Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour). - Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding). - Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc). - Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority. - Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task. REPORTING & COLLABORATION Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes. Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser. Indicators of Success - 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access. - Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention. - High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients. - Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work. - Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio. - Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours. - Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms. Expected Behaviour - Proactive, reliable, and accountable. - Thoughtful and detail-oriented. - Able to prioritise and escalate as needed. - Collaborative, not siloed. - Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency. APPLICATION PROCESS To apply, please submit the following: • A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role • Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link • Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal) Please apply and email all details to: ---------- ONLY those who follow the instructions in how to apply will be accommodated.

title: Product Engineer
description: You might call yourself a full-stack developer or backend engineer today. We think that role is changing fast and we're looking for someone who's already feeling it. We're a small Dutch tech company building ComChamp - the central nervous system for organisations. Today it's a CRM and Customer Journey Orchestration platform. Our clients are energy and telecom companies in the Netherlands who use it to run everything from lead intake to proposals to service delivery, without stitching five tools together. Where it's going: an Agentic Communication Hub, where AI agents handle routine interactions, hand off to humans for complex ones, and operate within the same journeys and audit trails. Same workflow, executed by a person or an AI. That's what we're building toward. Our team is 8 people. Our codebase is 25+ TypeScript microservices. And we're growing. **What this role actually is** We don't need someone to write code line by line. AI does that now and we use it extensively. What we need is someone who can think clearly about what to build, direct AI to build it, and know when it's getting it wrong. That means: - You understand how systems connect - databases, APIs, queues, state management - not at the syntax level, but at the "why is this architected this way" level - You can look at an AI-generated solution and smell when something is off - You can break a messy business problem into clean, executable steps - You can explain a complex idea simply - to a teammate, to a client, to an AI This is a product role as much as an engineering role. You'll think about what users need, how workflows should behave, and where the system should be smarter. Then you'll make it happen with AI as your primary tool. **What you bring** Must-haves: - Strong understanding of backend systems (we use NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, but we care more about depth than specific frameworks) - Experience working with AI coding tools Cursor, Claude, Copilot, or similar - Clear written and spoken English - this is non-negotiable, it's how we work - The ability to think at the product level, not just the ticket level Great to have: - Experience with workflow engines, state machines, or process automation - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, Redis, or GCP - Interest in AI agents and autonomous systems - not as hype, but as real engineering problems **What we offer** - Salary in line with your capabilities paid reliably, every time - Long-term contract, as we're not looking for a quick project, we're building a team - Real ownership and influence on what we build and how - We bet heavily on AI-driven development and constantly experiment with the newest capabilities, always tied to real deliverables. - Small team, big ambitions where your work directly shapes the product - Work with people who think differently about what software teams will look like **How to apply** Don't just send a CV. Write us a short message (a few paragraphs is fine) that answers two things: - What's something complex that you understand really well? Could be technical, could be anything. Explain it to us like we know nothing about it. - Why does this role interest you? Not a generic answer, but what specifically about how we described this made you want to respond? We read every application. The way you write your response tells us more than your resume. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We're building infrastructure for a world where communication IS operation, where small organizations can operate at enterprise scale, and where autonomous agents work alongside humans. If solving these problems excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

description: Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories About Growing Pains Marketing Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising. We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter. We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts. This is not just a “make pretty ads” role. We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases. Role Overview As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working. You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality. You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative. Key Responsibilities: Creative Strategy Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads. Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language. Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities. Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research. Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert. Creative Briefs Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators. Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references. Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion. Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed. Meta Ads Execution Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager. Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring. Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns. Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next. Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled. Creative Performance Analysis Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type. Identify why certain ads are working or not working. Use performance data to inform future creative briefs. Track winning patterns across accounts. Help build a repeatable creative testing system. Client-Facing Communication Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed. Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction. Strong written and spoken English is required. You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos. Requirements You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy. You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns. You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager. You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute. You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning. You must have excellent written and spoken English. You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy. You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts. You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift. We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role. Nice to Have Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories. Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators. Experience writing UGC scripts. Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel. Experience working inside an agency. Compensation Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level. Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis. Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month. If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus. Hiring Process: Step 1: Application You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work. Step 2: Level 1 Test If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test. Step 3: Interview If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview. Step 4: Level 2 Test Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made. Application Requirements Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered. You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy. Application Questions Experience How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy? What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for? Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring. Creative Strategy Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles. What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand? Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible. Research Process What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles? How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers? Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle. Performance Analysis What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working? How do you d ---------- whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative? Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it. Communication This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients? You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process. Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain. Availability & Fit What country and time zone are you located in? Are you available to work some U.S. business hours? What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD? How to Apply DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH YOU MUST submit the following to ---------- portfolio. Examples of creative briefs you have created. Examples of ads you helped strategize. A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process. Answers to the application questions above.

title: Graphic Designer
description: ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day. The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards. Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences. THE OPPORTUNITY At Scriveiner, design is not decoration. It is the product. From the curve of a pen to the layout of a product listing, every visual decision is an expression of what this brand stands for. Our customers have awarded us five product design awards. Our peers have recognised us with the King’s Award for Enterprise. The bar is not aspirational. It is already set. We are now hiring a Graphic Designer to own the visual output of the business: everything from Amazon A+ content and Shopify imagery to packaging, print materials, and retail partner assets. This is a broad, hands-on role with real creative ownership, not a production queue role where someone else makes the decisions and you execute. Scriveiner operates and sells globally, and as the brand expands into new markets and product categories, the volume and variety of design work will grow with it. If you want to build a genuine body of work at a brand people notice, this is where to do it. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Own the visual quality of every digital and physical asset Scriveiner ships: product listing images, A+ content, social graphics, packaging, print materials, and retail partner assets. Design and maintain product listing imagery for Shopify and Amazon, ensuring all assets meet platform specifications, convert effectively, and are unmistakably on-brand. Create Amazon A+ content modules including enhanced brand sections, comparison charts, and lifestyle image layouts that drive both conversion and brand perception. Produce and adapt assets for retail partners, interpreting co-branding briefs and working within third-party templates without compromising brand standards. Own packaging artwork from concept to print-ready files, coordinating with suppliers and production teams to ensure accurate, on-time delivery. Design product manuals, inserts, and printed materials to the same standard as the product itself: clear, precise, and on-brand. Build and maintain a library of reusable social templates across Instagram, Facebook , LinkedIn, and YouTube to enable faster, more consistent content production. Perform light retouching on product photography and provide simple video editing support as required. Maintain an organised, versioned asset library so all final files are accessible and correctly named. WHO YOU ARE Essential — you must have this A strong portfolio demonstrating ecommerce and product-focused design work. Amazon, Shopify, or D2C experience is expected. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma. A precise eye for detail and a genuine intolerance for off-brand, low-quality output. Ability to manage multiple briefs simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and hit deadlines without being chased. Experience designing for both digital screens and print or physical production, with an understanding of file preparation and production specs. Commercial awareness: you understand how design influences conversion and make decisions with that in mind, not just aesthetics. AI-literate and comfortable using tools to work more efficiently without compromising craft. Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have Experience within a premium, lifestyle, gifting, or consumer goods brand where brand standards are non-negotiable. Familiarity with Amazon A+ content and product listing image best practices. Basic photo retouching and video editing skills using Adobe Lightroom, Premiere, or similar. Exposure to packaging design and working directly with print suppliers or production teams. Experience producing retail partner assets and adapting brand materials to third-party templates. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In this role, you will be successful when: Every product listing image and A+ module is visually compelling, accurate, and consistent with brand standards. Social and thumbnail assets are produced on time and require minimal revision. Packaging and manual artwork is delivered print-ready, with zero production errors. Retail partner asset requests are turned around quickly and to brief. The creative output of the business looks unmistakably like Scriveiner, everywhere. KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Head of Marketing: your primary brief-giver. You translate their direction into finished visual assets and raise blockers early. Marketing & Ecommerce team: collaborate on asset requirements for campaigns, product launches, and retailer activations. Retail partners: receive and interpret co-branding briefs and partner asset requirements. External suppliers and print partners: manage file handover, proofing, and production sign-off.
