title: Marketing Assistant
description: ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day. The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards. Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences. THE OPPORTUNITY Scriveiner is entering its next chapter: building from a well-established, award-winning brand into a globally recognised name in accessible luxury. New markets, new product ranges, and a rapidly growing direct and retail footprint mean the business needs people who are as good at building systems as they are at running them. The Marketing & Ecommerce Assistant is the connective tissue of our marketing and commercial operations. This is the role that keeps the engine running: ensuring the Shopify catalogue is flawless, the retailer pipeline is active and accurately tracked, and the weekly reporting tells a clear, actionable story. It is not a support role. It is an ownership role. Scriveiner operates and sells globally, and as the brand expands into new markets, the coordination and localisation demands of this role will grow with it WHAT YOU WILL OWN Own the Shopify catalogue end to end: product uploads, descriptions, imagery, pricing, tagging, and collections, with a zero-tolerance standard for accuracy across all live listings in every active market. Keep the retailer outreach tracker live and current across all regions, logging every conversation, follow-up, and next action so no pipeline relationship goes cold. Produce the weekly ecommerce report autonomously, without prompting, delivering clean, action-oriented performance data that the business can act on immediately. Coordinate new market and product launch asset production, managing timelines, briefing designers and translators, and ensuring all creative and localisation requirements land ahead of launch windows with zero gaps. Draft and send trade communications to prospective and existing retail partners across all active territories, written to Scriveiner brand standards, not to a template. Build and maintain ecommerce dashboards that give real, useful visibility into what is working and what needs attention. Flag risks and anomalies proactively: Shopify discrepancies, performance dips, asset gaps, or retailer conversations going cold, before they become problems that need escalation. WHO YOU ARE Essential — you must have this Hands-on Shopify experience: you have managed a live store and understand catalogue management, product uploads, pricing, and data accuracy in practice, not just in theory. Organisational ability that closes loops without prompting. You track your own work, know what is outstanding, and get things finished. Confidence with data: comfortable building dashboards, maintaining trackers, and presenting performance in a way that tells a clear story. Strong written English, capable of drafting trade communications and brand-consistent copy that does not need a round of editing before it goes out. Ability to manage several concurrent workstreams across different markets without losing detail in any of them. AI-literate and comfortable using tools, whether for writing, reporting, or workflow automation, to work more efficiently. Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have Experience in wholesale, retail account management, or trade marketing. You understand how retailer relationships work in practice. Exposure to multi-market or international marketing operations, including asset localisation and translation management. Background in a premium, lifestyle, or gifting brand where attention to presentation and brand standards is non-negotiable. Experience using analytics platforms beyond spreadsheets: Shopify analytics, Google Analytics, or similar. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In this role, you will be successful when: The Shopify catalogue is 100?curate at all times across every active market: every product live, correctly described, correctly priced. The retailer outreach tracker is live and current, with no conversations going cold and every pipeline contact properly followed up. The weekly ecommerce report is produced every week, on time, without being asked, and tells a story the business can act on. New market asset coordination runs on schedule, with all creative and localisation requirements delivered ahead of launch windows. Risks, whether a listing error, a performance anomaly, or a missed follow-up, are flagged before they need to be caught by someone else. KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Head of Marketing: direct line manager. You free them from operational bottlenecks and keep every system running without escalation. Creative / Brand team: coordinate on asset production, product imagery, and brand-consistent communications. Ops / Warehousing: coordinate Shopify inventory alignment. Retail partners and prospects: day-to-day trade communication and outreach administration. Founders: occasional visibility on pipeline and reporting outputs.

title: Children's Book Animator

Workflow Optimization & Collaboration -Recommend, test, and operate the right tools and software for the pipeline, identifying strategic paid AI tools for company investment where they improve speed or affordability. -Take creative direction from the project leadership team and iterate confidently based on feedback. Systems & Software -Full flexibility is provided, as the animator will choose their own optimal tools. Highly Desirable Technical proficiency in motion graphics, compositing, lighting, and rendering. Demonstrated experience producing and optimizing video content specifically for YouTube and major social platforms. A professional background animating children’s, family, or character-led content. A strong showreel or portfolio demonstrating relevant stylistic depth and successful AI-assisted work. Personal Attributes Highly self-directed and comfortable pioneering a brand-new function independently. Proactive and efficient, with a strong drive to establish a smooth workflow from a fast-moving, fresh brief. Collaborative mindset, remaining highly receptive to creative direction and capable of iterating smoothly based on team feedback. Innovative thinker, constantly looking for ways to optimize production and quality through technology. Success Indicators The new animation strand is launched successfully, with short children's science animations produced efficiently and on schedule. A polished 10–15 second brand logo ident is completed to a high creative standard. An efficient, scalable, and affordable AI-assisted animation pipeline is established and documented. Delivered animation files seamlessly fit technical requirements across YouTube, social platforms, and print-linked QR codes. The specialist operates with high autonomy, providing clear recommendations on tools and smoothly integrating creative feedback from leadership. ***How to apply Please complete the application form and submit your portfolio/showreel here: [Insert Application Form Link]

update, file, and manage OD dispute records for compliance charges and discrepancies Generate inventory reports and variance summaries using the IM Sheet and Power BI Support the Inventory Manager with inventory data for seasonal demand forecasting and buying decisions Perform other ad hoc tasks as directed by the Inventory Manager or wider Operations team WHO YOU ARE Essential Hands-on experience in an inventory, warehousing, or retail operations role — you have worked with stock, reconciled records, and managed order processes in a real operational environment Confident working with inventory management tools and reporting platforms, whether that is a WMS, ERP, IM Sheet, or Power BI in combination Practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA processes, including shipment creation and account management Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors in data that others overlook, and you find reconciliation satisfying rather than tedious Competent in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, data management, and variance analysis A proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked Desirable Experience with wholesale platforms such as Faire and/or Turis Familiarity with 3PL order management, fulfilment workflows, and inbound shipment processing Experience handling Amazon compliance charges, disputes, and FBA reimbursement claims Understanding of FIFO stock rotation principles and inventory control best practices Experience using AI tools to improve operational workflows or reporting efficiency WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In this role, you will be successful when: Inventory records across all platforms are accurate and current, with discrepancies investigated and resolved promptly. Amazon FBA shipments are created, verified, and tracked without errors, and reimbursement claims are filed on time. 3PL orders are processed accurately, with fulfilment issues identified and escalated before they affect customers. title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Operating Officer

The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that. We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d ---------- . This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane. The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled. What You'll Own - Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through. - Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems. - Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting. - Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed. - Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews. - Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules. - Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO. What You Bring: Experience (non-negotiable) - Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time. - Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work. Skills (must-have) - Project and tracker management, hands-on with Airtable - Strong follow-up discipline; you don't need to be told twice - Document drafting to a standard a senior executive can route without edits - ProcessStreet workflow building from a brief - Calendar management across multiple people's schedules - Proficient in Claude and AI tools as part of your daily workflow - Native English Personality and culture fit (non-negotiable) - Self-starter. Takes the brief and runs. - A useful second brain: Offers a different perspective on how to approach a tricky conversation, not just executes the task - Discreet and trustworthy. You'll see contracts, compensation conversations, and sensitive internal decisions - Reliable enough that the COO can hand something off and consider it done Location & Hours 100% remote, based in the Philippines. Full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours. How You'll Be Measured - This role is measured on how much load it reliably takes off the COO and how cleanly the work gets done. Specific KPIs and targets are set quarterly with the COO, but the core measures are: - Task turnaround — speed and reliability on items the COO hands off - Tracker accuracy and freshness — project trackers stay current, accurate, and trusted as a single source of truth - Follow-up completion — outstanding items chased to closure, blockers surfaced early - COO time reclaimed — the headline outcome. How much of the COO's week is freed from admin back into strategic work.

description: Are you detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple tools to onboard creators into a brand's affiliate program? You should be comfortable managing: 15–25 creators in active onboarding at any given time Processing 5–10 new "Ready to go" creators per week Daily pipeline review — no creator should sit in a status for more than 48h without action 100% follow-through — every creator who signs a contract must reach "Active" status You must be: Thorough Organized Relentless with follow-ups Comfortable managing multiple tools simultaneously If something is stuck, you flag it. You don't wait. Must-Have Skills CRM management: Comfortable with pipeline-based CRMs (Go High Level preferred, but similar tools work) Tagging, status updates, follow-up scheduling, contact notes Shopify basics: Navigating Shopify admin to manage affiliate app (UpPromote) Processing or confirming orders You don't need to be a Shopify developer — just comfortable in the admin panel Contract/document management: Experience with PandaDoc, DocuSign, or similar e-signature tools Following up on unsigned documents without being pushy Clear written communication: Professional, friendly English for creator-facing messages Ability to explain simple technical steps (e.g., "how to accept Partnership Ads in Instagram") Process management: You can manage a checklist of 5–6 steps per creator without missing any You keep clean notes in the CRM You escalate issues before they become blockers Bonus (Nice to Have) Experience with affiliate marketing platforms (UpPromote, Refersion, GoAffPro, etc.) Familiarity with Meta Business Manager or Ads Manager Understanding of influencer/creator onboarding workflows Previous work in DTC or e-commerce operations Experience with Go High Level specifically Who You Are You're a natural operator — you love systems and processes You're the person who follows up when others forget You can manage 5 different tools without getting confused about what goes where You communicate clearly when something is blocked or needs attention You're reliable, consistent, and take ownership of your pipeline You understand that your job is to get creators from "interested" to "active" with zero drop-off Job Details Hours: 20–30 hrs/week (negotiable, may increase as volume grows) Long-term position Fully remote Payment: Monthly salary (based on experience) How to Apply (Important) ???? title: SEO Specialist
description: We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist who can lead and manage our full SEO workflow, with a strong focus on Local SEO, Search Atlas, technical SEO coordination, gap analysis, and ongoing campaign maintenance. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to improve local search visibility, support Google Business Profile growth, organize SEO tasks, and coordinate execution across content, technical SEO, and development teams. Work Schedule: 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM Manila Time Role Overview The SEO Specialist will be responsible for planning, leading, monitoring, and improving SEO campaigns for multiple clients. This person should be able to identify ranking opportunities, create structured SEO workflows, review local SEO performance, conduct gap analysis, and ensure that all SEO tasks are completed properly and consistently. The ideal candidate must have advanced experience using Search Atlas and must be confident in managing SEO strategy from planning to execution. Key Responsibilities: Local SEO Strategy Develop and manage local SEO strategies to improve client visibility in Google Search and Google Maps. This includes Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword targeting, service area strategy, citation direction, local content planning, and competitor review. Overall SEO Workflow Leadership Lead the overall SEO workflow from strategy creation to execution. Coordinate SEO tasks, organize priorities, assign action items when needed, and make sure each campaign follows a clear process. Gap Analysis Conduct SEO gap analysis across websites, competitors, keywords, content, backlinks, Google Business Profiles, citations, and technical SEO areas. Identify what competitors are doing better and create action plans to close the gap. Monitoring and Maintenance Monitor campaign performance, rankings, website health, Google Business Profile activity, keyword movement, technical issues, and recurring SEO tasks. Maintain SEO campaigns through regular audits, updates, and optimization checks. Search Atlas Management Use Search Atlas for keyword research, content planning, site audits, competitor analysis, optimization recommendations, backlink insights, and reporting. The candidate must be comfortable using Search Atlas at an advanced level. Technical SEO Coordination Review and identify technical SEO issues such as crawl errors, indexing issues, page speed concerns, metadata problems, heading structure issues, broken links, schema opportunities, internal linking gaps, and site architecture concerns. Coordinate with developers when technical fixes are needed. Content and On Page SEO Direction Guide content optimization by reviewing keyword placement, heading structure, internal links, metadata, page intent, local relevance, and overall SEO richness. Provide clear direction to copywriters when content needs improvement. Reporting and Documentation Prepare SEO updates, campaign notes, task summaries, ranking observations, and performance reports. Keep workflows organized and easy for the team to follow. Must Have Qualifications - Advanced experience using Search Atlas - Strong background in Local SEO - Experience leading SEO workflows or managing SEO campaigns - Ability to conduct competitor and gap analysis - Knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization - Strong understanding of on page SEO and technical SEO - Experience with keyword research and local keyword mapping - Ability to monitor rankings, performance, and campaign progress - Clear communication skills - Organized, detail oriented, and proactive Preferred Qualifications - Experience working with service based local businesses - Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics - Familiarity with citation building and local directory strategy - Understanding of schema markup - Experience coordinating with copywriters, developers, and operations teams - Familiarity with SEO reporting tools and project management tools - Ability to create SOPs or structured SEO workflows Skills Needed - Local SEO strategy - Search Atlas - Keyword research - Competitor analysis - Gap analysis - Google Business Profile optimization - On page SEO - Technical SEO - Internal linking strategy - Content optimization - SEO reporting - Workflow management - Team coordination What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who does not just complete SEO tasks, but can think strategically, lead the process, spot problems, and recommend the next best action. The right person should be able to look at a campaign and clearly understand what needs to be fixed, improved, prioritized, or monitored. This role requires someone who is reliable, analytical, organized, and comfortable managing SEO work across multiple clients. How to Apply Please send your resume along with a short summary of your SEO experience, especially your experience with Search Atlas, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and SEO workflow management. Applicants with proven experience handling local SEO campaigns and advanced Search Atlas usage will be prioritized.

title: AI Content Strategist (YouTube & IG Growth) — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor
job_title: AI Content Strategist (YouTube & IG Growth) — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor
description: Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor The setup . I've already got an audience and a funnel running — YouTube and Instagram content that turns into free-course signups and 30-day GoHighLevel trials. (Some of us have started calling this "Claude for Content" — you'd be the one actually running it day to day to get things made and out the door.) The ideation and the content pipeline are mine — I'm deeply involved in that part, every week. What I need is someone to take it from there: build the automations, generate the actual content with AI, get it edited, and get it posted, on time, without me having to chase it. . The role at the simplest level You're doing three things every single day. Taking the ideas and scripts that come out of our content pipeline and actually producing them — AI-generated, B-roll, whatever the format calls for. Getting each piece edited, mostly through AI tools, and out the door on schedule, whether that's an automated post or you hitting publish yourself. And repurposing what's already live into the next thing — same content, new platform, new cut. . Why I'm hiring That's the floor. The reason I'm posting this is I'm not handing off ideation — that part's staying with me and the pipeline I've already built. What I want is someone who can take a script and a hook and actually turn it into a finished, edited, posted, and repurposed piece of content without needing their hand held through it. Execution brain, every day. We'll still go through the analytics together — but production can't bottleneck on me. . Who we are I'm Vico Khang. I build and run AI automation and no-code agency systems on GoHighLevel — AI voice and chat agents, lead-gen automations, white-label SaaS — on real client accounts, not just talking about it on camera. The content side grew out of that: people kept asking how I was doing it, so I started filming it, and that turned into a real audience on Instagram and YouTube. We're not a media company that picked up automation as a topic. We're an automation business that happens to also make good content about it. Want the longer version, in my own words? Watch it here: ---------- . How to apply Fill out the doc here: ---------- . Day to day Building and maintaining the automations that move content from script to published post, cutting out manual busywork wherever it can. Generating the actual content with AI tools once a script or idea comes down the pipeline — B-roll voiceover pieces, AI-avatar or UGC-style videos, whatever the format calls for. Editing through AI tools first, and stepping in by hand only where AI can't get it there. Posting on schedule, automated where it makes sense, manual where it doesn't. Repurposing everything that goes out on YouTube or Instagram into TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook versions. Flagging anything in the calendar that needs a second look, and looping me in on the numbers — we go through those together. . What I need Real, hands-on fluency with Claude and the broader AI content stack — Gemini, Higgsfield, HeyGen — enough to take a script or idea and actually produce a finished piece with it. Comfortable building simple automations — Zapier, Make, n8n, or native tool workflows — so posting and repurposing don't need a human clicking every button. Solid editing instincts, and just as important, knowing which AI tool can do the edit for you and when it can't. Real, hands-on posting experience on YouTube and Instagram — you know the upload mechanics, scheduling, and formatting quirks of each platform cold. Comfortable repurposing long-form into short-form without needing a brief for every single cut. Decent English. We're filming for a US, UK, Canada, and Australia audience. . Bonus If you've actually run the production and distribution side of a channel — your own or someone else's — and know what breaks when you try to automate posting and repurposing, that's a big plus. . What won't work Someone who wants to own the ideation and strategy — that's staying with me and the content pipeline. Someone who treats AI tools as optional instead of the default way things get edited and produced. And someone who needs a fresh brief for every single piece instead of running the system once it's handed to them. . How to apply Fill out the doc here: ---------- Please don't send me a generic resume with nothing to show how you actually produce content with AI — I'll know within 5 seconds, and I'll just close it.
